jobs.title: SDET (C#)
jobs.description:
At NTT DATA, you have endless opportunities to think big, act bold and take ownership. As a $30\+ billion business and technology services, AI and digital infrastructure leader, we co\-innovate solutions with clients and partners globally for business and societal impact. Serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100, with experts in over 70 countries, we encourage experimentation and recognize great work. Proudly a Global Top Employer, NTT DATA is part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion annually in R\&D. Make this the place where you belong, learn, and build your network. Make this the place where *you* grow.


* Collaborate closely with delivery teams, business stakeholders, analysts, and developers to understand requirements, define test scope, and ensure quality expectations are met.
* Design, develop, maintain, and execute automated and exploratory tests across Dynamics 365 Customer Service, Power Pages, portal journeys, and Azure\-integrated solutions.
* Build and maintain automation frameworks and test suites using tools such as Selenium, Playwright, Spec Flow and programming language as C\#.
* Integrate automated testing into Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous testing, quality gates, and rapid feedback.
* Investigate test failures, manage defects through resolution and retesting, and communicate quality risks, dependencies, and release readiness.
* Contribute to test strategy, engineering standards, automation improvements, quality reporting, and maintenance of test documentation.


We are looking for an Automation Test Engineer who can take a requirement or user story, understand what needs to be tested, and apply the right mix of technical testing, automation and exploratory testing to give the team confidence in the quality of what is being delivered.


You should be comfortable using engineering standards, automation frameworks and CI/CD practices to make testing more efficient and repeatable. You will be expected to communicate clearly with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders, contribute to quality planning, and support the resolution of defects in a collaborative Agile delivery environment.


Depth in test automation, Dynamics 365/Power Platform delivery and CI/CD based quality assurance matters more to us than breadth across every testing tool. The right person will be hands\-on, collaborative, quality\-focused and comfortable working in a public sector delivery environment.

  

  

**Must Have**


* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and non\-technical teams.
* Proven experience in Agile delivery environments, working closely with Developers, Business Analysts, and Test Engineers.
* Hands\-on test automation experience using tools such as **Selenium, Playwright, Cypress**, or similar, with programming experience in **C\#,**
* Knowledge of **BDD practices** and tools such as **Spec Flow** or **Cucumber**.
* Experience designing, developing, executing, and maintaining automated test suites for enterprise applications, including **Dynamics 365, CRM, or portal\-based solutions**.
* Strong understanding of test design and execution across **functional, regression, smoke, exploratory, integration testing**.
* Experience using **Azure DevOps** for test management, source control, CI/CD pipelines, reporting, and defect tracking.
* Ability to derive test scenarios from requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria, while managing test data, environments, dependencies, and defects.
* Self\-sufficient approach to delivering testing activities, producing clear test evidence, reporting outcomes, and supporting release readiness decisions.


**Nice to Have**


* Experience defining test scope, estimating effort, and selecting risk\-based testing approaches.
* Experience building or enhancing automation frameworks and integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines with quality gates.
* Experience with **API and integration testing** using tools such as **Postman, REST frameworks and hands on performance testing using Jmeter or load runner**.
* Understanding of modern engineering practices including branching strategies, pull requests, peer reviews, accessibility testing and continuous quality improvement.
* Experience using GitHub Copilot or other AI\-assisted development/testing tools to improve productivity.
* Certifications such as AWS Cloud Practitioner, SAFe, ISTQB, Microsoft Power Platform or relevant automation/testing certifications.


We offer a range of tailored benefits that support your physical, emotional, and financial wellbeing. Our Learning and Development team ensure that there are continuous growth and development opportunities for our people. We also offer the opportunity to have flexible work options.


You can find more information about NTT DATA UK \& Ireland here: https://uk.nttdata.com/


We are an equal opportunities employer. We believe in the fair treatment of all our employees and commit to promoting equity and diversity in our employment practices. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workforce. We actively collaborate with individuals who have disabilities and long\-term health conditions which have an effect on their ability to do normal daily activities, ensuring that barriers are eliminated when it comes to employment opportunities. In line with our commitment, we guarantee an interview to applicants who declare to us, during the application process, that they have a disability and meet the minimum requirements for the role. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know. Join us in building a truly diverse and empowered team.


We are delivering Dynamics 365 Customer Service solutions for a public sector client, extended with Power Pages, Power Automate and related Azure components.


The Automation Test Engineer will play an important role in helping the team deliver reliable, well\-tested and maintainable solutions. You will develop and maintain technical test suites, use appropriate tooling and engineering approaches to design and execute tests, and support the team in identifying and reducing delivery risk.


You will work closely with Developers, Business Analysts, Product Owners, Test Leads and client stakeholders to determine what needs to be tested, how it should be tested, and how test outcomes should be recorded, reported and used to improve quality.


You will take direction from the Test Lead and wider delivery leadership, but you will be expected to work independently on assigned test activities, challenge constructively where appropriate, and bring practical suggestions to improve test coverage, automation quality, continuous feedback and release confidence.


The role involves a significant element of working from home, but there will be periods where occasional travel and working on client sites is needed. The role must be UK based due to client IT and security restrictions.

jobs.title: Sustainability Solutions Manager (SSM)
jobs.description:
Inspired is a market leading, technology\-enabled provider of energy and sustainability solutions in the UK \- supporting businesses to transition to net zero carbon and manage their response to climate change.


Established in 2000, we became the first publicly quoted advisor following a successful AIM debut in 2011\. We are now the UK’s number one destination for businesses seeking expert insight and advisory services to help them manage their energy costs, reduce their carbon emissions and prove their net zero carbon and ESG strategies to their investors and customers


We are looking for a **Sustainability Solutions Manager (SSM)** to join our successful Optimisation team. This role is **home based** with travel to offices required.


**Role and Responsibilities**


The SSM – Optimisation \& Decarbonisation Solutions is responsible for driving new business revenue across Inspired's sustainability and building optimisation division, selling energy efficiency, smart building, retrofit, decarbonisation and energy generation solutions.


Reporting to the Sales Director – Optimisation, the role works pre\-qualified leads generated from Inspired's existing base of c.3,000 energy consultancy customers — there is no requirement for cold outreach or lead generation. The SSM qualifies these warm opportunities, converts them, and develops them into long\-term client relationships in line with the divisional commercial strategy.


The SSM acts as the day\-to\-day commercial point of contact for clients, bridging client objectives and technical delivery capabilities to ensure solutions deliver measurable energy, carbon and operational performance improvements while meeting commercial, regulatory and sustainability requirements.


**The successful candidate's responsibilities will include but not be limited to:**


**Business Development \& Revenue Growth**


* Deliver against individual new business revenue and margin targets contributing to the divisional sales plan set by the Sales Director.
* Work a steady flow of warm, pre\-qualified leads sourced from Inspired's c.3,000 existing energy consultancy customers — no cold prospecting or outbound lead generation is required.

Close new opportunities across:


* Building Management Systems (BMS)
* Smart building technologies
* IoT\-enabled building operations
* Energy efficiency updates
* Retrofit projects
* Decarbonisation programmes – Solar and Battery Energy Storage
* Renewable energy and on\-site generation solutions
* Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of qualified opportunities and manage activity through the full sales cycle, keeping accurate CRM records and forecasts.

**Client Relationship Management**


* Understand client operational challenges, sustainability objectives and asset performance requirements.
* Position Inspired's solutions as strategic investments that deliver operational savings, improved building performance, enhanced ESG outcomes and regulatory compliance.

**Working with Solution Development \& Pre\-Sales**


Inspired has a dedicated Solution Development and Pre\-Sales team that owns the technical heavy lifting and business case build — energy audits, building performance assessments, sustainability reviews, ROI modelling and technical and commercial proposals. The SSM's role is to convert a strong, well\-qualified business case into a closed deal.


* Brief the Solution Development and Pre\-Sales team on client requirements, drivers and decision criteria so they can build a compelling business case.
* Act as the commercial owner of the opportunity — position the business case to client stakeholders, lead commercial negotiation, manage objections and drive to close.
* Maintain enough technical fluency to have credible client conversations, leaving deep engineering, modelling and proposal work to the Pre\-Sales team.
* Feed client and market insight back to the Sales Director and Pre\-Sales team to sharpen the wider proposition.

**Market Awareness \& Industry Engagement**


* Represent Inspired at industry events, conferences, client forums and networking opportunities to generate leads and raise the profile of Inspired's optimisation and decarbonisation capabilities.
* Stay informed on market trends, legislation, competitor activity and emerging technologies, sharing insight with the Sales Director and wider team.
* Act as a trusted advisor to clients on smart buildings, energy efficiency, sustainability and building performance strategies.
* Support marketing and business development initiatives through client presentations, content contribution and industry engagement.

**Sales\-to\-Delivery Transition**


* Ensure a seamless handover from sales to project delivery teams.
* Work closely with project managers, engineers and technical specialists to ensure client expectations, project scope and commercial objectives are clearly documented and understood.
* Stay engaged with clients throughout project delivery to maximise customer satisfaction and identify repeat and follow\-on opportunities.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**


Success in this role will be measured against:


* New business revenue generated against individual target.
* Gross margin.
* Growth and coverage of qualified sales pipeline.
* Conversion rates and sales cycle velocity.
* CRM hygiene and forecast accuracy.

Measurable client outcomes, including:


* Energy savings
* Cost reductions
* Carbon reduction achievements
* ESG and sustainability improvements
* Contribution to market positioning, brand reputation and competitive differentiation.

**Internal Stakeholders**


* Sales Director – Optimisation (line manager)
* Subject Matter Experts:
	+ Solar and Battery systems
	+ BMS and IoT
	+ IoT \& Digital Solutions Teams
	+ Engineering \& Technical Delivery Teams
	+ Sustainability \& ESG Advisory Teams
	+ Marketing \& Commercial Leadership

**Qualifications and Experience Requirements**


Essential:


* Proven track record of achieving and exceeding sales targets within B2B environments.

Desirable:


* Experience within sustainability, energy management, ESG, decarbonisation or net\-zero environments.
* Knowledge of UK energy and building regulations, compliance frameworks and sustainability reporting requirements.
* Experience working with energy monitoring, controls integration or smart building solution providers.
	+ Property management
	+ Facilities management
	+ Building owners and occupiers
	+ Developers and asset managers
	+ Retail, leisure, manufacturing and educational verticals
* Experience closing deals with a contract value of £1m or more.
* Ability to communicate technical solutions in commercial terms and articulate business value to both technical and executive stakeholders.
* Strong consultative selling, negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
* Excellent communication, presentation and influencing abilities.
* Self\-motivated, target\-driven and comfortable working autonomously within a defined commercial strategy.
* Familiarity with smart building and building optimisation technologies sufficient to hold credible client conversations (deep technical expertise sits with the Pre\-Sales team), including:
	+ Building Management Systems (BMS)
	+ IoT and connected technologies
	+ Building automation
	+ Data analytics and monitoring platforms
	+ Energy efficiency solutions
	+ Retrofit programmes

**What we offer**


* Training and development opportunities
* Company pension
* Life insurance
* Enhanced maternity and paternity
* Benefits portal, with a wide range of benefits
* 4pm finish on Friday

If you are interested in the role and would like to be considered, please apply now and a member of our In House Recruitment Team will be in touch. Good Luck!


*If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.*

jobs.title: Wealth Management, International Trust Services - Jersey, Channel Islands Trust Officer, Vice President
jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

A Trust Officer is responsible for the effective administration and oversight of a portfolio of sophisticated private client fiduciary structures across multiple jurisdictions. Structures may include trusts, companies and other wealth\-holding vehicles governed by a range of applicable laws. As Trust Officer you will act as a key point of contact for clients, beneficiaries, bankers, wealth advisers, investment managers, lawyers, tax advisers and other professional intermediaries and will support senior fiduciaries and management in the delivery of a high\-quality fiduciary service.  

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Client Relationship Management**

* As a Trust Officer you will be responsible for the management and administration of a portfolio of complex trust and corporate structures for multinational ultra\-high net worth client base of individuals, corporates and family offices.
* Develop, maintain and optimise professional relationships with clients, intermediaries and internal contacts through delivery of a consistent and seamless client experience to maximise client retention.
* Play a constructive role within our global business, assist the team and act as a principal day\-to\-day contact for designated clients and their professional advisers.
* Respond to client requests promptly and professionally while ensuring that requests are considered from the perspective of the trustee's fiduciary responsibilities.
* Coordinate effectively with internal and external stakeholders to deliver a seamless client experience.
* Identify significant changes in client circumstances and ensure that potential fiduciary, tax, legal, regulatory or reputational implications are appropriately considered and escalated.




* Maintain the highest level of trust and company administration to minimise business risk and to adhere to a culture of compliance with policies and appropriate risk management.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team. Work collaboratively with wealth advisors, bankers and peers to ensure adherence to policies and procedures while delivering a seamless client experience.
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple tasks efficiently. Ensure structures are administered in accordance with applicable governing documents, laws and regulations and J.P. Morgan policies, procedures and controls.
* Strong communication skills, both verbal and written required. Confident when dealing with clients and professionals.
* Ability to work under pressure to achieve deadlines and meet client and business expectations.
* Ability to analyze trust documents for legal, tax, administrative and investment issues and coordinate delivery of services.
* Oversee investment decisions including working with investment advisors. Ensure that the Trust investment objective is appropriate for the needs of the Trust and applicable fiduciary law. Ensure the Trust is compliant with its investment guidelines / mandate.
* Ensure compliance with all local and international anti\-money laundering and Know you Customer requirements.
* Assist with the onboarding of new clients in partnership with Wealth Advisors and the New Business Team.
* Provide technical guidance, coaching and support to Trust Officers and junior team members and review work where appropriate.
* Maintain high standards of client service while ensuring that fiduciary independence, governance and control requirements are consistently maintained.




**Qualifications and Experience**

* Significant experience in private client trust and fiduciary administration, preferably involving complex and internationally connected structures. Minimum 7 years of experience in the roll.
* Strong understanding of trusts, companies and other private wealth structures across multiple jurisdictions.
* Sound understanding of fiduciary principles, governance, AML/KYC and risk management requirements.
* Degree or equivalent professional qualification preferred plus STEP qualification.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to interact confidently with sophisticated clients, advisors and senior stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to exercise sound judgement, manage competing priorities and identify matters requiring escalation.
* Strong commitment to J.P. Morgan's standards of integrity, risk management, controls and client service.


**ABOUT US**
  

  

J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world's most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors. Our first\-class business in a first\-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. We strive to build trusted, long\-term partnerships to help our clients achieve their business objectives.  

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.  

  

  

**ABOUT THE TEAM**
  

  

J.P. Morgan Asset \& Wealth Management delivers industry\-leading investment management and private banking solutions. Asset Management provides individuals, advisors and institutions with strategies and expertise that span the full spectrum of asset classes through our global network of investment professionals. Wealth Management helps individuals, families and foundations take a more intentional approach to their wealth or finances to better define, focus and realize their goals.

Are you ready to build high\-impact production UIs from scratch using modern React, TypeScript, and AI\-augmented tools? Join a modern engineering environment where you will replace a legacy desktop application with a fast, browser\-based React experience, shipping functional software directly to energy dispatchers every single week!

**About Us:**  

Trimble is a global technology company that connects the physical and digital worlds, transforming the ways work gets done. With relentless innovation in precise positioning, modeling and data analytics, Trimble enables essential industries including construction, geospatial and transportation. Whether it's helping customers build and maintain infrastructure, design and construct buildings, optimize global supply chains or map the world, Trimble is at the forefront, driving productivity and progress.

  

Trimble Transportation provides the mobility, enterprise, and visibility tools that move freight across North America. Our TMW Suite TMS platform is the backbone of dispatch operations for energy carriers — managing orders, dispatch, tank readings, pricing, and delivery for bulk fuel and petroleum logistics.

  

Right now, we’re doing something our customers have been waiting for: replacing the legacy Windows desktop application (Suite Dispatch TMS) with a modern, browser\-based experience that dispatchers can access from anywhere. This is a greenfield React build, not a reskin. We’re building the next\-generation TMW Suite Dispatch UI from scratch, shipping 7 screens in 18 months, and going live with real dispatchers on June 1 2027\.

**Here’s what you’d be doing day to day:**  

You’ll be embedded in one of four pair\-squads (2 developers \+ 1 embedded generalist), building production React screens that fuel dispatchers will use to run their daily operations. Each squad owns specific screens end\-to\-end from data service integration through UI polish and Playwright testing. Every Friday, your squad demos working software to stakeholders. No spec theater, no sprint reviews six weeks from now. Weekly demos, weekly accountability, weekly progress.  

The architecture is straightforward: your React UI talks to CloudHub (a tenant\-routing gateway), which dispatches to a per\-tenant OData API, which connects through a CloudHub Connector (CHC) to the customer’s on\-prem SQL database. You’re building a fast, reliable, accessible front\-end that makes fuel dispatchers more efficient.

**Your Key Responsibilities:**

* Build Production React Screens: Own screens end\-to\-end: data service layer, Redux state management, UI components, and Playwright \+ axe\-core tests. Build responsive layouts (1280/1440/1920px) using MUI X DataGrid, Trimble Maps SDK, and the team’s shared design system
* Update and Enhance the Backend Services: Integrate with the CloudHub/OData/CHC API stack, wire up real data from customer SQL databases through the tenant\-routing gateway. Create new services to ensure the new React screens provide the same functionality as the existing Fuel Dispatch on premise application.
* Ship Working Software Weekly: Demo functional, tested features every Friday \- not mockups, not prototypes, not slide decks. Pair with your squad’s embedded generalist on PR reviews, accessibility checks, and test coverage. Maintain CI/CD discipline: main is always deployable, PRs are feature\-scoped, weekly tags cut for demos.
* Solve Real Dispatcher Problems: Build drag\-and\-drop planning interfaces, real\-time map synchronization, threshold\-based alerting, and inline validation engines. Optimize for dispatcher workflows: keyboard navigation, WCAG accessibility, loading skeletons, and error states that tell users what went wrong and what to do next. Performance\-tune data grids for large datasets with server\-side pagination and column virtualization.
* AI\-Augmented Development: Use Cursor and AI coding assistants to accelerate development, generate test scaffolding, and refactor code. Contribute to the team’s shared patterns and component library as the design system evolves.

**Our Tech Stack:**

* the app scaffold React \+ TypeScript \+ Vite
* sortable, filterable, server\-paginated grids MUI X DataGrid
* live truck/station pins, route visualization, bidirectional map\-grid sync Trimble Maps SDK
* shared state across screens (orders, dispatch status, planner sync) Redux Toolkit
* E2E and accessibility testing in CI Playwright \+ axe\-core

 the API layer (tenant routing per\-tenant OData on\-prem connector* SQL) CloudHub / OData / CHC
* authentication via token forwarding Trimble Identity SSO
* daily development tooling, not optional Cursor / AI assistants
* source control and CI/CD GitHub \+ GitHub Actions

**Your Essential Skills \& Experience:**

* 3\+ years building production React applications with TypeScript — not tutorials, not side projects, production apps that real users depend on
* Strong component architecture: you think in composable, testable components with clean prop contracts and proper state management
* Experience with data\-heavy UIs: grids, tables, filters, server\-side pagination, real\-time updates
* Comfort with REST/OData API integration — you’ve wired up front\-ends to real backends and debugged the full request/response chain
* CSS/styling proficiency: responsive layouts, design system integration, consistent cross\-browser rendering
* Git workflow fluency: trunk\-based development, feature branches, clean commit history, PR reviews
* Ability to work in a pair\-squad model — tight collaboration with one other developer and an embedded generalist, shipping weekly

**Bonus Points for:**

* Drag\-and\-drop implementation experience (dnd\-kit, react\-beautiful\-dnd, or similar)
* Experience with AI coding assistants Cursor in daily development workflows
* Familiarity with MUI (Material UI) component library and theming
* Previous experience modernizing legacy desktop applications into browser\-based UIs
* Background in .NET/C\# OData APIs (helpful for debugging the API layer)
* Logistics, transportation, or energy industry domain knowledge you understand what a dispatcher does and why their screen matters

  

Location: UK, Remote

**Why You'll Enjoy Working With Us:**

* At Trimble, we're not just a company that "does good"—we are a team dedicated to making a tangible, positive Real\-World Impact.
* We build innovative solutions designed to solve the world's most critical challenges. From construction sites to transportation hubs, our work tangibly improves how people live, build, move, and grow.
* You'll work on projects that truly matter: Our purpose\-driven culture means you'll be helping to build and deliver solutions that make work faster, safer, and more sustainable for millions of people worldwide. Our impact is tangible, from connected machines that save fuel to data\-driven insights that reduce waste.
* Collaborate with like\-minded people: Our strong internal culture is a "hidden gem." You will work with a collaborative, supportive team that shares your purpose and fosters a genuine sense of belonging. We're a company of "visionary pragmatists" who think boldly and build things that work.
* Be an owner: Trimble thrives on individuals who take initiative and embrace ownership. You'll find an entrepreneurial spirit where success is often "self\-authored," empowering proactive "doers."

  

React, TypeScript, Front\-End Engineer, Software Developer, Redux, Material UI, Playwright, Greenfield, Transportation, Logistics

 **How to Apply:** Please submit an online application for this position by clicking on the ‘Apply Now’ button located in this posting.

**Join a Values\-Driven Team: Belong, Grow, Innovate.**


At Trimble, our core values of Belong, Grow, and Innovate aren't just words—they're the foundation of our culture. We foster an environment where you are seen, heard, and valued (Belong); where you have an opportunity to build a career and drive our collective growth (Grow); and where your innovative ideas shape the future (Innovate). jobs.title: SSD/EDU Technician
jobs.description:
To undertake decontamination science duties in providing a specialized decontamination of medical devices service contributing to the clinical care of the patient \- to carry out the receipt, disassembly, cleaning, reassembly, packing and sterilization of reusable medical devices and record all tasks in the tracking and tracing database.
  
  

To ensure that all products manufactured in the Decontamination Services department within the Trust are fit for purpose and produced in a timely and efficient manner in accordance with the Quality Manager System (QMS) relevant to the area and to work as part of a team and undertake duties as directed by the management team of the Trusts decontamination facilities.
  
  

To work in all areas of the decontamination facilities at both hospitals (Chelsea and Westminster Hospital) and weekend as and when required
  
  

1\. To reprocess reusable medical devices, disassemble, clean, disinfect, check, assemble, sterilize, dispatch and track in a controlled environment.
  
  

2\. To work in accordance with Departmental Policy, Standard Operating Procedures and Quality Management System.
  
  

3\. Report any discrepancies to the team leader immediately.
  
  

4\. Complete the relevant documents for any non\-conformances.
  
  

5\. To contribute to ensuring that quality assurance and production controls systems are maintained in accordance with standard work instructions.
  
  

6\. To provide a collection and delivery service to the Decontamination Departments' customers
  
  

7\. To inform the Decontamination Technician Supervisors of any raw material shortages and ensure stock is rotated.
  
  

8\. To receive raw materials and distribute raw materials to the production area, ensuring that all materials have been booked out in accordance with the quality procedure.
  
  

9\. Under limited supervision meet the demands of the Department’s workload whilst consistently achieving high quality standards which will be measured by in\-process checks and non\-conformance reports.
  
  

Our Trust is one of England's top\-performing and safest trusts. We operate two main acute hospital sites—Chelsea and Westminster Hospital and West Middlesex University Hospital—along with award\-winning clinics across North West London.
  
  

Our nearly 7,500 staff care for a diverse population of 1\.5m, providing full clinical services including maternity, A\&E and children’s services, plus specialist HIV and sexual health care. The CQC rates us Good in safety, effectiveness, care and responsiveness, and Outstanding in leadership and resource use.
  
  

We continually invest in our facilities, including a £30m expansion of critical care at Chelsea and an £80m Ambulatory Diagnostic Centre at West Mid.
  
  

We are delivering sustainable healthcare through our Green Plan. In line with Greener NHS ambitions, we aim for net zero carbon emissions by 2045\. Achieving this requires collective effort. We encourage staff to reduce their impact on carbon, waste and pollution wherever possible. Every action counts to create a healthier, more sustainable future.
  
  

We are committed to equal opportunities and believe diversity drives innovation and excellence. We welcome applications from the global majority, veterans and underrepresented communities, valuing the perspectives they bring.
  
  

1\. To undertake initial investigation into non\-conformances reports as instructed
  
  

2\. To use manual dexterity and concentration for the disassembly and reassembly of the reusable medical devices in accordance with Manufacturer’s instructions
  
  

3\. To operate decontamination equipment and carry out routine tests in accordance with the Planned Preventative Maintenance Schedules, Quality Standards and Guidance
  
  

4\. Attend regular departmental team meetings.
  
  

5\. To attend any training as required.
  
  

6\. To undertake duties consistent with the responsibility of the grade and needs of the service
  
  

7\. Required to work weekends, bank holidays and participate in the department’s on\-call schedule.

jobs.title: Housekeeper
jobs.description:
Join our Women’s Health team as a Housekeeper and play a vital role in creating a safe, welcoming and well\-organised environment for women, babies and families. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys working with people, takes pride in maintaining high standards and thrives in a busy healthcare setting.
  
  

You will be a key member of the multidisciplinary team, helping to ensure the ward runs smoothly by supporting patient experience, maintaining stock supplies, promoting cleanliness and coordinating with support services.
  
  

We are looking for a reliable, proactive and organised individual with excellent communication skills and a commitment to delivering outstanding customer service. In return, you will work in a supportive team environment where your contribution is valued and where you can make a real difference to the experience of our patients and their families every day.
  
  

As a Housekeeper, you will be a valued member of the ward team, helping to ensure a positive experience for patients, families and staff through the delivery of high\-quality non\-clinical support services. You will take responsibility for coordinating ward supplies and maintaining stock levels, ensuring clinical and non\-clinical areas remain organised, safe and operationally ready.
  
  

You will work closely with colleagues across nursing, midwifery and support services to help maintain a clean, welcoming and well\-maintained environment, supporting infection prevention standards and the efficient running of the ward.
  
  

The role requires excellent organisational and communication skills, attention to detail, the ability to prioritise workload and a proactive approach to problem\-solving. You will also support meal service provision, monitor environmental standards, escalate maintenance concerns and contribute to continuous service improvement.
  
  

This is an important role for someone who is approachable, reliable and committed to delivering an excellent experience for women, babies and their families while supporting the safe and effective delivery of care.
  
  

University College London Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust (UCLH) is one of the most complex NHS trusts in the UK, serving a large and diverse population. We provide academically led acute and specialist services, to people from the local area, from throughout the United Kingdom and overseas. Our vision is to deliver top\-quality patient care, excellent education, and world\-class research.
  
  

We provide first\-class acute and specialist services across eight sites:
  
* University College Hospital (incorporating the Elizabeth Garrett Anderson Wing)
* National Hospital for Neurology and Neurosurgery
* Royal National ENT and Eastman Dental Hospitals
* University College Hospital Grafton Way Building
* Royal London Hospital for Integrated Medicine
* University College Hospital Macmillan Cancer Centre
* The Hospital for Tropical Diseases
* University College Hospital at Westmoreland Street


We are dedicated to the diagnosis and treatment of many complex illnesses. UCLH specialises in women’s health and the treatment of cancer, infection, neurological, gastrointestinal and oral disease. It has world class support services including critical care, imaging, nuclear medicine and pathology.
  
  

We are committed to sustainability and have pledged to become a carbon net zero health service, embedding sustainable practice throughout UCLH. We have set an ambitious target of net zero for our direct emissions by 2031 and indirect emissions by 2040\.
  
  

For the full Person Specification and more information regarding the main responsibilities of this role, please refer to the attached Job Description.
  
Please note, due to anticipated high volumes of applications, this vacancy may close earlier than the listed closing date. You are advised not to delay submitting your completed application
  
  

Come and be a part of the best NHS trust in England to work for, according to our staff\*
  
  

* UCLH top trust to work at in England \- In the most recent NHS staff survey UCLH had the highest percentage of staff who said they would recommend us as a place to work, out of all general acute or acute/community NHS trusts in England – for the third year in a row.


UCLH recognises the benefits of flexible working for staff – To find out more, visit: Flexible working .
  
  

To discover more about what makes UCLH a great place to work, visit: Why Choose UCLH?

jobs.description:
**Date:** 11 Sept 2026


**Location:** London, TfL Corporate


**Company:** TfL, GLA or OPDC



**Job title:** SHE Environment Manager
  

**Salary:** £60,000 to £62,000 dependent on skills, knowledge, and experience
  

**Grade:** Band 3
  

**Contract type:** TfL
  

**Reference:** 5670
  

**Team:** Corporate Environment
  

**Contract details:** 12 month FTC (possibility of becoming permanent subject to business requirements and approval)
  

**Location:** Palestra /hybrid

  

**Application closing date:** 23rdSeptember @23\.59

  

Please Note: We reserve the right to close this vacancy early should we receive a high volume of applications; therefore, we encourage interested candidates to apply as soon as possible.

  

*All offers of employment are subject to satisfactory right‑to‑work checks. Candidates must be able to demonstrate their right to work in the UK. At the present time TfL is unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.*

*Hybrid working within this role enables a balance of 50 per cent of time split between the office and home over a 4\-week period.**Hybrid working arrangements can evolve subject to business requirements****.***

  

**About the Role**


Transport for London is seeking an experienced Energy and Carbon professional to join the Sustainability, Energy and Carbon team on a 12\-month fixed\-term contract or secondment.


This is an exciting opportunity to play a key role in delivering TfL's Net Zero ambitions and supporting the decarbonisation of one of the UK's largest and most complex organisations.


As TfL continues its journey towards net zero operations, this role will help shape the strategic direction of energy and carbon initiatives across the business. Working with a wide range of stakeholders, you will lead and support programmes focused on reducing energy consumption, lowering carbon emissions, improving energy efficiency, and driving sustainable outcomes across TfL's operational estate.

  

**What You'll Be Doing**


* Leading the development and delivery of energy and carbon reduction initiatives across TfL.
* Supporting decarbonisation programmes for buildings and operational assets.
* Identifying opportunities to improve energy efficiency and reduce carbon emissions.
* Analysing energy and carbon data to inform decision\-making and drive performance improvements.
* Providing expert advice on energy management, sustainability and carbon reduction.
* Working closely with procurement teams to embed environmental requirements into contracts and supplier relationships.
* Building strong relationships across the business to influence positive environmental change.
* Supporting the delivery of TfL's wider environmental and sustainability objectives.
  

**About You**


We're looking for a motivated and knowledgeable energy and carbon specialist with a proven track record of delivering sustainability initiatives within a large and complex organisation.

  

**Essential Experience**


* Experience developing and delivering energy efficiency and decarbonisation programmes.
* Experience in energy and carbon reporting, monitoring and target setting.
* Experience providing technical advice on energy and carbon matters to a range of stakeholders.
* Experience working on projects that reduce energy consumption and carbon emissions.
* Experience supporting organisational change and influencing stakeholders.
  

**Essential Knowledge**


* Strong understanding of energy management and energy efficiency best practice.
* Knowledge of carbon management and decarbonisation strategies.
* Understanding of climate change, UK energy policy, and the challenges associated with achieving net zero.
  

**Essential Skills**


* Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills.
* Strong project management and organisational capabilities.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong written, verbal and presentation skills.
* Ability to manage competing priorities and deliver high\-quality outcomes in a fast\-paced environment.
  

**Why Join Us?**


This role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful contribution to London's environmental future. You'll work on high\-profile decarbonisation initiatives, influence strategic decisions, and play a key role in helping TfL achieve its ambitious net zero targets.

  

**Application Process**


* Please apply using your CV only
* Think carefully about the skills, knowledge and experience in the advert and cover this in your CV
* PDF format preferred and do not include any photographs or images
  

**Equality, diversity and inclusion**


We are committed to equality, diversity and inclusion and aim to reflect the diverse communities we serve. We believe that a diverse workforce enables us to deliver better services and outcomes. Our goal is to make our recruitment as inclusive as possible. As a Disability Confident Leader, we actively encourage applications from disabled people. As part of the Disability Confident scheme, we aim to offer an assessment or interview to candidates who apply via the scheme where the minimum essential criteria for skills, knowledge and experience has been met. In some circumstances, it may not be practical to offer an interview or assessment to every candidate who applies through the scheme and meet the minimum essential criteria; in these situations, we select candidates who best meet the minimum criteria for the job rather than interviewing all who meet them.


Across all recruitment activity, we recognise that selection methods may vary depending on the nature and scale of the campaign and will be applied fairly, consistently and proportionately in line with our Disability Confident commitments.
  

  

**Benefits**


In return for your commitment and expertise, you will enjoy excellent benefits and scope to grow. Rewards vary according to the level of role but mostly include the below:  

  



* Final salary pension scheme
* Free travel for you on the TfL network
* Reimbursement of 75% of the cost of a standard class Ticket for National Rail travel from home
* 30 days annual leave plus public and bank holidays
* TfL is committed to work\-life balance, operating a hybrid working approach where business and role requirements allow
* Private healthcare discounted scheme Tax\-efficient cycle\-to\-work programme
  

Retail, health, leisure and travel offers
* Discounted Eurostar travel

We will make every effort to give you as much notice as possible, however some interviews/assessments could be organised at short notice.

  

**Vetting Process**


At Transport for London, safety, trust and fairness sit at the heart of how we recruit. Our Vetting Charter (https://tfl.gov.uk/corporate/careers/our\-vetting\-process) explains the checks we carry out before you join us, helping ensure we create a safe, inclusive and reliable network for everyone who depends on our services. We simply ask that the information you provide is honest and accurate so we can progress your application smoothly. If something doesn’t match or can’t be verified, we may not be able to move forward with your application, but we’ll always treat you with transparency, respect, and clear communication throughout.

**CONTRACT TYPE:** Permanent, Full\-time
  
**DEPARTMENT:** BBC Studios Creative Services
  
**LOCATION:** London Television Centre – Hybrid
  
**PROPOSED SALARY RANGE:** Up to £55,000 plus £5,441 London Weighting depending on relevant skills, knowledge and experience. The expected salary range for this role reflects internal benchmarking and external market insights.
  
  

WE ARE BBC STUDIOS
  
  

A globally renowned media company borne of the BBC. We make and distribute the world’s most sought\-after TV, audio and digital content.
  
  

Our ambition is to be the home of the most powerful, entertaining, and inspiring stories for people all around the world.
  
  

PURPOSE OF THE ROLE
  
Join BBC.com as a Senior Designer and play a key role in shaping the creative direction of its growing international subscription business. You'll lead the development of impactful brand and campaign creative across digital channels, combining strategic thinking with hands\-on design execution. Working closely with editorial, marketing, product and UX teams, you'll create audience\-focused campaigns, champion brand excellence and help drive subscription growth on a global scale.
  
  

WHY JOIN THE TEAM
  
This is a unique opportunity to influence how millions of people discover and engage with BBC content around the world. You'll work at the intersection of creativity, storytelling and digital product growth, collaborating with talented multidisciplinary teams on high\-profile campaigns. With exposure to strategic decision\-making, stakeholder leadership and brand development, it's an ideal role for a Senior Designer’s next step.
  
  

**YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES AND IMPACT:**  

Lead the creation of high\-quality design and campaign assets across web, social, CRM, paid media and subscription marketing channels.
  
Develop compelling creative concepts and visual storytelling that drive audience acquisition, engagement, retention and subscription growth.
  
Champion and evolve BBC brand standards, ensuring consistency and excellence across all customer touchpoints.
  
Partner with editorial, marketing, product, UX and growth teams to translate insights and objectives into effective creative solutions.
  
Manage multiple creative projects from concept through to delivery, ensuring quality, efficiency and continuous improvement.
  
Build strong stakeholder relationships, presenting creative work confidently and influencing decision\-making through expert design guidance.
  
Provide day\-to\-day leadership, mentoring and direction to the Motion Designer, helping to maintain high creative standards across the team.
  
YOUR SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE
  
  

**ESSENTIAL CRITERIA:**  

Significant experience in a Senior Designer, Graphic Designer or Brand Design role, ideally within media, publishing, digital products, subscription businesses or content\-led brands.
  
A strong portfolio showcasing branding, campaign development, digital marketing and visual storytelling.
  
Expert knowledge of design principles, including typography, layout, visual hierarchy, photography and brand systems.
  
Proven experience creating high\-performing creative assets across digital channels, including web, social, CRM and paid media.
  
Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and Figma, with experience working within digital\-first environments.
  
Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence, present ideas and build effective working relationships across multiple teams.
  
Experience leading projects and supporting, mentoring or coaching junior creatives.
  
  

**DESIRED BUT NOT REQUIRED:**  

Experience working within subscription, membership or audience growth\-focused businesses.
  
Basic motion graphics knowledge and an understanding of animation\-led creative.
  
Experience using AI\-powered creative tools and emerging technologies to enhance workflows and output.
  
Understanding of digital products, UX principles and performance marketing.
  
Experience contributing to the evolution of brand systems and creative frameworks.
  
Strong commercial awareness with the ability to balance brand, audience and business objectives.
  
Passion for storytelling, journalism and creating work that reaches global audiences.
  
  

If you can bring some of these skills and experience, along with transferable strengths, we’d love to hear from you and encourage you to apply as soon as possible.
  
  

Please include a link to your portfolio as part of your application.
  
  

We appreciate your interest in this position and understand how important this opportunity is to you. Due to the high volume of interest we may need to close the application period earlier than anticipated. This step is necessary to ensure we can provide a high level of attention and service to all applicants. Thank you for your understanding.
  
  

\#BBCSTUDIOS

jobs.title: Imaging Nursing Assistant
jobs.description:
The post holder will primarily help provide a seamless service for patients attending imaging for an interventional procedure under Ultrasound, CT or fluoroscopic guidance.
  
  

The purpose of this role is to support the interventional diagnostic and treatment services. The role will be cross sites, allocated based on procedure list requirements The post holder will be required to work both autonomously using their own initiative and within the team in the development and delivery of the minimal invasive procedure services.
  
  

This role also entails providing support to the clinical nurse specialist team. The post holder will be predominantly responsible for ensuring the prompt and complete preparation of the patient prior to entering the scanning rooms as well as assisting the operators intra\-procedure. It is expected that the post holder is highly computer literate, experienced within the hospital setting with knowledge and evidence of medical terminology, educated to a level required to perform the role or equivalent experience.
  
  

The post holder will be responsible for the provision of a professional, proficient and comprehensive support service alongside the nursing team, modality lead radiographer, rotational radiographers, medical and non\-medical staff.
  
  

**Shift pattern:** Monday to Friday 37\.5 hrs per week.
  
  

To assist the Operator and other qualified healthcare professionals in checking patient details as per trust identification policy.
  
  

To assist the nursing team in preparation for the patients. This will include completion of relevant safety checklists, changing them into suitable patient gowns and any other reasonable steps.
  
  

To undertake intravenous cannulation according to trust and imaging policy.
  
  

To answer any queries which the patient or their carer may ask and know when to ask for assistance from a radiographer
  
  

To assist with any manual handling responsibilities at any point during the examination
  
  

To assist in the preparation of and maintenance of the clinical environment in keeping with trust infection control policy and procedure.
  
  

To assist in the patient point of care testing under the close supervision of a suitably trained radiographer
  
  

To facilitate the efficient movement of patients both to and from imaging, such as those requiring hospital transport
  
  

To be responsible for the maintenance of stock for the procedure scheduled for that day list, this will include cannulation packs, paper products, gloves, hand hygiene products, linen etc.
  
  

At Imperial College Healthcare you can achieve extraordinary things with extraordinary people, working with leading clinicians pushing boundaries in patient care.
  
  

Become part of a vibrant team living our values \- expert, kind, collaborative and aspirational. You’ll get an experience like no other and will fast forward your career. Benefits include career development, flexible working and wellbeing, staff recognition scheme. Make use of optional benefits including Cycle to Work, car lease schemes, season ticket loan or membership options for onsite leisure facilities.
  
  

We are committed to equal opportunities and improving the working lives of our staff and will consider applications to work flexibly, part time or job share. Please talk to us at interview.
  
  

Environmental sustainability
  
Climate change and poor air quality is a health emergency that harms people’s health and wellbeing and widens health inequalities. The Trust is also committed to reducing its impact on the environment by reducing our greenhouse gas emissions to Net Zero by 2045\. All our employees have a role to play, and we have an active green network that supports staff to act in ways that ensures that our services are efficient, sustainable and reduce our impact on the environment www.imperial.nhs.uk/about\-us/our\-strategy/green\-plan .
  
  

The full job description provides an overview of the key tasks and responsibilities of the role and the person specification outlines the qualifications, skills, experience and knowledge required. For both overviews please view the Job Description attachment with the job advert.

jobs.title: .Net Software Engineer
jobs.description:
At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team.

**Role overview**


We’re looking for a .Net Software Engineer to help design, build, and support our core platform.


In this role, you’ll contribute to backend services, APIs, data access, integrations, and some UI components in a cloud\-based, event\-driven architecture. Our technology stack includes C\#, .NET, PostgreSQL, AWS, Blazor, and MudBlazor, with services running across Lambda, ECS, and EC2\.


We build distributed systems that communicate through APIs and events, and we continue to improve our engineering practices, tooling, and platform capabilities.


We take an AI\-first approach to software development, using approved AI tools to support design, coding, testing, refactoring, documentation, and problem\-solving. You’ll be encouraged to use these tools thoughtfully and responsibly as part of your day\-to\-day work.


This role suits someone who enjoys hands\-on development, collaborative problem\-solving, and delivering reliable software in a practical, iterative environment.

**Responsibilities**

* Design, build, test, deploy, and maintain secure, reliable, and maintainable software
* Develop and support .NET services and APIs within an event\-driven microservices architecture
* Contribute to integrations between systems using APIs and events
* Work with PostgreSQL and data access patterns to deliver scalable, supportable solutions
* Support applications and services hosted in AWS, including Lambda, ECS, and EC2
* Contribute to UI development in Blazor and MudBlazor where needed
* Break down requirements and solution designs into clear technical tasks
* Participate in estimation, planning, and technical discussions
* Take part in peer reviews and contribute to shared coding standards and quality practices
* Write automated tests and help improve software quality and reliability
* Troubleshoot defects, investigate incidents, and support production issues when needed
* Create and maintain clear technical documentation
* Use approved AI\-assisted development tools responsibly and in line with engineering, security, and quality standards

**Requirements**

* Minimum 3 years of experience as a Software Engineer building production application in **C\# and .NET**
* Experience building and maintaining backend services and APIs
* Experience working with **event\-driven systems**, asynchronous messaging patterns, or service\-based architectures
* Understanding of **RESTful APIs** and service\-to\-service communication
* Experience with **relational databases**, preferably **PostgreSQL**
* Understanding of automated tests and good software quality practices
* Experience using source control and collaborating through code review practices
* Ability to work from technical documentation and break development work into clear technical tasks
* Practical experience using **AI\-assisted development tools** as part of day\-to\-day engineering work
* Good written and verbal communication skills
* Comfortable working in a pragmatic delivery environment that draws from agile principles without following a strict framework

*Nice to have:*

* Experience with **microservices architecture**
* Experience with **BFF patterns**
* Experience with **AWS services** such as **Lambda, ECS, EC2**, or related cloud\-hosted environments
* Experience with **PostgreSQL** in production systems
* Experience with **Blazor** and/or **MudBlazor**
* Familiarity with **CI/CD pipelines** and deployment processes
* Familiarity with **Docker** or container\-based development
* Exposure to observability, logging, and monitoring practices in distributed systems
* Exposure to **AI\-assisted development tools** such as **GitHub Copilot**
* Awareness of secure coding practices and building resilient applications

Support the Project Managers, Project Development Managers and Project Teams, responsible for providing support for the development of SP Energy Networks Transmission projects portfolio.


The role holder will work alongside project managers and project development managers to assist with key project management responsibilities including financial administration as well as supporting the onboarding and training of new staff in key systems. jobs.title: Business Development Manager (Sponsorship)
jobs.description:
**Boost by Banter**



We are not looking for a relationship manager who waits for inbound, files tidy decks, and calls it a quarter. We are not looking for someone who needs a sales playbook handed to them or who thinks "following up" means a single email chase. If your idea of pipeline management is a CRM full of hopeful conversations that never close, this is not your role.



What we are building at Boost by Banter is a commercial engine with real teeth. You will be responsible for the full sponsorship and partnerships pipeline: identifying crypto projects and advertisers with live marketing budgets, pitching them into Banter's media channels, managing KOL deal flows concurrently, and making sure every campaign actually delivers.



You will be joining a small, growing team at a media brand that millions of crypto\-native people already follow and trust. That brand equity is real, and it is yours to leverage from day one.


**What You'll Do**


* **Own the full sales pipeline:** Source, qualify, pitch, negotiate, and close new crypto project sponsors, KOLs, and affiliates from first contact through to signed deal \- no handoffs, no safety net.
* **Build and work a live prospect list:** Drive outreach proactively via Telegram BD communities, Crypto Twitter, conference flors, and your personal book of contacts \- not by waiting for marketing to generate leads.
* **Manage concurrent KOL deal flows:** Execute multiple KOL partnerships simultaneously, maintaining clear timelines, deliverables, and communication standards without dropping the ball on any active campaign.
* **Ensure campaign execution lands:** Coordinate with Banter's content and operations teams to make certain every sponsor integration is fulfilled to brief, on time, and in line with the advertiser's campaign objectives.
* **Report performance with precision:** Deliver detailed post\-campaign reports to sponsors that demonstrate ROI, build trust, and create grounds for renewal \-turning closed deals into long\-term commercial relationships.
* **Hit a hard number:** Work toward a consistent **$150k\+ monthly revenue** **target**, with clear milestones in the first 90 days — a live pipeline, first closed deals, and demonstrable early revenue momentum.

  


**Your Skills and Experience**


* **Native crypto market knowledge:** You understand the difference between a vanity integration and a high converting campaign, know how KOL deal structures work in practice, and can speak credibly to a crypto project's CMO about what actually moves their audience**.**
* **Hunter sales mentality:** You self source leads through conferences, Telegram groups, and a warm Rolodex rather than relying on inbound \- commission upside and full ownership of your pipeline motivate you more than a comfortable base.
* **KOL and affiliate management experience**: You have managed multiple KOL relationships concurrently, handling deal negotiation, briefing, fulfilment tracking, and performance review without needing a separate account management layer to hold it together.
* **Stable commercial tenure in Web3:** 3\+ years in BD, partnerships, or sales roles within crypto \- with a tenure history that shows you build and deliver rather than move on before results materialise, and an active warm book of crypto project contacts with marketing budgets in the $50k–$500k range.
* **Geographic and community prese**nce: Based in a genuine Web3 hub \- Singapore, Dubai, London, New York, Seoul, Hong Kong, or comparable with real access to regional conference circuits and the Telegram and Crypto Twitter communities where deals are actually sourced.
* **Operational self\-sufficiency:** Comfortable integrating into existing content and admin workflows, managing your own CRM hygiene, and delivering performance reporting to sponsors without needing a support team to do it for you.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. **Location**
------------


10 South Colonnade, Canary Wharf, London E14 4PU / Edinburgh Government Hub Queen Elizabeth House, Edinburgh EH8 8FT**About the job**
-----------------

### **Job summary**


Do you want a career with a difference? Where you can have a real impact working with government departments and the wider public sector. If yes, then a career at the Government Actuary's Department (GAD) could be for you.


At GAD our mission is to support effective decision\-making and robust reporting within the public sector as the first\-choice provider of actuarial and specialist analysis, advice and assurance. The departments work covers valuation work and policy support in relation to investment, credit risk, insurance and contingent liabilities, pension schemes, financial risk, and social security. We also provide financial modelling and quality assurance.


We offer great working benefits including a world\-class pension, flexible working options and a career where your learning and development is taken seriously.


You will be a key consultant advising on investment and/or credit risk. The purpose of the role is to support our engagement and delivery of advice to help the public sector make more effective and informed decisions. The work is significantly more varied than in a typical actuarial consultancy, with opportunities to work on high\-profile public sector priorities and develop innovative solutions.


Further information on GAD is provided in the attached pack.

**N.B. GAD may work with recruiters on this campaign provided prior agreement is reached for this specific campaign**

### **Job description**


The role is in our Policy and Assurance unit. You will be based in one of the teams in that unit although we would expect you to support other teams and undertake a wider variety of work as required (see Key responsibilities 5\). Below sets out the range of work that GAD undertakes with respect to Investment and Credit Risk. There is scope for consultants at GAD to specialise in one area, or to work across multiple areas.


Investment


GAD provides advice in relation to invested funds held or sponsored by public sector bodies, and on government policy relating to investments held in the private sector, often in the context of pension arrangements. We are looking to hire an investment specialist to work alongside actuaries, trainee actuaries and analysts to enhance the support we can provide to our clients on investment issues.


GAD consultants regularly work in a much more diverse range of areas than a typical actuarial consultancy, working closely with both policy makers and operational staff to deliver effective public policy. The work is varied, interesting and has purpose, working in the best interests of the UK public. Recent projects have included:

* DB and DC pensions  advice in relation to funded public sector Defined Benefit (DB) pension scheme investments, public sector bodies Defined Contribution (DC) and Additional Voluntary Contribution (AVC) arrangements and wider pensions policy.
* Sizewell C  working with the Department for Energy Security and Net Zero and stakeholders to develop the funding and investment framework for a fund that will eventually be used to decommission the Sizewell C infrastructure.
* Pensions Investment Review  advising the Department for Work and Pensions on its productive finance agenda and how defined contribution pensions can contribute.
* Climate scenario analysis  setting assumptions and carrying out analysis of investment portfolios for funded public sector pension schemes to comply with Taskforce for Climate Related Financial Disclosures (TCFD) reporting.
* Personal Injury Discount Rate  supporting government bodies as they review the rate of return that a personal injury claimant is assumed to earn if investing their damages award.


Credit Risk


GAD provides advice and support to a range of departments and wider public sector bodies on credit risk arrangements and modelling. These arrangements can arise from situations where government addresses gaps in private sector coverage, is trying to stimulate investment or is otherwise subject to credit risk.


The type of credit risk modelling is varied, and could relate to:

* expected credit loss calculations for financial guarantees and loans
* economic capital modelling
* stress testing
* other insolvency modelling for events which could impact government.


GADs role may involve:

* Quantifying and communicating risk
* Policy development  how credit risk arrangements can help meet policy objectives and be structured to reduce risk to government
* Quality Assurance  reviewing credit risk related models produced by other areas of the public sector


The work may involve consideration of niche, novel or remote risks, working with clients and third parties to incorporate specialist knowledge from subject matter experts to determine appropriate advice.


Current and previous areas of advice include:

* Assessment of implicit liabilities related to insolvency of key entities in line with Guidance for managing governments implicit liabilities
* Modelling of the credit losses arising from guarantees given to support multi\-lateral development banks
* Quality assurance of economic capital models subject to the Financial transaction control framework \- GOV.UK


General


The exact area a successful candidate will work in will be discussed prior to an offer being made and will be informed by the expertise and interests of the individual.


Regardless of the area of work, you will be expected to work closely with clients, scope out advice needs and deliver high value advice. The ability to apply investment and/or credit risk principles to novel policy areas and develop innovative solutions is essential.


Business development is an essential component of the role: you will help to build GADs reputation within the public sector, increasing awareness of your area of expertise and supporting the development of new client opportunities through networking, profile raising and building relationships with stakeholders across the public sector.


As part of your role, we expect you to help grow and develop both your own skills, and those of junior colleagues to help meet the evolving nature of our work. You will also help develop the investment and/or credit risk capabilities within GAD, sharing your knowledge and experience with others.

### **Person specification**

To provide consultancy support and advice to government departments and other organisations in the public sector. This will involve working with colleagues and clients to deliver high\-quality advice, often within demanding timescales.


To maintain and build on existing client relationships and to develop new relationships.


To work with colleagues to ensure all work is appropriately scoped and delivered in an efficient and timely manner with a focus on providing value for money for our clients. This includes:

* Specifying work, monitoring output and providing feedback
* Effective project management
* Motivating and team building
* Partnering with clients
* Operational duties  scheduling work, leave management, exercising financial control as required
* Business development and client engagement activities


The role requires a consistently high level of service to be provided and for work to be undertaken within professional requirements. This includes:

* Providing/supporting appropriate quality advice (oral or written) to agreed timescales and within budget
* Complying with peer review procedures
* Adapting to changing client needs and balancing conflicting priorities
* Complying with all professional actuarial (where relevant), civil service and GAD guidance.


 Agile working within other GAD teams from time to time during key periods.


 To maintain an up\-to\-date knowledge of role\-relevant developments and other matters (including meeting all CPD requirements).

*This job description is a broad reflection of the current duties. It is not an exhaustive list, and changes may be required, based on GADs immediate operational needs which are at the discretion of the relevant Unit Director and in conjunction with the post holder.*

### **Behaviours**


We'll assess you against these behaviours during the selection process:


* Managing a Quality Service
* Seeing the Big Picture
* Working Together
* Communicating and Influencing
### **Technical skills**


We'll assess you against these technical skills during the selection process:


* For Actuary Band 1 or 2 (investment / credit risk consultant): Fellow of the Institute and Faculty of Actuaries (IFoA) or international equivalent (Essential for AB1 and AB2\)
* For Grade 7 (investment / credit risk consultant): A member of the Chartered Financial Analyst Institute, holding the CFA charter and designation or equivalent professional qualification (Desirable for Grade 7\)
* Detailed knowledge of Investment and/or Credit risk concepts and techniques (Essential)
**Benefits**
------------


Alongside your salary of £66,361, Government Actuary's Department contributes £19,224 towards you being a member of the Civil Service Defined Benefit Pension scheme. Find out what benefits a Civil Service Pension provides .
As well as competitive salaries, we offer a substantial package of benefits:

* Exceptional learning and development opportunities that you can explore alongside your day\-to\-day work.
* 25 days annual leave per year, increasing to 30 days after 5 years service. In addition, we offer 9 days public and privilege days leave per year (pro rata for part time staff)
* A Civil Service pension with an employer contribution of 28\.97%
* 5 days of paid volunteering leave
* Up to 9 months maternity leave on full pay \+ generous paternity and adoption leave
* Staff reward and recognition bonuses that operate throughout the year.
* Occupational sick pay
* Family\-friendly policies such as help with caring responsibilities, special leave, generous paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave.
* Access to employee assistance programme which offers staff 24/7 confidential support and resources such as counselling, debt guidance and management advice.
* The opportunity to join a trade union.
* A working culture which encourages inclusion and diversity.
* Salary advances for travel costs, including annual season tickets and cycle\-to\-work schemes.
* Access to the Edenred employee benefits system which offers discounts to popular retailers and access to various useful resources such as financial and savings advice.
* Complimentary BUPA health check.
**Things you need to know**
---------------------------

### **Artificial intelligence**

Where plagiarism has been identified (presenting the ideas and experiences of others, or generated by artificial intelligence, as your own) applications may be withdrawn and internal candidates may be subject to disciplinary action. jobs.title: Deputy Superintendent Radiographer - ED
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced, senior radiographer who wishes to work at Chelsea and Westminster Hospital so that they are surrounded by people who put patients first but are also keen to invest in themselves and the organisation.
  
  

The Trust has a commitment to develop its staff. For the ED Imaging Deputy Superintendent, this means rotating through:
  
  

* ED Xray
* ED CT
* General Xray
* Interventional Radiology
* Main CT


The post holder will be responsible for assisting the Xray and CT Superintendents in providing the operational management and coordination of the ED Imaging service at Chelsea \& Westminster Hospital.
  
  

The post holder will partake in effective management and deployment of staff and will assist with all aspects of the day to day management of the ED and main Imaging Department.
  
  

The post holder will be responsible for the assisting the superintendents with coordination of the Quality Standards for Imaging accreditation.
  
  

Operationally they will be responsible for coordinating continual improvement of Patient Experience and Quality of Care improvement projects including paperless workflow, coordinated department wide surveys and reviewing patient pathways.
  
  

They will be responsible for the monitoring of an effective Quality Assurance database of all Imaging equipment in ED Imaging together with the Superintendents and Medical Physics team.
  
  

The post holder will also be the lead for the Trauma Audit Research Network data collection, working together effectively with the x\-ray/CT superintendents and the trauma team across ED and the hospital.
  
  

We have a culture which fosters innovation and supports new ideas whilst also ensuring our people are well supported so that they have high rates of employee satisfaction and are professionally developing to be the leaders of tomorrow. Being one of only a handful of Trusts in London to secure Quality Standards in Imaging (QSI) accreditation by the United Kingdom Accreditation Service (UKAS), we are keen to maintain the highest quality standards, and drive quality improvement (QI).
  
  

Our Trust is one of England's top\-performing and safest trusts. We operate two main acute hospital sites—Chelsea and Westminster Hospital and West Middlesex University Hospital—along with award\-winning clinics across North West London.
  
  

Our nearly 7,500 staff care for a diverse population of 1\.5m, providing full clinical services including maternity, A\&E and children’s services, plus specialist HIV and sexual health care. The CQC rates us Good in safety, effectiveness, care and responsiveness, and Outstanding in leadership and resource use.
  
  

We continually invest in our facilities, including a £30m expansion of critical care at Chelsea and an £80m Ambulatory Diagnostic Centre at West Mid.
  
  

We are delivering sustainable healthcare through our Green Plan. In line with Greener NHS ambitions, we aim for net zero carbon emissions by 2045\. Achieving this requires collective effort. We encourage staff to reduce their impact on carbon, waste and pollution wherever possible. Every action counts to create a healthier, more sustainable future.
  
  

We are committed to equal opportunities and believe diversity drives innovation and excellence. We welcome applications from the global majority, veterans and underrepresented communities, valuing the perspectives they bring.
  
  

To demonstrate perspective taking when dealing with patients, customers and fellow staff alike so that all views are understood and considered
  
  

To undertake all radiographic duties efficiently and to the highest quality standards.
  
  

To ensure that all patients receive the best possible standard of care.
  
  

Commitment to ensuring own development by exposing self to all necessary modalities at Chelsea and Westminster Hospital.
  
  

Assist with practical training of junior staff and student radiographers, acting as a role model through leading by example.
  
  

Communicate with other staff members to ensure the smooth running of the directorate.
  
  

Participate in the out of hours shift rota as required.
  
  

The post holder will be required to actively participate in a periodic professional development review, in accordance with Trust guidelines.
  
  

To undertake any other duties which may be appropriate to the post.
  
  

To offer an initial assessment and interpretation of images produced by themselves or more junior staff in the course of their role.
