jobs.title: Business Control Manager, Instinet - Vice President
jobs.description:
Job Code: 14931
Country: GB
City: London
Skill Category: Operations
Description:
**Company overview**

  

As the agency\-model execution services arm of the Nomura Group, Instinet Incorporated subsidiaries provide brokerage services to clients in over 65 markets around the world. Through its advanced suite of electronic trading strategies, experienced high\-touch trading group, top\-ranked Commission Management services, award\-winning desktop trading platform, and unparalleled access to insightful analytics, content and unique liquidity, Instinet helps institutions lower overall trading costs and ultimately improve investment performance. Over the course of its 50\+ year history, Instinet has introduced a range of now industry\-standard trading technologies, and has been an innovator at the forefront of the market's evolution. For more information, please visit www.instinet.com.

  

**Department Overview**

  

Financial Data \& Business Analysis will be responsible for the ownership, analysis, control and governance of financial, liquidity and business\-cost data supporting Instinet Europe Limited’s Clearing \& Settlement Services business and relevant activities within Business Control.

  

The role will sit within Business Operations and provide dedicated analytical ownership of the financial economics of the Clearing \& Settlement Services business, ensuring that the relationship between client activity, transaction volumes, clearing and settlement activity, liquidity utilisation, infrastructure costs, client charges and business profitability is understood, appropriately controlled and accurately represented.

  

**Role Description**

  

The successful candidate will take ownership of the financial and analytical data provided by Business Operations to Finance for client invoicing and other financial processes, together with oversight of relevant NPE and associated business costs. The individual will work closely with internal and external stakeholders to understand underlying cost and revenue drivers, investigate material movements and provide meaningful analysis to support business management and decision\-making.


In addition, the role will have responsibility for relevant financial data, modelling, EUCs and analytical activities undertaken within Business Control.

  

Key objectives critical to success (and not limted to):

  

* Own the financial and analytical data supporting the Clearing \& Settlement Services business.
* Lead the development, maintenance and governance of liquidity\-related data, reporting and analytical models.
* Business Operations oversight of the financial and transactional data supplied to Finance for client invoicing.
* Business Operations oversight, monitoring and analysis of relevant NPE and associated costs of operating the Clearing \& Settlement Services business.
* Financial models and material EUCs operated within Business Operations for Clearing \& Settlement Services and relevant Business Control activities.
* Take ownership of key financial data, analytical models, reporting and End User Computing (EUC) tools that support Business Control activities.
* All aspects of Business and Management Information
* Develop strong working relationships with stakeholders across Business Operations, the Front Office, Business Control, Finance, Treasury, Technology, Product and other relevant functions.
  

**Skills, experience, qualifications and knowledge required:**

  

* Degree or equivalent professional experience in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Data Analytics, Business or a related discipline.
* ACA, ACCA, CIMA, CFA or equivalent professional qualification.
* Experience within an investment bank, broker\-dealer, agency brokerage, clearing or financial\-market infrastructure environment.
* Knowledge of cash equities, clearing and settlement and the associated trade lifecycle.
* Understanding of CCPs, CSDs, custodians, exchanges and associated infrastructure charging models
* Significant prior experience in financial analysis, business analysis, management information, financial control, product control or a comparable analytical role within financial services.
* Strong quantitative and financial analytical capability with demonstrable experience analysing large and complex financial or transactional data sets.
* Advanced Excel skills and experience developing and maintaining complex financial models and EUCs.
* Experience analysing revenues, costs, invoices and business profitability, with strong understanding of financial data controls, reconciliations and data\-quality management.
  

**Nomura Competencies**


**Explore Insights \& Vision**


* Identify the underlying causes of problems faced by you or your team and define a clear vision and direction for the future.

**Making Strategic Decisions**


* Evaluate all the options for resolving the problems and effectively prioritize actions or recommendations.

**Inspire Entrepreneurship in People**


* Inspire team members through effective communication of ideas and motivate them to actively enhance productivity.

**Elevate Organizational Capability**


* Engage proactively in professional development and enhance team productivity through the promotion of knowledge sharing.

**Inclusion**

Respect DEI, foster a culture of psychological safety in the workplace and cultivate a "Risk Culture" (Challenge, Escalate and Respect).  

* 

**Right to Work**
  

The UK Government have taken steps to reduce net migration to the UK by limiting the number of overseas workers coming to the UK for employment. Please note that whilst we are able to consider applications from overseas workers from outside the UK (who require a Tier 2 Skilled Worker visa) we can only employ them if we can provide evidence that this is a genuine vacancy for a qualified role.

  

**Diversity \& Inclusion**

Nomura is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to ensuring we best reflect the diversity of the communities we serve creating an inclusive environment for all our employees. We welcome all applications and do not discriminate on the basis of age, disability, gender identity and gender expression, pregnancy and maternity, marriage and civil partnership, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation.

  

If you require any assistance or reasonable adjustments due to a disability or long\-term health condition, please do not hesitate to contact us.

  

Nomura is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Assistant Shop Manager
jobs.description:
**About the role**


As an Assistant Shop Manager in Mind Retail, you'll work alongside the Shop Manager and the wider shop team, inclusive of volunteers, to deliver sales and profit targets for your shop, where every item sold fights for mental health. The money raised from our charity shops funds Mind's vital mental health support services, helping the 1 in 4 of us that experience a mental health problem in their lifetime.


You'll also work with the team to produce excellent shop standards and deliver outstanding customer service \- creating a hub for the local community. Our Assistant Managers also take full responsibility whilst the Shop Manager is away for the day\-to\-day running and overall performance of the shop.


As Assistant Shop Manager, you'll also be invested in, and supported to grow. We actively look for opportunities to learn so we can do better for the people who need us. With development programmes and a vast programme of workshops, you'll be able to take ownership for your own personal and professional development. You'll be able to make a real difference and will play an important role in the fight for mental health, helping us to respond to the mental health emergency.


We're looking for someone who:


* is passionate about retail
* has the ability to lead and motivate others
* can plan and prioritise their own workload and the workload of the team
* has a strong customer focus
* can demonstrate our values and behaviours, which are at the core of all we do

If you haven't got management or supervisor level experience, don't worry! We're just as interested in people who want a career in retail, are prepared to work hard and are eager to learn.


We need great people like you to help us in the fight for mental health. Will you join us?

  

**About our benefits**


As Assistant Shop Manager, you'll receive the fantastic benefits below:


* Competitive hourly pay, which is in line with the Real Living Wage
* 25 days' paid holiday per year (pro\-rata for part\-time employees)
* Development workshops \& courses, to help build your career
* Comprehensive, personalised induction programmes, tailored to your role when you join us
* A huge variety of additional qualifications \& development programmes for anyone looking to grow their skills
* A strong commitment to work\-life balance
* Family friendly policies \& enhanced pay
* A competitive pension scheme \& life assurance, available to all our employees
* 25% staff discount in all Mind shops
* Access to exclusive discounts at over 160 retailers through our employee savings app
* Employee Assistance Programme
* Cycle to Work Scheme
* Interest free season ticket loan
  

**About Mind Retail**


Mind Retail are a network of almost 200 shops across England and Wales, generating a net income of around £21 million per year. We have ambitious plans to grow over the next few years and we're going to be fighting for mental health in a way we never have before. We won't stop until everyone with a mental health problem gets the support and respect they deserve. There's never been a more exciting time to join us.

  

**Equality, Diversity and Inclusion**


We value the power of diversity. We embrace the different perspectives that each of us bring. We are committed to creating an inclusive working environment where everyone is appreciated for being authentic and bringing their whole selves to work.

  

**Safer Recruitment at Mind Retail**


We are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of our employees and volunteers and we expect anyone working with us to share this commitment. In line with our Safer Recruitment policy, the successful candidate will be required to provide references and will be expected to undertake an enhanced DBS check with a check of the Children's Barred List and/or ‘Work with Adults' workforce check based on their role and responsibilities. A DBS check is a process to check someone's criminal record (if they have any). A Barred List is a list of people who are barred from working with children.


Mind Retail is an equal opportunities employer, welcoming applicants from all communities. We are committed to the fair treatment of our staff, potential staff and volunteers, regardless of race, gender, religion, sexual orientation, responsibilities for dependants, age, physical/mental disability or offending background.


This job vacancy is exempt from the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974 and the amendments to the Exceptions Order 1975, 2013 and 2020\.

  

**More details**

  


Mind Retail reserve the right to close the vacancy to applications earlier, should we receive a high volume of strong candidates. Therefore, we encourage an early application.

jobs.title: Clinical Research Nurse
jobs.description:
We are excited to announce a wonderful opportunity to join the Clinical Trials Centre at St Mary's, ICHT. We are looking for a dedicated and passionate Band 5 Clinical Research Nurse to support our HIV and Sexual Health clinical research studies on a one\-year fixed\-term contract.
  
  

Post qualification nursing experience is essential to this role and therefore it is not suitable for newly qualified nurses or those who have yet completed their preceptorship.
  
  

This role involves onsite working only. You will be based primarily at St Mary's Hospital, Paddington, with the potential to travel to Hammersmith and Charing Cross Hospitals as needed, to assist with commercial and non\-commercial research studies.
  
  

The role also includes day to day monitoring and maintenance of the clinic and equipment, and the opportunity to manage wider team projects such as the Patient Reported Experience Survey as mandated from the NIHR, as well as clinical audits.
  
  

You will need to collaborate with the Principal Investigators (PIs), the wider Multidisciplinary Team (MDT) as well as the Study Team in order to efficiently manage a caseload of studies. Excellent communication skills are required.
  
  

Prior knowledge and clinical experience of research delivery in a healthcare setting and clinical experience or knowledge about HIV and Sexual Health would be advantageous.
  
  

The post holder will support the aims of the Trust and the NIHR clinical research network to improve the speed, quality, and integration of clinical research, through the successful delivery of clinical research in the NHS.
  
  

The post holder will support the co\-ordination and management of clinical research projects, collaborating with key personnel throughout the Trust and network to ensure continued care and support for patients involved in clinical trials.
  
  

The main focus of the role will be in supporting the delivery and development of the research portfolio through identification of suitable participants, co\-ordination, recruitment, performance and maintenance of study documentation.
  
  

The post holder will ensure that any research undertaken safeguards the well\-being of research participants and is conducted to ICH Good Clinical Practice standards.
  
  

At Imperial College Healthcare you can achieve extraordinary things with extraordinary people, working with leading clinicians pushing boundaries in patient care.
  
  

Become part of a vibrant team living our values \- expert, kind, collaborative and aspirational. You’ll get an experience like no other and will fast forward your career. Benefits include career development, flexible working and wellbeing, staff recognition scheme. Make use of optional benefits including Cycle to Work, car lease schemes, season ticket loan or membership options for onsite leisure facilities.
  
  

We are committed to equal opportunities and improving the working lives of our staff and will consider applications to work flexibly, part time or job share. Please talk to us at interview.
  
  

Environmental sustainability
  
Climate change and poor air quality is a health emergency that harms people’s health and wellbeing and widens health inequalities. The Trust is also committed to reducing its impact on the environment by reducing our greenhouse gas emissions to Net Zero by 2045\. All our employees have a role to play, and we have an active green network that supports staff to act in ways that ensures that our services are efficient, sustainable and reduce our impact on the environment www.imperial.nhs.uk/about\-us/our\-strategy/green\-plan .

jobs.title: Enterprise Sales Specialist
jobs.description:
Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.


**Role Summary**

We are seeking a high\-energy, driven **SMB/SME Channel Sales Specialist** to accelerate our presence across key business sectors. In this role, you will be the driving force behind identifying, enabling, and supporting our SMB/SME partners to unlock and close new business opportunities within **B2B, Government, Education, and Enterprise** sectors. You will leverage your industry expertise to build deep relationships with SMB/SME partner sales, presales, and procurement teams, positioning our innovative IT and cloud peripheral solutions to consistently meet and exceed quarterly and annual growth targets.  



  

**Your Contribution**

* **Pipeline \& Target Management:** Develop, manage, and mature a robust sales pipeline to consistently achieve quarterly and annual revenue targets.
* **Partner Relationship Management:** Build, nurture, and maintain long\-term, high\-value relationships with SMB/SME channel partners.
* **Collaborative Lead Generation:** Work hand\-in\-hand with partners to generate, track, and follow up on sales leads while maintaining comprehensive reporting back to the business.
* **New Business Development:** Actively identify, negotiate, and close net\-new business opportunities within the B2B, Government, Education, and Enterprise markets.
* **Product Strategy Execution:** Introduce and pitch new product categories to key partners, executing targeted sales strategies to expand our market share.

  

**Qualifications \& Skills**

* **Experience:** Minimum of **3\-5 years of experience** in a fast\-paced sales environment, ideally within the **IT or cloud peripherals sector** .
* **Track Record:** Proven history of meeting or exceeding assigned sales revenue targets.
* **Strategic \& Analytical Mindset:** Strong analytical and forecasting skills, with a demonstrated ability to develop and execute commercial business strategies.
* **Communication:** Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to deliver compelling presentations to diverse partner audiences.
* **Language:** Full fluency in English (both written and verbal).
* **Tools \& Marketing:** Functional knowledge of standard marketing tools to support channel enablement.
* **Interpersonal Skills:** Outstanding relationship\-building capabilities, a collaborative team player mindset, and a solution\-oriented, self\-driven work ethic.
* **Mobility:** Flexibility and willingness to travel interstate as required to support partners and close deals.

Our hybrid work model allows some employees to work remotely while others work on\-premises. Logitech supports a culture that encourages individuals to achieve good physical, financial, emotional, intellectual and social wellbeing so we all can create, achieve and enjoy more and support our families. We can’t wait to tell you more about them being that there are too many to list here and they vary based on location.
  

  

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, age, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability.
  

  

If you require an accommodation to complete any part of the application process, are limited in the ability, are unable to access or use this online application process and need an alternative method for applying, you may contact us toll free at \+1\-510\-713\-4866 for assistance and we will get back to you as soon as possible.

As a Principal Financial Reporting Accountant, you'll play a key role in ensuring our financial reporting is accurate, insightful, and supports effective decision\-making across the business. Working within our Financial Control \& Reporting team, you'll lead the production of performance reporting, forecasting, budgeting and regulatory submissions, while partnering with senior stakeholders across Finance and the wider business.


You'll be the trusted expert helping leaders understand what the numbers are saying today, and what they could mean tomorrow. Whether you're consolidating financial results, leading planning cycles, supporting regulatory reporting, or driving improvements in reporting processes, you'll have a genuine impact on how the business operates.


You'll join us on a salary starting from **£60,000 per annum**, with the potential for an annual bonus. This is a hybrid role ideally based in **\#London**, working from our Nova North office up to one day per week.


Beyond the day job, you'll gain exposure to senior leaders from the outset, work in a team that genuinely supports development, and can shape improvements across a fast\-moving, evolving business. If you're looking for a role where you can make your mark rather than simply produce reports, this could be the opportunity you've been waiting for.

**Who You Are**


We're looking for a Principal Financial Reporting Accountant who combines technical excellence with strong commercial awareness. You'll be a naturally curious finance professional who enjoys understanding what drives business performance and turning complex information into clear insights.


To be shortlisted, you need to offer:

* A full accounting qualification or working towards completion (ACA, ACCA or CIMA)
* Strong industry experience in financial accounting and reporting
* Experience producing and analysing Income Statements, Balance Sheets and Cash Flow Statements
* Proven experience of budgeting, forecasting and financial planning activities
* Advanced Excel skills and experience working with financial systems
* Experience presenting financial information and recommendations to senior stakeholders

**What You'll Be Doing**

* Leading monthly financial reporting and consolidation activities
* Producing performance packs and financial insights for senior leadership teams
* Managing forecasting, budgeting and planning cycles across the business
* Supporting regulatory reporting, audit requirements and corporate submissions
* Identifying and implementing improvements to reporting processes, controls and systems

**Pay, Benefits and Culture**


Alongside a starting salary from **£60,000 per annum**, potential for an annual bonus, and a market\-leading pension scheme, your package will include customisable benefits such as electric vehicle leasing, discounted gym membership, life assurance, tech vouchers, experience days, and more.


At EDF, we believe there are multiple definitions of what it means to succeed. That's why we offer you the freedom to develop a career that's unique to you. Here, Success is Personal. It's your journey, powered by us.


Everyone is welcome at EDF. We're committed to building a workforce that reflects the communities we serve and creating an inclusive environment where people can thrive. As a Disability Confident employer, we'll support applicants who need adjustments throughout the recruitment process.

**Join us and find your success at EDF.**

**\#SuccessIsPersonal \#EDFCareers \#LI\-Hybrid \#London**

  

  

Success is Personal. It's your journey, powered by us. Join us and drive the transition towards An Electric Britain.

jobs.title: Sales Support Administrator
jobs.description:
**Summary**
===========


Quilter plc is a leading wealth management business, helping to enable brighter financial futures for every generation.
  

  

Quilter oversees £157\.4 billion in customer investments (as of August 2026\). It has an adviser and customer offering spanning financial advice, investment platforms, multi\-asset investment solutions, and discretionary fund management. The business is comprised of two segments: Affluent and High Net Worth.  

  

Affluent encompasses the financial planning business, Quilter Financial Planning, the Quilter Investment Platform and Quilter Investors, the multi\-asset investment solutions business.
  

  

High Net Worth includes the discretionary fund management business, Quilter Cheviot, together with Quilter Cheviot Financial Planning – offering a highly personalised service to private clients, charities, trustees, and professional partners. Quilter Cheviot has presence throughout the UK, Ireland and Channel Islands.
  

  

At Quilter we never stand still. Our foundations are rooted in our extraordinary expertise, which is trusted by hundreds of thousands of customers, but we have great ambitions to stay one step ahead and make an even greater difference to the people and communities we serve, including our colleagues.
  

  

Our business is transforming, continually modernising, and becoming even more customer centric. So, if you want to be bold in the pursuit of your ambitions, bring new ideas, and challenge and evolve what we do, it’s the perfect time to join us!**About the Role**
==================


Level: 2


Department: Distribution \- Sales Support


Location: Southampton, United Kingdom


Contract Type: Fixed Term Contract / Secondment


Contract Length: 6 months


Regulated/Non\-Regulated: Non\-Regulated


You’ll work closely with multiple areas of the business, including Operations, Marketing, and Platform Specialists, while gaining insights into Quilter and how external stakeholders provide Financial Advice. Joining at an exciting time with the recent update to our flagship Wealth Select investment proposition and several propositional campaigns, you’ll have plenty to engage with as you support our Sales Consultants and Platform Specialists. Throughout this role, you will develop expertise in financial data analysis, platform navigation, regulatory compliance, and wealth management strategy, learning to analyse Excel\-based financial data, resolve transfer payment issues, ensure DGT quoting accuracy, and enhance competitor comparisons.


**Key Responsibilities**

* Act as primary support for Sales Support \& Sale Distribution via administrative and operational assistance
* Handle new business flows and platform transaction processes
* Serve as a key contact for adviser firms—resolving daily queries and ensuring seamless experiences
* Prioritize “right first time” service, consistently demonstrating care, professionalism, and attention to detail
* Produce management information reports to support WMCs and adviser firms in tracking business and retention
* Monitor adviser activity and flag new business and retention opportunities to WMCs
* Produce Discretionary Gift Trust (DGT) quotes on request
* Generate consultant\-facing reports: pipelines, high\-value quote tracking, and opportunity spotting
* Compile and present monthly advisor reports addressing misdirected payments and client issues
* Deliver competitor analysis of Quilter’s MPS portfolios using FE Analytics
* Manage Tactical Pricing Illustration (TPI) requests via FNZ with careful data validation
* Liaise with product support and consultants to ensure data quality and processing accuracy
* Compile and present monthly advisor reports addressing misdirected payments and client issues
* Deliver competitor analysis of Quilter’s MPS portfolios using FE Analytics
* Manage Technical Product Illustration (TPI) requests via FNZ with careful data validation
* Liaise with product support and consultants to ensure data quality and processing accuracy.
* Provide a comprehensive suite of professionally designed printed materials to elevate brand visibility, support sales initiatives, and communicate our value proposition effectively across various customer touchpoints.
* Ensure Continuing Professional Development (CPD) certificates are accurately and efficiently distributed to attending financial advisers following Quilter\-hosted external events.
* Support cross\-functional tasks aligned to your skill set when required

**About You**
=============


You’ll be a highly organised and proactive administrator who enjoys supporting others, working with data and delivering an excellent service. You’ll be comfortable managing multiple priorities, communicating with different stakeholders and taking ownership to ensure work is completed accurately and on time.

* Previous experience in an administrative, sales support, operations or customer service role, ideally within financial services, wealth management or a similarly regulated environment.
* Strong organisational and prioritisation skills, with the ability to manage varied requests, meet deadlines and maintain high standards in a busy environment.
* Excellent attention to detail and a right\-first\-time approach when checking data, producing reports, preparing quotes or processing requests.
* Confident written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build effective relationships with sales colleagues, adviser firms and internal teams.
* Good numerical and analytical skills, with experience interpreting information, identifying trends and producing accurate management information.
* Competence using Microsoft Excel and other digital systems; experience with financial platforms, reporting tools or FE Analytics would be advantageous.
* A proactive, practical approach to resolving queries and issues, knowing when to involve colleagues or escalate concerns.
* A collaborative and adaptable mindset, with a willingness to learn about Quilter’s products, processes and regulatory requirements and to support wider team priorities.
* A strong commitment to providing a professional, responsive and customer\-focused service.

**About IWG**


IWG is the world’s largest provider of flexible workspace, with more than **5,000 locations** across **120 \+ countries**. We bring together leading brands such as Regus, Spaces, HQ and Signature, as well as digital marketplace platforms such as Instant Offices, Easy Offices and Coworker. For over 35 years, we’ve enabled organisations of every size—from start\-ups and scale\-ups to 83% of the Fortune 500—to work more productively, flexibly and sustainably.


Our purpose is simple: help everyone have a great day at work—while protecting people and the planet. We offer carbon\-neutral workplaces worldwide and are progressing toward achieving **Net Zero emissions.**


In 2025, IWG delivered record system‑wide revenue of **$4\.5B** driven by rapid expansion of our capital‑light partnership model.This will continue in 2026 where we will have a target of over 1500 new centre deals as we accelerate towards our long\-term ambition of 30,000 centres world\-wide.


Join us\- www.iwgplc.com

  

**Job Purpose**


This person will manage relationships with our external partners to deliver our New Centre Openings (NCO) and refurbishment programmes on time, on budget and in line with our design standards.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Programme manage the end\-to\-end process of delivery in conjunction with our out\-sourced partners. Ensure there is clarity on expectations, deadlines and any issues or risks are escalated and dealt with in a timely manner
* Fully accountable for scope, programme and cost
* Ensure our partners manage the fit\-out so they are in line with our global design and build standards
* Plan and manage the refurbishment and maintenance of our existing estate, ensuring minimal disruption to customers and prioritising where we will maximise Return on Investment. Ensure Design and Build partners are utilised where appropriate and other contractors are effectively engaged where Design \& Build is not appropriate
* Effectively manage internal and external stakeholders so work is prioritised in line with business needs. Robustly manage supplier’s performance in line with contractual agreement whilst maintaining a positive relationship and ensuring suppliers remain engaged and committed to delivering our NCO and refurbishment objectives
* Utilise strong network of contacts so we partner with the right suppliers.

**Key measures of success are:**


* Successfully execute assigned projects within agreed costs, timeline and IWG specifications;
* Enhance the supply chain setup to meet the local market price, practice and standards;
* Provide training to new and existing vendors to ensure they fully understand IWG Design \& Construction guidelines while delivering NCO/refurbishment works.

**Required Skills, Experience \& Qualifications**


* Significant project / programme management experience gained in a fast\-paced environment such as Retail, Retail banking, Hotels or Professional consultancy.
* Used to managing multiple openings to demanding timescales and tight budget controls
* Proactive approach to problem solving and a customer first approach
* Highly commercial and results focussed \- significant experience of reducing cost whilst improving standardisation
* High drive with strong attention to detail. Can cope with a high degree of ambiguity, uncertainty and change
* Strong resilience with the ability to keep focussed on the big picture and end goal
* Previous experience of refurbishment and maintenance management is desirable
* Ability to positively influence multiple stakeholders across countries and cultures
* Experience in selecting and managing preferred partners for large Design and Build programmes through a competitive tender process would be advantageous

**What we can do for you**


You are reading the right advert if you are looking for:


* A fun, challenging, and rewarding career.
* Award\-winning induction training and excellent ongoing learning and development.
* Fantastic career progression opportunities.
* Access to a comprehensive selection of flexible, personalised workplace benefits that support your mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.

**Recruitment process**


Our recruitment process is transparent and objective, because we care about your experience with us. We will respond to you within a few days to let you know if you are moving to the interview stage. This usually starts with a 30\-minute conversation with our Global Recruitment Team, giving you the chance to learn more about us and the job. If we both feel there’s a good fit and connection, you will progress through one or two further stages, depending on the level of the position. IWG is proud to be recognised as a **Leading Employer,** every year since 2022\.

jobs.title: Principal Engineer - Substations
jobs.description:
**Base Location:** For this role, we require successful applicants to be based from one of our Scottish locations – Glasgow, Perth, Inverness or Aberdeen


**Salary:** £59,800 \- £89,800 \+ performance\-related bonus \+ a range of benefits to support your finances, wellbeing and family.


**Working Pattern:** Permanent \| Full Time \| Flexible First options available


**The role**



At SSEN Transmission, we are building a network for Net Zero \- one that's smarter, more flexible, and equipped to support the future of energy. Our mission is to deliver clean, reliable investment in the network that provides long\-lasting benefits for generations to come.



Our Network Engineering team sits within the Asset Management and Operations Directorate. We are responsible for ensuring that engineering activities across our Transmission projects and business areas are safe, technically sound and fully supported. We carry out Design and Technical Engineering Governance for the Transmission business, ensuring our network operates safely, reliably and in compliance with the relevant legislation.



As part of our journey, we are looking for a Principal Engineer \- Substations to join our specialist team. This is a key role where you will help shape technical policy, influence industry standards, and support the delivery of innovative, future\-ready projects across our high\-voltage transmission network.


**You will**


* Own and maintain technical specifications and guidance notes for substation designs, including substation earthing systems.
* Continuously improve existing specifications based on lessons learned and emerging technologies.
* Collaborate with other engineering disciplines, including Civil, LV/MV systems, Cables and Overhead Lines, while working closely with asset management and operations teams.
* Support the Design Authority and act as part of the Technical Authority, providing expert input into substation design reviews to ensure compliance with technical specifications and suitability for the transmission network.
* Represent SSEN Transmission at industry events and working groups, share best practice, offer technical consultancy across the business and mentor peers to support team development.


**You have**


* A degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline, with Chartered Engineer status or active progress towards it.
* Strong experience in the design, specification and application of transmission voltage substations.
* The ability to critically assess technical challenges and evaluate a range of solutions, with a solid understanding of the design, planning, operation and development requirements of the transmission network.
* Familiarity with SSE Transmission, National Grid, British and European Standards, and experience writing technical specifications, guidance notes or work instructions.
* Relevant exposure to the design, manufacturing, testing, installation or maintenance of transmission voltage plant and equipment, plus a passion for engineering excellence and helping shape the future of the UK’s transmission network.


**About SSE**



SSE’s purpose is to provide energy needed today while building a better world of energy for tomorrow. We do this by developing, building, operating and investing in electricity infrastructure and businesses needed in the energy transition. Our Transforming for Growth investment plan sees us investing £33bn in critical electricity infrastructure across the five years to 2030\.



SSEN Transmission own and operate the electricity transmission network across the north of Scotland. We transport energy from where it is generated to where it is needed, ensuring a safe and reliable electricity supply for the communities we serve. But that's not all – we're upgrading the grid to deliver cleaner, homegrown energy for the future and building a network for net zero to create secure power for generations to come.


**Flexible benefits to fit your life**



Enjoy discounts on private healthcare and gym memberships. Wellbeing benefits like a free online GP and 24/7 counselling service. Interest\-free loans on tech and transport season tickets, or a new bike with our Cycle to Work scheme. As well as generous family entitlements such as maternity and adoption pay, and paternity leave.


**Work with an equal opportunity employer**



SSE will make any reasonable adjustments you need to ensure that your application and experience with us is positive. please contact Andy on andrew.torrance@sse.com / 01738 275370 to discuss how we can support you.



We're dedicated to fostering an open and inclusive workplace where people from all backgrounds can thrive. We create equal opportunities for everyone to succeed and especially welcome applications from those who may not be well represented in our workforce or industry.


**Ready to apply?**



Start your online application using the Apply Now box on this page. We only accept applications made online. We'll be in touch after the closing date to let you know if we'll be taking your application further. If you're offered a role with SSE, you'll need to complete a criminality check and a credit check before you start work.

jobs.title: Control System Specialist
jobs.description:
Overview:

At PepsiCo, you’ll discover a place where our mission is to create smiles around the world. With a portfolio of more than 500 beloved brands including, Gatorade, Lay’s and Quaker, our work touches millions of people every day. At the heart of the company is a team of thinkers, creators, and problem\-solvers who collaborate to innovate and turn ideas into action. Driven by innovation and a focus on creating joyful moments through food and drinks, our decisions are guided by consumer centricity, creating opportunities for our associates to do meaningful work and make a lasting impact in the communities we serve. Whatever your role, you’ll be part of a global community that values your ideas and empowers you to make an impact, on your career and on the world around you.  

You will be leading the site requirements and procedures to maintain and develop the site’s SCADA, PLC and advanced control systems and infrastructures. You will be driving initiatives in improving the plant control systems and provide technical leadership for the Site technician group, ensuring all documentation, back up and emergency procedures are in place and regularly updated in line with Global CSS requirements. Managing control system integrators through capital projects design, build and execute phases to ensure that any projects are implemented in line with the Pepsico Standards.
Responsibilities:
* Managing the site\-based control system infrastructure and asset base to global PepsiCo controls standards.
* Understanding and adhering to the PepsiCo OT Cyber Security Playbook to maintaining required cybersecurity standards.
* Developing the technical requirements of the shift technician population to maintaining 24/7 production.
* Maintaining the site PLC and SCADA systems to ensuring availability, data integrity, and compliance with business standards and audits.
* Maintaining all network drawings and ensuring they are up to date.
* Ensuring system backups, recovery procedures, and risk assessments are in place and up to date, with plans to mitigating infrastructure risks.
* Managing and implementing support contracts, system upgrades, and software changes to maintaining system performance and delivering business requirements.
* Developing project\-related URS technical documentation for CAPEX projects requiring CSS interfaces.
* Managing the delivery of control system projects through appointed system integrators.
* Leading SAT and FAT activities on control system upgrades and new equipment.
* Identifying opportunities for improving control and production information, and generating action plans.
* Managing PLC and system obsolescence risks and contributing to the annual obsolescence programme.
* Managing hardware programmes to ensuring spare parts availability and coverage of critical assets.
* Developing, managing, and delivering the site software budget, including licensing requirements.
* Supporting frontline teams on technical breakdowns.
* Acting as the point of contact for site\-based IT support (i.e., Wi\-Fi upgrades, etc.).
* Improving capability of engineering team leaders and shift technicians on control systems.


Qualifications:
* Fully authorized and knowledgeable on electrical equipment and systems through qualifications and experience.
* Fundamental knowledge of electrical systems through qualifications and/or experience.
* Excellent fault\-finding and problem\-solving skills.
* At least 3 years’ experience in programming PLCs and microprocessor\-based control equipment for major projects.
* Good working knowledge of SCADA systems, PC programmes, and networks.
* Good knowledge of Wonderware systems and Safety PLC systems and applications.
* Skills in high\-level language programming.
* Understanding process and packaging technology.
* Able to training Control System Specialists and Shift Technicians in fault analysis, root cause analysis, and system recovery.
* Leading activities to improving asset reliability.
* Using CMMS systems, with experience in SAP preferred.

**Why Join Us?**  

We offer a competitive salary, bonus, flexible working, and a wide range of benefits—from critical illness cover and discounted gym memberships to enhanced parental leave and electric car schemes. Our commitment to wellbeing and career growth makes us a Top Employer for 14 years running.

**Equal Opportunities**  

We’re an equal opportunity employer, committed to the Equality Act 2010\. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and will provide any necessary adjustments to support you through the recruitment process.

**About PepsiCo**  

PepsiCo products are enjoyed by consumers more than one billion times a day in more than 200 countries and territories around the world. PepsiCo generated nearly $92 billion in net revenue in 2024, driven by a complementary beverage and convenient foods portfolio that includes Lay’s, Doritos, Cheetos, Gatorade, Pepsi\-Cola, Mountain Dew, Quaker, and SodaStream. PepsiCo’s product portfolio includes a wide range of enjoyable foods and beverages, including many iconic brands that generate more than $1 billion each in estimated annual retail sales.


Guiding PepsiCo is our vision to Be the Global Leader in Beverages and Convenient Foods by Winning with pep\+ (PepsiCo Positive). pep\+ is our strategic end\-to\-end transformation that puts sustainability and human capital at the centre of how we will create value and growth by operating within planetary boundaries and inspiring positive change for planet and people. For more information, visit www.pepsico.com, and follow on X (Twitter), Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn @PepsiCo.

**Base Location:** You'll be expected to spend 50% of your working week in one of the following locations Reading, Cardiff, Glasgow or Perth


**Salary:** £44,000 \- £65,900 \+ performance\-related bonus \+ a range of benefits to support your finances, wellbeing and family.


**Working Pattern:** Permanent\| Full Time \| Flexible First options available


**The role**



As an Engineer within the Engineering function, you will support the development and delivery of electrical distribution network designs across new\-build and existing infrastructure projects.



You will assist in the production, coordination and technical delivery of LV, HV and EHV (including 132kV) electrical network designs in compliance with relevant legislation, NERS requirements, ENA G81 standards, DNO/IDNO specifications and SSE engineering governance requirements.



You will work closely with internal engineering teams, delivery teams, clients, DNOs, IDNOs and external design partners to support the safe, compliant and efficient delivery of projects from early\-stage feasibility through to construction and final network adoption.



This role provides an excellent opportunity to develop technical capability within the growing Energy Customer Solutions and ICP market while contributing to innovative engineering solutions supporting the UK’s transition to net zero.


**You will**


* Support the development of LV, HV and EHV (including 132kV) electrical distribution network designs for contestable infrastructure projects.
* Assist in producing conceptual, outline and detailed electrical designs in line with NERS, ENA G81, BS standards and DNO/IDNO requirements.
* Support feasibility studies, route assessments and equipment selection activities.
* Assist with technical assessments including load flow, fault level, voltage drop and protection coordination studies.
* Support the integration of earthing, protection, metering and SCADA requirements where applicable.
* Ensure designs are developed in accordance with CDM, SHE requirements and industry legislation


**You have**


* Degree, HNC or equivalent qualification in Electrical Engineering would be highly advantageous.
* Working towards professional registration such as IEng or CEng is desirable.
* Experience or understanding of electrical distribution network design across LV and HV systems.
* Awareness of NERS, ENA G81, DNO/IDNO standards, CDM 2015 Regulations and UK engineering legislation.
* Understanding of electrical network design principles including protection, earthing and cable systems.
* Experience using engineering software and AutoCAD packages is desirable.


**About SSE**



SSE’s purpose is to provide energy needed today while building a better world of energy for tomorrow. We do this by developing, building, operating and investing in electricity infrastructure and businesses needed in the energy transition. Our Transforming for Growth investment plan sees us investing £33bn in critical electricity infrastructure across the five years to 2030\.


**Flexible benefits to fit your life**



Enjoy discounts on private healthcare and gym memberships. Wellbeing benefits like a free online GP and 24/7 counselling service. Interest\-free loans on tech and transport season tickets, or a new bike with our Cycle to Work scheme. As well as generous family entitlements such as maternity and adoption pay, and paternity leave.


**Work with an equal opportunity employer**



SSE will make any reasonable adjustments you need to ensure that your application and experience with us is positive. Please contact Zoe.Gillespie@sse.com to discuss how we can support you.



We're dedicated to fostering an open and inclusive workplace where people from all backgrounds can thrive. We create equal opportunities for everyone to succeed and especially welcome applications from those who may not be well represented in our workforce or industry.


**Ready to apply?**



Start your online application using the Apply Now box on this page. We only accept applications made online. We'll be in touch after the closing date to let you know if we'll be taking your application further. If you're offered a role with SSE, you'll need to complete a criminality check and a credit check before you start work.

**Contents**
------------

* Location
* About the job
* Benefits
* Things you need to know
* Apply and further information
**Location**
------------


Successful candidates may be based in any of our office locations  Cardiff, Glasgow, or London. We especially welcome applicants from Cardiff and Glasgow.**About the job**
-----------------

### **Job summary**


At the forefront of the fight to protect the integrity of Britains wholesale energy markets, Ofgem is helping combat market misconduct and ensure gas and electricity markets work effectively for consumers. Were looking for a Senior Analyst to join us and bring powerful analytical insight to some of the most complex issues affecting wholesale energy markets.  

  

Ofgem is Great Britains independent energy regulator. Were at the forefront of change across the energy sector, driving toward Net Zero whilst protecting energy consumers, especially vulnerable people.  

  

Were offering a permanent, full\-time role with the chance to work at the heart of wholesale market regulation and make a meaningful impact on how these vital markets operate. Youll join our Wholesale Market Conduct team, helping promote integrity and transparency across Britains gas and electricity markets. Working across a varied and complex landscape, youll contribute to evidence\-led regulation that ultimately delivers better outcomes for consumers.  

  

This is an exciting chance to combine your understanding of wholesale markets with advanced analytical expertise, working with unique and complex datasets covering trading activity and the physical characteristics of energy producers. Youll collaborate across Ofgem and engage with major organisations across the UK and European energy landscape, gaining significant exposure while helping strengthen our response to risks within wholesale markets.  

  

Were looking for someone with a strong understanding of wholesale energy markets or trading, combined with excellent analytical and quantitative capabilities and the ability to draw robust conclusions from complex evidence. Youll also bring experience navigating complex regulatory frameworks, excellent communication skills and the technical capabilities to work effectively with large datasets.  

  

Youll have the chance to apply your expertise to high\-profile issues that directly influence the integrity of Britains wholesale energy markets. Alongside this breadth and exposure, youll benefit from excellent Civil Service pension arrangements, generous annual leave and flexible working options designed to support a positive work\-life balance.  

  

We have a critical purpose to protect the integrity and transparency of Britains wholesale gas and electricity markets, so they work effectively for consumers. Join us and help combat market misconduct, strengthen confidence in the energy market and ensure robust evidence drives action where it matters most.  

  

Read on and find out more.### **Job description**

**Key responsibilities:**

* Leading on compliance or enforcement activity in relation to wholesale market conduct issues by producing high quality, timely, and robust analysis and reports and by engaging with market participants and market operators on conduct issues.
* Build capability in the team by improving the teams analytical tools and processes for proactive monitoring of large and complex wholesale transaction datasets for potential regulation breaches.
* Making evidence\-based recommendations: identifying and escalating key issues as well as assisting in the management of risk.
* Contributing to learning and development of colleagues, by mentoring and developing team learning materials.
* Collaborating across Ofgem teams and with external stakeholders on addressing wholesale markets risks and issues.

**Key Stakeholder Relationships \-** **Internal:**

* Wholesale Market Oversight and International portfolio, including the team providing insights on wholesale gas and electricity markets developments
* Wholesale market policy teams
* Legal teams


**External:**

* National Energy System Operator (NESO)
* Energy brokers and exchanges
* Electricity generators, gas shippers and wholesale market participants
* UK and EU institutional stakeholders such as DESNZ, the FCA, ACER and other National Regulatory Authorities (NRAs).
### **Person specification**

* **Sector knowledge: An understanding of the operation of wholesale energy markets and/or experience of trading (energy, commodities or equities etc). (LEAD CRITERIA)**
* **Excellent analytical and quantitative skills. Experience in analysing complex quantitative and qualitative data and evidence to arrive at conclusions and recommendations. (LEAD CRITERIA)**
* Experience of interpreting and applying complex legislation, regulation, rules and processes to deliver effective compliance or enforcement investigations.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills that effectively communicate complex issues to non\-expert audiences
* Experience using Python or SQL programming languages to manage large datasets and produce compelling analytical outputs.
### **Behaviours**


We'll assess you against these behaviours during the selection process:


* Changing and Improving
* Making Effective Decisions
* Communicating and Influencing
**Benefits**
------------


Alongside your salary of £49,452, OFGEM contributes £14,326 towards you being a member of the Civil Service Defined Benefit Pension scheme. Find out what benefits a Civil Service Pension provides .
Ofgem can offer you a comprehensive and competitive benefits package which includes; 30 days annual leave after 2 years; Excellent training and development opportunities; The opportunity to join the generous Civil Service pension which also includes a valuable range of benefits; hybrid working (currently 1 day a week in the office but this is kept under review), flexible working hours and family friendly policies. Plus lots of other benefits including clean and bright offices based centrally, engaged networks and teams and an opportunity to contribute to our ambitious and important targets of establishing a Net Zero energy system by 2050\. This exciting blend of professional challenge and personal reward identifies career opportunities at Ofgem as something to get excited about.**Things you need to know**
---------------------------

### **Artificial intelligence**


Artificial intelligence can be a useful tool to support your application, however, all examples and statements provided must be truthful, factually accurate and taken directly from your own experience. Where plagiarism has been identified (presenting the ideas and experiences of others, or generated by artificial intelligence, as your own) applications may be withdrawn and internal candidates may be subject to disciplinary action. Please see our candidate guidance for more information on appropriate and inappropriate use.### **Selection process details**


This vacancy is using Success Profiles , and will assess your Behaviours, Ability and Experience.
When you press the Apply now button, you will be directed to a Civil Service test  guidance for this can be found here Civil Service online tests \- GOV.UK (www.gov.uk)**The test you are due to take are not timed and you can complete it at your own pace**. Upon passing the tests, you will be asked to complete personal details (not seen by the sift panel), your career history and qualifications.


You will then be asked to provide a 1250 word personal statement evidencing how you meet the essential skills and capabilities listed in the role profile. Please ensure you demonstrate clearly, within your supporting statement, how you meet each of the criteria listed in the role profile.


The Civil Service values honesty and integrity and expects all candidates to abide by these principles. You must ensure that any evidence submitted as part of your application or used during interview, including your CV and any statements or examples, are truthful and factually accurate. Ofgem takes any incidences of cheating very seriously. Please ensure all examples provided are of your own experience. Any instances of plagiarism or other forms of cheating will be investigated and, if proven, the relevant applications will be withdrawn from the process. Please note that plagiarism can include presenting the ideas and experiences of others, or generated by artificial intelligence, as your own.


Please refer to Civil Service candidate advice on the acceptable use of artificial intelligence within the recruitment and selection process \- Artificial intelligence and recruitment , Civil Service Careers

Further details of how your information will be used by us and Cifas, and your data protection rights, can be found by \[ https://www.cifas.org.uk/fpn].

  

Feedback will only be provided if you attend an interview or assessment.### **Security**

* nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities with settled or pre\-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS)

Company Description  

  

Legal \& General (L\&G) is a leading UK financial services group and major global investor.


**We’ve been safeguarding people’s financial futures since 1836, and strive to build a better society, while improving the lives of our customers and creating value for shareholders.**


We are one of the world’s largest asset managers and provide powerful asset origination capabilities. Together, these underpin our retirement and protection solutions: we are an international player in pension risk transfer, in UK and US life insurance, and in UK workplace pensions and retirement income.


Our Group Functions provide the services that all areas of the business need. This requires a talented and diverse team behind the scenes, who enable everyone at L\&G to do what they do best.


Joining us means helping to improve the lives of our customers and contributing to the success of the business every day.

  

  

Job Description  

  

Join our centralised Transaction Reporting Team, where you’ll play a vital role in ensuring the accurate and timely reporting of trade and transaction data across a wide range of financial products. Working in a business‑critical environment, you’ll help us meet our regulatory obligations, strengthen our reporting controls, and contribute to continuous improvement across our processes. This is an excellent opportunity to build specialist expertise in a dynamic regulatory landscape while collaborating with teams across the organisation.


What you’ll be doing:


* Executing daily and periodic transaction reporting processes to support regulatory compliance
* Performing reconciliations and investigating discrepancies across reporting datasets
* Maintaining high standards of data quality through proactive oversight and robust controls
* Supporting business‑as‑usual reporting activities while identifying improvements to efficiency
* Escalating reporting issues, risks, and delays clearly and promptly
* Reviewing and enhancing procedures in line with regulatory and business changes
* Analysing regulatory updates to stay informed of industry and legislative developments
* Collaborating with internal teams and third parties to resolve reporting issues

Who we’re looking for:


* Strong attention to detail and the ability to work proactively and independently
* Good time‑management skills with the ability to prioritise effectively
* Strong PC skills, particularly Microsoft Excel, with confidence working with data
* Ability to follow structured processes while identifying issues and supporting resolution
* Clear and effective communication skills with a client‑focused approach
* Interest in regulatory reporting and developing expertise in this area
* Previous experience in financial services (desirable but not essential)
* Minimum GCSE grade C or above in Maths and English

Whatever your role, we reward performance and behaviour with a package that looks after all the things that are important to you. Here are some of the benefits we offer:
