Actual Salary £14,131 \- £14,355 per annum per annum (Grade 5\)


This job isfor 23 hours per week and 39 weeks per year.


It is offered on a Permanent basis


Approximate start date November 2026


The postholder will play an important role in supervising the activities of pupils during the teaching period and midday session break within the school, including both indoor and outdoor areas, ensuring a safe environment is maintained at all times.


To assist the Headteacher/SENDCo to promote students’ academic, social and emotional development through the development and implementation of programmes of student work and support (individual and group) and in the provision of a stable, caring and supportive learning environment; to enable students to achieve their full learning potential.


There may be a Special Needs input to support students with activities. Support is both on a one to one basis and in groups, for students with disability, learning difficulties or behavioural problems.

**Key responsibilities:**


To support teaching and learning processes.


? To assist the SENDCo in developing, implementing and managing individual/group student learning strategies aimed at:


a. supporting progress


b. establishing and maintaining relationships with individual students/groups to support with learning activities


c. inclusivity of students with identified SEND needs.

**Essential knowledge and skills:**

* 5 GCSEs including English and Maths (minimum level 4 or equivalent experience/ vocational
* qualification)
* Previous experience of working in an educational setting
* Experience in dealing with challenging behaviour whilst remaining calm
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills
* Demonstrate role model behaviour
* Fluency in English for all student and public\-facing roles, specifically to support students’ learning and wellbeing

**Working days/ patterns \-**We welcome flexible working as long as your availability falls within school hours, we are happy to discuss a schedule that works for you. Working patterns may be subject to change depending on business needs.


Please refer to the attached job description for more details about the role.


Interview date: Thursday 1st October or Friday 2nd October 2026

*Please Note: the actual salary shown is based on the number of hours and weeks worked and paid annual leave entitlement for an employee with under 5 years' service.*


If you have any further questions, please contact **Vicky Head** on **01202 112248** or by emailing **recruitment@corfehills.net**

**About our School**


Corfe Hills is an ambitious and high performing school where every student is known and supported to succeed. The school has been on a significant and ambitious improvement journey over the last four years as can be seen by our excellent outcomes. We are also delighted to share that following our recent Ofsted inspection in September 2021 we have been graded good in all categories.

*Living Here*


Corfe Hills School is in a fabulous location within easy reach of Bournemouth and its beaches, Poole and its harbour, the Jurassic Coast and the Dorset countryside.


The school serves the catchment area of Broadstone, Corfe Mullen and the wider area and we truly believe that all of our students are exceptional.

*Our Vision and Culture*


At Corfe Hills School we are passionate about excellence in learning. Our vision is underpinned by the Trust's values of Collaboration, Ambition and Respect.


We believe that this is the foundation which will enable our young people to achieve the highest possible outcomes during their time with us. We have the highest expectations of students – that they will engage fully in their learning, have high aspirations for themselves and embrace the wide range of opportunities available to them both inside and outside the classroom.


Our motto is “High Expectations – Exceptional Individuals” and we truly believe in the potential of every young person who joins the school. We also have an exceptionally committed staff, including talented teachers and a fabulous support staff who provide a range of functions including pastoral and administrative support to students.

*Teaching and Learning*


Teaching and Learning is at the heart of all that we do and our personalised professional development programme is centred around our Principles of Teaching that have been shaped by research from, among others, Barak Rosenshine, John Hattie and Doug Lemov. We also follow a lesson structure shaped around these principles that liberates and enables students to Learn to the Max every lesson. We are committed to regular developmental lesson visits and coaching conversations as part of our shared commitment to developing as practitioners.


For more information please visit our school website www.corfehills.net/


We welcome visits to our school \- if you would like to arrange a visit or require more information, please refer to the contact details above.

**Initio Learning Trust provides:**

* A supportive and welcoming environment with a genuine commitment to professional development.
* A flexible, equal opportunities workplace.
* Access to the local government or teachers pension scheme.
* Employee benefits including a Health Cash Plan and Cycle to Work scheme.


Initio Learning Trust comprises 17 schools across Dorset, with our head office based in Wimborne. Formed in February 2022 from the merger of The Minerva Learning Trust and Wimborne Academy Trust, we offer outstanding education through every stage of schooling, from nursery through to upper sixth form. We believe in enabling every person to thrive within their role, and our core values of Ambition, Collaboration and Respect underpin the pride we take in offering genuine professional development opportunities for all our staff; and in our focus on staff wellbeing.

jobs.title: Mobile Technical Operative - Electrical
jobs.description:
**Mobile Technical Operative \- Electrical**
--------------------------------------------


Offer ID: 90408
Job: Technicians / Electricity
Contract type: Permanent
Schedule: Full\-Time
Country: United Kingdom
**EQUANS are looking for a Mobile Technical Operative (Electrical) to work on our HMCTS contract across Redditch Magistrates and Worcester Combined Courts. This role would be a permanent full\-time role working 40 hours per week. On offer is a competitive salary and benefits package.**

  

**General Overview:**


Equans provide technical and soft services to our client HMCTS across a large portfolio of buildings across the UK. As part of the service, we provide low voltage electrical maintenance and installation services, and because of business growth, we are recruiting for additional roles to provide these services for our customer.

  

**Main Duties and Responsibilities:**


The primary purpose of the role is to carry out both planned and reactive maintenance on a wide variety of Fabric and limited Engineering Assets, ensuring all activities are completed in a safe and timely manner and in accordance with the contracted output specifications and Equans processes and procedures. Activities will include:


* Ensure that routine Planned Preventative Measures (PPM) is carried out to the electrical infrastructure and plant in accordance with Site task schedules and CAFM.


* Ensure that reactive tasks throughout the sites are completed and be proactive in highlighting areas where improvements can be made.


* Ensure that plant faults and defects are always swiftly remedied to maintain plant in serviceable order.


* Ensure that suitable spares are available to carry out both maintenance and reactive works.


* To provide parts lists and estimated timescales to carry out remedial works.


* Ensure that all relevant paperwork/CAFM is completed regarding PPM, reactive and breakdown works and that it is passed without delay to the contract administrator.


* Ensure that Method Statements and Risk Assessments are always prepared and used for all tasks undertaken to ensure safe working practices.


* To develop a good working relationship with all members of Equans staff, subcontractors and the client representatives.


* Ensure the provision of a Safe and Healthy working environment. To include the wearing of uniform and PPE at all times.


* Ensure up to date plant logs are kept at all times.


* Supervising and monitoring of sub\-contractors works whilst they are on site undertaking maintenance.


* Ensure an awareness and compliance to the contractual KPI's/SLA's.


* Ensure CAFM system, e.g. TotalMobile, is kept up to date and that PPM and reactive tickets are closed out with accurate data captured.


* To operate a Permit to Work System in accordance with Equans’ Technical and SHEQ processes and client requirements (or approved client system).


* To carry out any other task as directed by the account management team.


* Participate in the 24/7 maintenance cover (including on call rota) of the Building Engineering Services during normal and emergency activities, assisting in the preparation of emergency and contingency plans. Participate in emergency plans and provide written reports as required.


* The position will require you to provide engineering support in emergency situations to ensure business and operational continuity.


* To gain Technical Appointments as required e.g. LVCP/LVAP/HVAP and to issue PTW to Subcontractors and Equans staff


* Ensure both self\-delivered and subcontracted maintenance, testing and inspection activities are in compliance with the latest version of BS7671, ensuring that all remedials are carried out

  

**Client / Customer**


* Respond in a timely manner to verbal and written requests


* Coordinate quotations with the contract manager


* Production of information for quotations

  

**Helpdesk \- PPM**


* Support the Helpdesk as required when reporting or updating planned and reactive maintenance


* Be available for out of hours call\-out support for the contract

  

**Compliance**


* To gain Technical Appointments as required e.g. LVCP/LVAP/HVAP and to issue PTW to Subcontractors and Equan staff


* Ensure both self\-delivered and subcontracted maintenance, testing and inspection activities are in compliance with the latest version of BS7671, ensuring that all remedials are carried out


* Produce Condition / Dilapidation Reports as required


* Ensure supervisor is informed immediately if dangerous circumstances occur

  

**SHEQ**


* Comply with requests for information from SHEQ manager


* Ensure you work to company health and safety policy


* Ensue PPE is safe to use


* Report accident and near misses in a timely manner


* Ensure your test equipment is within calibration


* Ensure you follow Method Statements \& Risk Assessments for all work

  

**Impact:**


Working to high standard of Building Maintenance, we require a fully reliable and competent Electrician who can work on own initiative, within a team or oversee subcontractor’s, producing high quality reports on their findings and work. The role will involve being the face of Equans so smart appearance and being able to discuss findings with others including customers is required.

  

**Complexity:**


The successful candidate will have the ability to fault find and diagnose and rectify complex Electrical faults and issues unaided. Have an excellent knowledge of Electrical systems, which will enable the development of switching schedules and Safety Documentation prior to shutdowns. To plan and oversee electrical shutdowns to permit maintenance or testing.

  

**Qualifications or Required Experience:**


Suitable experience working in a similar high demanding role.

  

**Essential:**


* Hold relevant Electrical Qualification including; NVQ level 3 in Electrical or equivalent such as City \& Guilds Technical Certificate in Electrical.


* 18th Edition IET Wiring regulations


* Hold and maintain valid Clean UK Driving License


* Post holders must be able to pass and maintain BPSS


* Counter Terrorism Check CTC (applicable for specific sites at: Westminster Magistrates; Woolwich Crown; Royal Courts of Justice; Snaresbrook Crown; and The ‘Rolls’ Building)

  

**Desired but not essential:**


* IPAF


* PLASMA

  

**What can we offer you?**


On offer is a competitive salary and benefits package, which includes;


* 24 days annual leave


* Life Cover equivalent to 1\.5 times annual salary


* Employee discount shopping schemes on major brands and retailers


* Gym membership discounts


* Cycle to work scheme


* Holiday purchase scheme


* 2 corporate social responsibility days per year


* Broad range of learning opportunities, such as professional qualifications, collective/individual training, and personalized support programmes


* Attractive Employee Referral Rewards Scheme


* Access to our growing employee networks including WiE (Women in EQUANS), RISE (BAME), LGBTQI\+, Working Parents, YPN (Young Persons Network) and our Disability Network


* 24/7 Employee Assistance Program and access to mental wellbeing app

  

**Who are we?**


EQUANS is a world leader in energy services with nearly 100,000 employees working in more than 50 countries, with an annual turnover of over 17 billion euros.


In the UK \& Ireland, EQUANS is a provider of technical, FM, regeneration and energy services – with specialist capabilities in smart buildings, green mobility, district \& embedded energy and decentralised renewables.


EQUANS’ 13,500 UK \& Ireland employees combine these activities to help businesses, public sector organisations and government to embrace the energy transition towards net zero, and also the digital \& industrial transitions that are redesigning the way we move, work and live.


EQUANS is a Bouygues group company.


ENGENG

  

**What's next?**


If this role is of interest to you, please click below to register, apply, and track your progress! A member of our Resourcing Team will review your application and be in touch.


At Equans we’re committed to delivering a culture where everyone’s voice is heard and supported. We know the value a diverse workforce creates, delivering better results for our people, customers, and stakeholders. Diversity and inclusion is at the core of what we do, should you join Equans you’ll find a welcoming and open workplace where you’re supported and encouraged to be your true self at work. You’ll also have access to our growing employee networks including WiE (Women in Equans), RISE (BAME), LGBTQI\+, Working Parents, YPN (Young Professionals Network) and our Disability Network.


For this role, you must have evidence of the right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, we are not able to offer a re\-location package with this job role. Certain roles may require applicants to undergo a Disclosure check, as noted in the role requirements.


The EQUANS Resourcing Team supports this job advert. Agency involvement is not required. All related enquiries must come to the resourcing team not direct to EQUANS Managers

jobs.title: Family Law Solicitor (3+ PQE)
jobs.description:
##### **Job Description:**


##### **Duncan Lewis Solicitors (Ltd):**

  


Regulated by the Solicitor’s Regulation Authority, Duncan Lewis Solicitors was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in the City of London (Fenchurch Street EC3M), with offices nationwide. We are recognised by the Legal 500 and Chambers \& Partners UK independent legal directories as a top\-tier law firm in all of our key practice areas – “a diligent and professional team that is prepared to go the extra mile for its clients”. A paperless law firm with over 500 personnel that embraces hybrid\-working, we service both corporate entities and private individuals in over 25 areas of law across 60 languages. We give people a voice \- that is our ethos.

  


Recognised among The Times 200 Best Law Firms, we have been awarded Law Firm of the Year at the 2024 Lexis Nexis Awards and 2023 Modern Law Awards, reflecting our dedication to legal expertise and client service. We hold Investors in People Gold Standard accreditation for over 15 years, showcasing our commitment to professional development. Duncan Lewis is also Law Society Lexcel, Cyber Essentials Plus, and ISO 27001 certified, ensuring excellence in practice management and data security.

  


We are committed to recruiting dedicated and talented professionals and welcome applications from exceptional candidates. At Duncan Lewis, we value training and diversity, and we take pride in our inclusive workforce.

  


##### **Department Background:**


The Legal 500 independent legal directory applauds our Family legal team has “superbly reliable”, “professional, personable, and very efficient”. The department is ranked and recommended by The Legal 500 UK and Chambers \& Partners UK for family and matrimonial work, providing confidential advice with effective representation. Our family team includes solicitors who have achieved the Law Society’s Children Law and Family Law Advanced accreditations providing advocacy in all court proceedings, ensuring our clients receive a consistent and professional service as well as a high degree of continuity.

  


The Family department is experienced in assisting high net worth individuals in divorce matters with specialist divorce solicitors with expertise in domestic abuse, adoption, child abduction, prohibitive steps orders, specific issues orders, injunctions, spousal and child maintenance, properties, pensions and freezing injunctions.

  


##### **Main Responsibilities of the Role**


* Report directly to Department Director
* Responsible for all aspects of Family law work including providing technical expertise and guidance to other team members
* Ability to manage and supervise Solicitors, Trainee Solicitors and Caseworkers to manage appropriate caseload types and complexities
* Assisting with delivery of appropriate training and development in the department
* Variety of duties including dealing with a range of public and private Family / children cases including child abduction, child protection issues, special guardianship and adoption matters as well as undertaking your own advocacy
* You will have a professional pro\-active approach, strong client care skills and be interested in Business Development and Marketing to supplement the substantial work volumes brought in by the company

  

  

##### **Key Skills Required:**


* A minimum of 3 years' PQE in Family Law, with proven experience managing a varied caseload of public and/or private family law matters.
* Must hold a valid Practising Certificate and be registered with the Law Society of England and Wales at the time of application.
* Accredited Family Solicitor on the Family Law Panel (preferred). Children Panel Accreditation, Resolution membership, Abduction Panel accreditation, or other relevant Family Law accreditations would be advantageous, although a willingness to work towards accreditation would be highly desirable.
* Strong management skills
* Committed team player with ability to approach team concerns fairly, foster culture of positive change and encourage cross referrals
* Previous proven supervisory experience and working to key performance indicators
* Professional with a pro\-active approach; excellent client care skills and ability to deal with vulnerable clients and resolve complicated practicalities involved in child care issues
* Excellent networking and communication skills with the ability to successfully market the Company and generate new business
* Working knowledge of the publicly funded Family / Child Care work and have the ability to service privately funded cases
* Have extensive experience in dealing with all Family / Child\-Care work\-related work and some expertise on adoption matters
* Experience in own advocacy is an advantage
* Excellent IT Skills \-familiar with Microsoft Office applications and document management skills

##### **What we offer**


* A fantastic supportive team
* Strong career progression with support for legal awards and professional recognition

**SALARY STRUCTURE (Non\-Accredited) \- FAMILY LAW**
  

**SOLICITOR SALARY**
**(London)**

  

**(Outside London)**

  

  

NQ £42,500 £40,000

jobs.title: Head of Built Environment IPC
jobs.description:
We are seeking an exceptional and experienced Infection Prevention and Control (IPC) leader to join Imperial College Healthcare NHS Trust as our Head of Built Environment IPC.
  
  

This is a rare 24\-month fixed\-term opportunity to lead one of the most complex and high\-profile built environment IPC portfolios in the NHS.
  
  

Working closely with the Director and Deputy Director of Infection Prevention and Control, you will provide strategic leadership and expert oversight across a broad portfolio including healthcare redevelopment programmes, capital projects, water safety, ventilation, decontamination, environmental risk management and estates\-related infection prevention assurance.
  
  

As a senior member of the IPC leadership team, you will influence decision\-making at site, divisional, executive and Board level, ensuring infection prevention principles are embedded within service transformation, healthcare infrastructure and operational planning.
  
  

We are looking for a registered healthcare professional with substantial senior\-level IPC experience, strong leadership skills and a proven ability to manage complex risks, influence stakeholders and deliver improvement across organisational boundaries.
  
  

This is an exciting opportunity to shape the future of built environment IPC within one of the UK's leading academic health science centres while contributing to innovation, education, research and service excellence.
  
  

You will provide strategic leadership for the Trust\-wide built environment infection prevention and control portfolio, ensuring effective governance, assurance and risk management across healthcare infrastructure, redevelopment, water safety, ventilation, decontamination and environmental IPC programmes.
  
  

Working closely with senior clinical, operational, estates and facilities colleagues, you will ensure infection prevention requirements are embedded throughout capital developments, refurbishment projects, service reconfigurations and operational activities.
  
  

You will provide authoritative specialist advice, undertake complex risk assessments, oversee assurance arrangements and support the identification, mitigation and escalation of significant infection prevention risks.
  
  

The role includes leading the development of strategy, policy and assurance frameworks; contributing specialist expertise to incident and outbreak management where environmental factors are relevant; and supporting organisational improvement through audit, education, research and innovation.
  
  

You will represent the IPC service at senior internal and external forums and contribute to executive and Board\-level reporting and assurance processes.
  
  

You will provide professional leadership to staff within your portfolio, build effective partnerships across organisational boundaries and drive continuous improvement in infection prevention practice.
  
  

At Imperial College Healthcare you can achieve extraordinary things with extraordinary people, working with leading clinicians pushing boundaries in patient care.
  
  

Become part of a vibrant team living our values \- expert, kind, collaborative and aspirational. You’ll get an experience like no other and will fast forward your career. Benefits include career development, flexible working and wellbeing, staff recognition scheme. Make use of optional benefits including Cycle to Work, car lease schemes, season ticket loan or membership options for onsite leisure facilities.
  
  

We are committed to equal opportunities and improving the working lives of our staff and will consider applications to work flexibly, part time or job share. Please talk to us at interview.
  
  

Environmental sustainability
  
Climate change and poor air quality is a health emergency that harms people’s health and wellbeing and widens health inequalities. The Trust is also committed to reducing its impact on the environment by reducing our greenhouse gas emissions to Net Zero by 2045\. All our employees have a role to play, and we have an active green network that supports staff to act in ways that ensures that our services are efficient, sustainable and reduce our impact on the environment www.imperial.nhs.uk/about\-us/our\-strategy/green\-plan .

**About the role**

The department is well resourced and is made up of four teaching staff who work collaboratively to support student success. The ability to teach Computing at Key Stages 3 and 4 is essential. We are also looking for someone who is keen to develop their experience of teaching at Key Stage 5, with training and support provided. Experience of teaching BTEC IT and the ability to teach Computer Science at Key Stage 4 would be advantageous.


At Ballakermeen, we believe that every second of learning matters. We have high expectations of both students and staff, delivered within a warm, welcoming and supportive environment. Professional development is a priority, and all staff have access to a research\-informed Professional Development programme throughout the academic year.


Applications are welcomed from both Early Career Teachers (ECTs) and experienced teachers.

Candidates must hold Qualified Teacher Status (QTS) and meet the other essential criteria outlined in the Person Specification.**

**A workplace that invests in you**

Newly qualified teachers will automatically start on a generous salary of £42,718 per annum (spine point M4\).


A competitive salary that increases each 12 months until you reach the salary maximum.


Subject to meeting eligibility criteria, you will be offered two pensions arrangements: the Teachers Superannuation scheme or the Isle of Man Government Defined Contribution (DC) arrangement.

If you are an Early Career Teacher, you will receive payments of £2,000 at the beginning of your first and second school years in teaching, following the completion of the ECT induction period (2 years).


Financial support to get you, your family and your belongings, including one motor vehicle to the Isle of Man. We will pay 70% of any removal or storage costs incurred.

Access to the Learning, Education and Development training facility, which is exclusively for Public Service employees, to keep on top of your continuous professional development.

You may be eligible for a Blue Light Card, unlocking a wide range of exclusive discounts on shopping, food and leisure activities at hundreds of popular high street and online retailers.

You can visit our great cafes, bars and restaurants, and become part of the Island’s close\-knit community. The island is well connected to the UK with quick, direct flights and ferries to many destinations.


Want to find out more about Island life? Visit www.locate.im to find out why you should make your move to the Isle of Man!

**Working for the Isle of Man Public Service**


We are the largest employer on the island delivering a diverse range of services to the people of the Isle of Man. We care, nurture and value our employees’ wellbeing, development and career and place great importance on rewarding the commitment by our wonderful employees.


We support and promote flexible working, recognising the importance of working flexibly around your life and commitments and the benefits in improving work\-life balance. We are happy to discuss flexible working arrangements where possible and if interested you should discuss this with the Recruiting Manager.


The Isle of Man Public Service is committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates equality, diversity and inclusion. We understand how a wide range of views and experiences can benefit us as we work together for the Isle of Man.


Your candidate experience is important to us. As a proud member of The Circle Back Initiative, we commit to respond to every applicant that applies for an Isle of Man Public Service role.


We are committed to net zero by 2050 and as an entire nation UNESCO Biosphere Reserve, we are transforming public services for a sustainable future and your contributions will directly benefit our community, economy, and environment.


**Things to note**


An enhanced with barring police check is required for this post, the cost of which will be covered by the Isle of Man Government.

We understand that you might have some questions about the role and the Recruiting Manager is on hand to support you. You can contact them at BHSrecruitment2@sch.im.


To get the best out of your application, read our article on the important essentials you need to know before applying.


Applications will be accepted up to midnight of the closing date specified. If you have difficulties applying online, please contact us on 01624 685000 or by email at helpmeapply@gov.im.

jobs.title: Security Engineer II, Traffic Quality, Traffic Quality
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Advertising at Amazon is a fast\-growing, multi\-billion dollar business that spans across desktop, mobile and connected devices; encompasses ads on Amazon and a vast network of hundreds of thousands of third party publishers; and extends worldwide. Traffic Quality, within Amazon Advertising, builds technology to detect invalid traffic (IVT) and ensure that Advertiser spend worldwide is directed towards human audiences and protected from ad fraud.  

  

As the Security engineering team within Traffic Quality, we research programmatic advertising risk landscapes to build an understanding of existing and emergent threats. We build specialized techniques to detect and mitigate these threats, contributing to a robust Traffic Quality platform that is a bedrock of advertiser trust and saves hundreds of millions of dollars in ad spend that would otherwise be lost to IVT. The Security Engineering team is responsible for: (a) Targeted threat hunting, including on the dark web, to consistently stay updated on modus operandi and risks associated with advertising fraud, (b) Building sophisticated mitigation techniques through reverse engineering known software, identifying network layer signatures, and conceiving client\-side scripting methods, and, (c) Collaborating with security teams across Amazon for sharing intelligence and devising durable detection techniques.  

  

As a Security Engineer in the team, you are passionate about unraveling ad fraud tactics utilizing a diversity of highly specialized skills in reverse\-engineering, deep packet inspection of network traffic, understanding of network security, operating systems and browser architectures. You accomplish your tasks by applying expert level knowledge to tools to understand not only what a particular piece of malware for perpetrating ad fraud can do but also how it does it. You work with internal security teams to identify and mitigate botnets, as well as leverage the ethical hacking community to obtain standard modus operandi, source code and tactics used by malware and botnets. The role requires influencing leaders across the company to improve our security bar and protect advertiser trust. A Security Engineer also works with other product and security teams to proactively identify problems and suggest approaches to solve them.  

  

Given the high level of ambiguity in the advertising fraud space, and the need to prepare for unknown unknowns, your creativity, judgement and bias for action will all be key ingredients towards delivering the right results for advertising customers.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
* Knowledge of networking protocols such as HTTP, DNS and TCP/IP
* Experience programming in Python, Ruby, Go, Swift, Java, .Net, C\+\+ or similar object oriented language
* You have passion for reverse engineering, malware analysis, threat detection and risk hunting.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with AWS products and services
* Experience with any combination of the following: threat modeling, secure coding, identity management and authentication, software development, cryptography, system administration and network security

  

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy\_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.  

  

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

---------------

CP\&A is the Finance Single Threaded Leader for carbon intensity (CI) data integrity, reporting, and planning across WW Ops' \~45MM tCO2 annual footprint, directly supporting the WW Ops S\-team carbon intensity goal and Amazon's Climate Pledge commitment of net zero by 2040\. This role will maintain and improve the data structures underpinning EU/ROW carbon reporting and planning, partner cross\-functionally and cross\-country with regional sustainability and BI teams, and deep\-dive data quality challenges as they arise. The role sits at the intersection of Sustainability, Finance, and Operations \- a rare combination that gives the analyst exposure to carbon science, financial planning rigor, and operational decarbonization levers all in one seat, and offers a strong foundation for building differentiated expertise early in their career. The analyst will operate with oversight and mentorship from a senior CP\&A team member, with growing autonomy over time as regional carbon data fluency builds.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Support EU and ROW carbon month\-end close (MEC), ensuring carbon ledger (GCD) aligned data quality and timely resolution of carbonation and data quality issues.
* Maintain and continuously improve EU/ROW carbon reporting and planning data structures within data cluster and Carbon Reporting Deck.
* Partner cross\-functionally and cross\-country with EU and ROW regional sustainability, BI, and BU Finance teams to consolidate data requests, validate submissions, and resolve discrepancies.
* Support EU/ROW carbon planning cycles (OP1/3YF, OP2, Glidepath), ensuring carbon drivers (LMPP, 3P cost, WHT LoH, fleet electrification) are captured accurately and tie to the broader financial plan.
* Deep\-dive data quality and reporting challenges, identify root causes, and propose process or automation improvements.
* Contribute to CP\&A's transition toward an AI\-native reporting and planning model \- supporting GenAI\-powered variance commentary, automated data quality checks, and other tools that reduce manual reconciliation work.
* Assist in preparing variance commentary and metrics tables for leadership reporting (Kingpin, WWS reviews), under the guidance of a senior team member.
* Escalate data quality, timeline, or stakeholder risks promptly, partnering with the senior team member on resolution.
* Build subject\-matter expertise in carbon data systems and regional carbon drivers to grow scope over time.

  

A day in the life  

Your day starts with a check of data submission status and the latest carbon ledger (GCD) snapshot for EU and ROW, flagging any late, missing, or anomalous data before it becomes a downstream reporting issue. You'll join a call with an EU or ROW sustainability or BI counterpart to align on a carbon driver discrepancy or walk through a data request \- always leading with data lineage and methodology clarity, since regional teams often hold their own numbers. Back at your desk, you update Carbon Reporting Deck tabs for your regions, validate CI calculations, and dig into any variances that don't tie to plan. You sync with your senior team member to review findings, prioritize open items, and decide what needs escalation versus what you can resolve independently. Depending on the point in the month, your afternoon might involve supporting a planning cycle deliverable (OP1/3YF, OP2, Glidepath), pulling together inputs for a leadership review, or scoping a process improvement to reduce manual reconciliation work.  

  

About the team  

Carbon Planning \& Analysis sits within WW Operations Finance and was built from scratch in 2024 to bridge carbon science and financial planning across Amazon's largest and most complex emissions source. The team serves as the Finance Single Threaded Leader for carbon intensity reporting, planning, and data integrity across NA, EU, and ROW \- covering 10\+ business units and over 45MM tCO2 of annual operations\-wide emissions. CP\&A owns the monthly carbon month\-end close, the Carbon Reporting Deck (WW Ops' single source of truth for CI), and multi\-year carbon planning (OP1/3YF, OP2\), directly informing decisions at the VP and S\-team level in support of the Climate Pledge's net zero by 2040 commitment. It's a small, high\-visibility team that combines rigorous financial modeling with deep carbon domain expertise, and is actively building out AI\-native automation for data quality checks and variance commentary. This role will report to a senior CP\&A team member and work alongside peers covering NA carbon planning and reporting.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting or related field, or experience in relevant finance roles
* Speak, write, and read fluently in English
* Experience in forecasting, budgeting, variance analysis, and interpreting financial results
* Experience using financial models, KPIs, and data analysis to support business decisions

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience developing financial models in Excel with advanced functions (pivot tables, macros, VBA, Power Query)
* Experience with data analytics platforms (Power BI, Python, SQL, Tableau)

**About Us**
Planet is a leading technology company transforming payments by putting customer experience first. We offer integrated solutions that include payment processing, VAT refunds, dynamic currency conversion, and management services for merchants in the Retail and Hospitality sectors worldwide.


In recent years, we have experienced significant growth, expanding our services and global presence.


With strong private equity investors, Advent International and Eurazeo, we have the financial capital and expertise to grow our capabilities and reach through acquisitions.


Our mission is to create a world of connected commerce where payments are simple, secure, and seamless, enabling our partners to deliver exceptional experiences to their customers.

 **Role overview:**


Planet is scaling AI\-first engineering across its technology organisation, and the AI Enablement team is helping turn that ambition into day\-to\-day reality.


We are looking for **Senior AI Developer Experience Engineers** to join the team and help drive adoption across Engineering. This is a hands\-on role focused on AI Fluency, developer experience, internal enablement tooling, and measurable improvement across the software delivery lifecycle.


You will work closely with teams across Engineering, partnering directly with developers, QAs, product owners, scrum masters, business analysts, and managers to help them adopt better ways of working with AI. This is not a role from the sidelines. You will spend time with teams, understand where they struggle, coach them in practical contexts, and help embed better habits into real delivery work.


We are looking for people with strong engineering foundations who also bring a strong human touch. You should be someone who communicates clearly, builds trust easily, works well with different personalities, and knows how to bring people with you. Success in this role depends as much on credibility with engineers as it does on your ability to explain, facilitate, coach, and create momentum across the organisation.


You will help enable more than 300 engineers, alongside a broader set of SDLC roles, through structured AI Fluency sessions, hands\-on pairing, internal agents and workflows, reusable guidance, and support for priority initiatives. Over time, the role will also help drive adoption of broader platform and toolchain capabilities that improve engineering effectiveness across Planet.

 **What You'll Do:**

* Deliver AI Fluency sessions across Engineering and SDLC roles, from prompt engineering fundamentals to more advanced agentic coding workflows and practical AI\-first ways of working
* Work closely with teams across Engineering, building strong relationships, understanding where they struggle, and helping them adopt AI and better workflows in a practical, team\-friendly way
* Pair directly with developers and teams to improve adoption in real delivery work, helping them use tools such as GitHub Copilot, Copilot CLI, internal AI agents, workflow automations, and related capabilities effectively and responsibly.
* Help maintain and improve internal enablement tooling, including AI agents, automations, templates, prompts, workflows, and supporting assets used across the organisation.
* Create high\-quality enablement content, including guides, templates, examples, recorded sessions, best practices, and role\-specific learning material that teams can actually use.
* Assess and track AI maturity across teams using Planet’s AI Fluency model, helping identify where support is needed and where stronger patterns can be scaled.
* Support priority initiatives with dedicated AI\-first coaching, helping delivery teams apply better workflows, better prompting, and more effective use of internal tools in live projects.
* Collaborate closely with Architecture and Platform teams so enablement stays aligned with engineering standards, platform capabilities, system landscape, and the way Planet builds software.
* Capture adoption signals, usage insights, and learning feedback, and feed these into the AI Centre of Excellence and broader leadership reporting.
* Over time, help expand enablement beyond AI tooling into broader developer experience and platform adoption across the engineering toolchain.

 **Who you are:**

* Strong software engineering background, with experience building or maintaining production systems and a solid understanding of the full SDLC.
* Hands\-on experience with AI\-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Copilot CLI, Cursor, Cody, Claude Code, or similar.
* Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly, run hands\-on workshops, and adapt your style to different audiences across Engineering.
* Strong interpersonal skills and a genuine human touch. You build trust, work well with different personalities, and enjoy helping teams improve in a practical and collaborative way.
* Credibility with engineers. You are comfortable pairing with developers, discussing implementation trade\-offs, and helping teams improve how they work in practice.
* Experience creating strong technical content such as guides, tutorials, documentation, or internal learning material.
* A genuine interest in developer experience, engineering productivity, and helping teams adopt better ways of working.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Experience in developer experience, developer enablement, developer advocacy, or internal technical coaching.
* Understanding of enterprise engineering environments, including APIs, system design patterns, CI/CD, observability, infrastructure, and engineering governance.
* Strong understanding of prompt design, LLM capabilities, agentic workflows, and practical AI usage patterns in software engineering.
* Experience defining or tracking adoption metrics, maturity models, developer productivity indicators, or ROI\-oriented enablement measures.
* Experience with workflow automation and internal tooling, including platforms such as N8N or similar.
* Familiarity with fintech, payments, or regulated engineering environments.

**Tech Environment**


AI and enablement tools: GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Copilot CLI, internal AI agents, workflow automations


Engineering ecosystem: GitHub, Azure DevOps, Jira, Confluence, Terraform


Languages and stacks: Java, .NET, TypeScript, Python, and others across Planet teams

 **Why Planet**


Planet is an equal opportunity employer where diversity is valued, and all employment is decided based on qualifications, merit, and business need.


Come and grow your career in the most exciting, fast\-paced technology market, with a business that delivers feel\-good connected commerce.


We would love to hear from you. Apply now.


At Planet, we embrace a hybrid work model, with three days a week in the office.

  

Reasonable accommodations may be made in order to allow for an individual to perform the essential functions of this role successfully.


  
### **About Us**

**Company Background**


Planet provides integrated software, payment and technology solutions for its customers in the Hospitality and Retail sectors and worldwide via a network of global Financial Services Partners.


Founded over 35 years ago, we have evolved our services, delivering an innovative digital commerce platform that puts customer experience first.


With headquarters in London and around 3,000 expert employees located across six continents we serve customers in over 120 markets.

jobs.title: Full Stack Product Engineer
jobs.description:
Nordic Investin is recruiting a Full Stack Product Engineer on behalf of one of our partner companies. You like owning a problem from the first user conversation to the production metric that proves the solution works.
  
The partner is building a digital product in a small cross functional team. You will move between frontend, backend and data concerns, choosing the simplest approach that delivers a strong experience without creating tomorrow’s bottleneck.
  
The environment will suit someone who enjoys building systems, testing assumptions in code and taking responsibility for production behaviour. Technical choices are expected to be explained in terms of maintainability, reliability and the people who use the product.
  
How you will work
  
You will work in short delivery cycles with direct access to product, domain and operational colleagues. The partner expects engineers to review designs, test assumptions early and follow important changes into production. Decisions should be recorded clearly enough that another engineer can understand the tradeoff months later.
  
You will receive meaningful ownership while working with senior colleagues on the most consequential decisions. The partner expects you to deliver independently within a clear area, ask for context early and contribute ideas grounded in what you observe. There is room to deepen your specialism or broaden toward adjacent responsibilities.
  
What you will do
  
Build customer facing features across TypeScript frontend and backend services.
  
  

Work with product and design to clarify user problems before coding.
  
  

Create APIs, data models and integrations that support rapid iteration.
  
  

Instrument features and use real behaviour to guide improvement.
  
  

Strengthen tests, deployment automation and production diagnostics.
  
  

Take part in discovery, planning, delivery and support.
  
  

What you will bring
  
Three to six years of full stack product development.
  
  

Solid TypeScript and experience with React or a similar framework.
  
  

Backend experience with Node.js, Python, Java or NET.
  
  

Working knowledge of SQL, APIs and cloud deployment.
  
  

Practical testing habits and ownership of production outcomes.
  
  

Clear English and a collaborative working style.
  
  

Experience that would add value
  
Experience in an early stage or fast moving product team.
  
  

Feature experimentation and product analytics.
  
  

Interest in AI enabled product capabilities.
  
  

A background that can succeed here
  
You may have started in frontend, backend or product design and deliberately broadened your range. We are looking for good judgement, curiosity and the ability to finish valuable work, not shallow familiarity with every tool.
  
What makes the opportunity interesting
  
You will see the direct connection between your code and the user experience. The partner offers a compact decision path, meaningful product influence and experienced colleagues who value thoughtful speed.
  
The exact partner, employment model, compensation, start date and working arrangement will be explained openly during the process. Nordic Investin will make sure you understand the context, expectations and decision path before you are asked to commit significant time.
  
The recruitment conversation
  
During the process, Nordic Investin will focus on concrete decisions you have made: the context you received, the alternatives you considered, the result you observed and what you would change today. You do not need every optional technology if your core experience transfers and you can explain how you would close the gap.
  
How to apply
  
Apply with your CV or LinkedIn profile and a short note describing the most relevant system, product or transformation you have helped deliver. Nordic Investin welcomes candidates with different routes into technology and assesses applicants on relevant capability, judgement and potential.

jobs.title: Digital Development Specialist
jobs.description:
Digital Customer Offering (DCO) is a business function within Fortum Consumer Solutions, where business and technology come together. At DCO, we create superior digital offerings and experiences for our 2,4 million consumer and enterprise customers. We innovate and find new ways to digitalize our offerings and processes. We collaborate closely with our stakeholders and external partners. Through cross\-functional collaboration, agility and sustainability focus, we strive to make our customers’ increasingly digital lives easier with our services. We serve clients in the Nordics as well as Poland and Spain.

  

**About the role**


We are looking for talented and passionate individuals to join our Enterprise Online team. This role involves capturing user and business needs and translating these into initiatives that maximize customer value and ensure a world\-class user experience for our Nordic customer base. United by our passion for technology, curiosity about user experience, and dedication to excellence, we are looking for someone who shares our enthusiasm!

  

Your responsibilities will be:


* Bridge the gap between business needs and technical solutions by gathering, analyzing, and documenting detailed business requirements, ensuring that digital offerings meet customer needs and align with Fortum's strategic objectives.
* Develop use cases, user stories, and use planning tools such as Jira and Miro to follow up and support development.
* Define, manage and communicate the Product backlog to stakeholders and team.
* Prioritize and ensure that work is being conducted according to plan and set goals and support in solving blockers.
* Manage multiple projects and adjust priorities based on changing business needs.
* Solve complex problems requiring an understanding of both business and technical aspects.
* Collaborate with team members to foster a customer\-centric approach.
* You will be part of the Enterprise Online team, focusing on developing and improving services for our enterprise customers. We work within an Agile approach, taking end\-to\-end responsibility for our area. Our team, consisting of 15 experts with diverse competencies, has a great atmosphere where we work hard and have fun. We offer a dynamic work environment where you can grow your skills and make an impact on Fortum’s business and customers.

  

This position can be located in our office in Espoo, Solna or Oslo.

  

**About you**


To succeed and thrive in this role, we see that you have:


* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Minimum 2\-4 years of experience in digital development or a similar role.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills.
* Proficiency with requirements management tools and familiarity with Agile methodologies.
* Previous experience from the energy industry is beneficial.
* Be fully fluent in English, both spoken and written.

  

**We offer you**
  

At Fortum, we believe in a better future and want to be involved in shaping it. Our workplace is a safe place, both physically and mentally. You will grow with professional colleagues, being trusted and free to challenge yourself. We offer comprehensive benefits, flexible working hours, and hybrid work model to support your productivity, development and wellbeing. We are committed to build diverse teams where everyone feels included and is treated equally.


More information about our culture and benefits can be found here.

  

**Interested?**


Submit your application by **01\.10\.2026** at the latest. We will begin actively screening during the application period and hire as soon as the right candidate is found. We will not consider applications outside our recruiting system. If you would like to hear more about the position, please contact hiring manager Thale Fritzner by email thale.christina.fritzner@fortum.com.
  

For Swedish candidates: contact details to union representatives can be found on the bottom of **this page****.**

  

**We are Fortum**
  

Fortum is a Nordic energy company. We generate and deliver reliable energy to our customers and the Nordic energy system while at the same time helping industries decarbonise their processes and grow. Our core operations comprise efficient and best\-in\-class low\-carbon power generation, customer services, and heating and cooling. Fortum’s power generation is already 99% from renewable or nuclear sources with one of the lowest specific CO2\-emissions in Europe. We are guided by our ambitious SBTi\-validated
  

emission reduction targets on our way towards net\-zero by 2040\. For our \~4,500 employees, we commit to be a safe and inspiring workplace. Fortum's share is listed on Nasdaq Helsinki. fortum.com

jobs.title: Security Manager
jobs.description:
Do you want to contribute to protecting critical infrastructure and supporting the secure operation of one of the Nordic region's leading energy companies? We are looking for a Security Manager to join our Security team in Sweden. In this role, you will help ensure that security risks are managed effectively while supporting compliance with important security regulations and requirements.  

**About the role**
As a Security Manager, you will play an important role in strengthening Fortum's security capabilities and ensuring that security\-related work is carried out in line with business objectives, internal requirements, and relevant legislation.  

You will take independent responsibility for one or more security areas, such as:
* Physical security
* Personnel security
* Information security
* Supplier security

  

You will develop, implement and maintain methods, processes and routines within your areas of responsibility. The role requires a structured and proactive approach, as well as the ability to manage complex matters and make sound decisions independently.  

You will work closely with a wide range of stakeholders across the business, support functions and external authorities. In addition, you will provide guidance and training within your areas of expertise to help strengthen security awareness and compliance throughout the organisation.  

We offer a hybrid work model to support your productivity; you are expected to be at the office two to three times a week.  

The position is based at our office in Solna, Stockholm.  

**About you**
To succeed in this role, you bring a combination of security knowledge, strong judgement and the ability to work independently in a complex environment.  

We are looking for someone who has:
* A relevant university degree in law, technology, security or a related field
* At least two years of experience working within one or more security disciplines
* The ability to communicate effectively in both Swedish and English, verbally and in writing
* A systematic and structured way of working

 **Key Responsibilities:**

* Engineer Detection\-as\-Code: Write detection logic using KQL, SPL, SQL, and Python. Manage the lifecycle strictly through version control and CI/CD pipelines. Create new monitoring use cases based on red team exercises, CTIC reports, and your own hypothesis\-driven threat research.

* Leverage Hybrid Data Ecosystems: Develop detection and automation use cases across a variety of different data architectures (SIEM, data lakes, S3/Storage blobs, Federated Search).
* Mitigate Security Gaps: Mitigate detection and response gaps through the creation of new detection rules, improvement of processes, new architectural designs, and hand\-over to other technical teams.
* Enforce Pipeline Quality: Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines with automated validation gates for secure content deployment. Use breach attack simulation \& threat intelligence verification where applicable in larger validation workflows.
**Required Skills \& Qualifications:**

* Collaboration \& Articulation: Problem\-solving mindset with the ability to bridge the gap between engineering and SOC operations effectively. Able to convey targeted messages to different audiences.

* Engineering Mindset: Proficiency in Python or PowerShell, software engineering best practices, APIs, and data structures (JSON/YAML).
* Query Mastery \& Scripting: Deep proficiency in security query languages (Splunk SPL, KQL, SQL) and Python/TypeScript.
* GitOps \& CI/CD: Hands\-on experience with Git and CI/CD platforms for managing infrastructure and logic as code.
* Security Tooling: Technical experience configuring and administering enterprise security controls (XDR/EDR/NDR, Firewalls, Cloud Security, DLP, Identity).
* Active Defense: Deep expertise in adversary tactics and techniques to position deceptive assets along realistic attack paths without impacting production.

 **Good\-to\-Have Skills:**

* Data Modeling: Familiarity with Graph Databases (Neo4j, Cosmos DB Gremlin) and entity relationship modeling.
* Applied AI: Experience integrating LLMs or building RAG pipelines for enterprise use cases.
* Containerization \& IaC: Experience with Docker, API Gateways, and Infrastructure\-as\-Code (Terraform/Bicep).

Er du klar til å bli en sentral role hos Norges raskest voksende Shopify byrå?


Scandicommerce er et Shopify Plus Partner\-byrå i sterk vekst. Vi har allerede tredoblet resultatene fra i fjor, og ligger an til å femdoble dem. Vi jobber med noen av Norges mest spennende og ledende varemerker, og vi er blant de mest aktive aktørene i det norske ehandelsmiljøet, både på scenen, i partnernettverkene og i konkrete leveranser hos kundene.


Nå ser vi etter en Senior E\-commerce Rådgiver som kan Shopify inn og ut, og som vil være med på å forme løsningene til ambisiøse nettbutikker sammen med oss.


Du blir vår CTOs nærmeste sparringspartner. I dag eier han løsningsarkitekturen og prosjektansvaret på flere av våre største kundeleveranser, din jobb blir å ta over stadig mer av dette, slik at vi kan fortsette å vokse og levere kvaliteten våre kunder forventer!


**Hva du skal gjøre**
* Utforme løsninger sammen med vår CTO ut mot kunder \- fra behovsavklaring og løsningsarkitektur til leveranse
* Ta kunde og prosjektansvar: eie dialogen, fremdriften og resultatet
* Jobbe hands\-on med integrasjoner og arbeidsflyter mellom Shopify og ERP/OMS
* Koordinere utviklingsteamet og sikre at leveransene treffer på scope og kvalitet
* Jobbe tett med partnerne våre for å finne den beste løsningen for hver kunde \- ikke den enkleste for oss

**Hvem vi ser etter** **Må ha:**
* Solid Shopify\-erfaring \- du kjenner plattformen inn og ut
* Erfaring med integrasjoner og arbeidsflyter mellom netthandel og ERP\-systemer \- for eksempel Microsoft (Business Central), Visma, Unimicro, Finago eller Odoo
* Erfaring med KI\-verktøy og agenter i praktisk arbeid \- hos oss er KI en naturlig del av både leveransene og hverdagen, fra agentbaserte arbeidsflyter til agentic commerce
* Forstår API\-er \- du kan lese API\-dokumentasjon, forstå datamodeller og designe integrasjonsflyter mellom systemer
* Kommersiell teft og trygghet i kundedialog \- du forstår hva som skaper verdi
* Evne til å eie ting ende\-til\-ende og levere i tempoet til et selskap i vekst

**Stort pluss:**
* Erfaring med Omnium
* God forståelse for det norske ehandelsøkosystemet (Vipps, Bring, norske ERP\-landskap)
* Erfaring med Make.com eller tilsvarende automatisering
* En stemme i bransjen, du skriver, snakker eller blir oppsøkt for råd
* Forståelse av API og UCP
* Kan lede utviklere

**Hvorfor scandicommerce**
* Du kommer inn i et selskap i kraftig vekst med reelle muligheter til å påvirke retningen
* Fastprismodell som gir tydelighet på scope, ikke timeregistrering og fakturajag
* Varierte prosjekter for ledende varemerker, ingen to prosjekter er like
* Full\-stack leveranser: Shopify Plus, ERP, OMS, POS og integrasjoner
* Vi bygger egne produkter og verktøy \- inkludert KI\-drevne løsninger som effektiviserer både våre egne og kundenes arbeidsflyter
* Konkurransedyktige betingelser og fleksibel arbeidshverdag
* Aksjonæravtale for riktig kandidat
* Kontor på Skøyen (Drammensveien 167\) med kantineavtale
* Sertifiseringer, kurs og bransjearrangementer
* Et lite, direkte og faglig sterkt team med lav byråkrati og høyt tempo

**Slik søker du**
Dropp søknadsbrevet. Send oss CV\-en din sammen med korte svar på tre spørsmål:


* Hva er det med denne rollen og scandicommerce som gjør at du vurderer å ta steget?
* Hva er det beste eksempelet du har på et e\-commerce\-prosjekt du har eid eller bygget \- hva var problemet, hva gjorde du, og hva ble resultatet?
* Hvordan jobber du best \- med kunder, med team, og når du eier ting alene?
Vi vurderer søknader fortløpende og gir beskjed etter hvert steg i prosessen \- ingen ghosting.


Kontakt: christian@scandicommerce.no · \+47 333 94 000



**Om bedriften**
----------------


Scandicommerce er et norsk Shopify Plus Partner\-byrå med kontorer på Skøyen i Oslo og i Tønsberg. Vi ble grunnlagt i 2024 av to erfarne e\-handelsprofiler med bakgrunn fra både plattform og konsulentsiden, med ett tydelig mål: å utfordre måten e\-handelskonsulenter jobber på.


Der bransjen tradisjonelt selger timer, leverer vi til fastpris. Det gir kundene våre forutsigbarhet og oss et sterkt insentiv til å bygge smart, gjenbrukbart og effektivt. Modellen fungerer: Vi har allerede tredoblet resultatene fra i fjor og ligger an til å femdoble dem.


Vi leverer hele verdikjeden i moderne netthandel, Shopify Plus, integrasjoner mot norske ERP\-systemer (Visma.net, Business Central, Finago), ordrehåndtering med Omnium, og fysisk handel gjennom vår egen POS\-løsning bygget for norske compliance\-krav. Vi har partnerskap med aktører som Shopify, Vipps MobilePay og Nets/Nexi, og bygger egne KI\-drevne produkter som effektiviserer både våre og kundenes arbeidsflyter.


Kundene våre er ambisiøse norske og nordiske merkevarer i vekst \- fra etablerte retailkjeder til raskt voksende D2C\-merker. Vi er svært aktive i det norske ehandelsmiljøet, blant annet som hovedsponsor av Virke Arena Handelskonferansen 2026 sammen med Shopify.


Vi er et lite, faglig sterkt team med lav byråkrati, høyt tempo og en kultur der praktikere og rådgivere jobber side om side. Hos oss får du reell påvirkning på et selskap i kraftig vekst.

**WHAT MAKES US, US**

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp !


At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success\-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people\-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.


If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!  



**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US**

You will be joining an innovative application development team within SimCorp's Product Division. We provide a cloud native SaaS product buil t on Azure using modern development principles, technologies and practices.


The product, Digital Engagement Platform (DEP) has been operational for over 5 years and based o n client feedback and our own experience we have begun to lift the product to the next level, modernizing architecture and tech stack so we can scale DEP for a much larger audience than we can today.


This is why we need you \- to help test and ensure the quality assurance of the new DEP 2\.0 that we are build ing that can support the biggest clients, asset managers, across the globe.


The future success of our SaaS hinges on the ongoing enhancement of the application and the refinement of associated processes and tools. QA will continue be a vital element of this journey. While we have achieved remarkable milestones, there are still challenges to conquer.


Your contribution to the robustness of the DEP will be pivotal as we continually onboard new clients , ensuring high performance, top\- notch security, and exceptional user experience for a diverse clientele .  



**What you will** **be responsible for**

As part of your role, you will collaborate with three agile development teams, each consisting of approximately 5\-7 members. Your daily tasks will involve understanding and questioning customer requirements, discussing solutions, implementing automated tests for chosen solutions, some manual testing and providing support. The tools you will use are centered around .NET, Data Build Tool ( d bt ), TypeScript , and Microsoft Azure.

jobs.title: Head of Finance and Strategy, Pre-IPO Readiness
jobs.description:
About ScaleUp.SG
  
  

ScaleUp is a PE\-backed, institutionally backed financial platformbuilding a category\-defining alpha generation yield business powered byregime\-aware AI. The company has processed $3\.2bn\+ for 50\+ blue\-chipclients(including global fintechs, listcos) and is now entering the next phaseof growth, with a focus on application of PCAOB/IFRS reporting, audit readiness andIPO\-quality financial reporting.
  
  

The Role
  
  

ScaleUp is hiring a senior finance leader to own thereporting and execution workstreams for its
  
  

restructuring and proposed IPO
  
  

**.The mandate:** define the reporting perimeter, build audit\-ready historical andpro forma financials, lead the
  
  

statutory audit process
  
  

, and position thecompany for institutional investors and capital markets.
  
  

We need a builder—someone who can structure, document,defend, and deliver a workable reporting solution in a complex multi\-entityenvironment. This is not a role for someone who only flags risk; it is forsomeone who architects the solution and gets it across the line with auditors,the Sponsor, and regulators.
  
  

What You Will Do
  
  

Lead the
  
  

statutory audit process
  
  

– work with the Reporting Accountants on
  
  

ASC606/IFRS 15
  
  

(revenue recognition of the technology licensing royalty, sales\-based royalty exception, minimum royalty floor)
  
  

Define the reporting perimeter – prepare standalone, pro forma, and consolidated financials across regional entities
  
  

Draft and defend technical accounting memos – including
  
  

royalty revenue recognition, transfer pricing, and ASC 810/ IFRS 10 consolidation analysis of the Big\-4 audited JV
  
  

Prepare audit\-ready documentation – basis\-of\-preparation papers, reconciliations, supporting schedules for financing scenarios
  
  

Own transfer pricing benchmarking –
  
  

royalty rate under the Technology Licensing Agreement and the interim fee\-sharing arrangement
  
  

, and related\-party transaction documentation
  
  

Build pro forma financials for the post\-reorganisation structure
  
  

Strengthen reporting processes – controls, close discipline, and finance governance across a scaling multi\-entity platform
  
  

Coordinate across finance, legal, tax, and management – keep restructuring and reporting workstreams aligned
  
  

What We Are Looking For (Ordered by Importance)
  
  

Corporate finance and deal experience
  
  

– 8–15\+ years in investment banking, corporate finance, Big 4 transaction advisory, or senior finance roles in high\-growth, multi\-entity organizations; proven ability to structure and execute complex transactions from a financial and reporting perspective
  
  

IPO and capital markets expertise
  
  

– direct experience preparing companies for public listing, including drafting offer documents (
  
  

exchange experience strongly preferred
  
  

; HKEX or SEC experience also relevant), managing regulator comment processes, and building the financial infrastructure for public company readiness
  
  

Commercial and strategic mindset
  
  

– ability to translate financial data into investor\-grade narratives, support fundraising and M\&A activities, and partner with management to drive valuation and growth outcomes
  
  

Technical accounting authority
  
  

– deep understanding of
  
  

ASC 606 / IFRS 15
  
  

, with hands\-on experience in
  
  

royalty revenue recognition, the sales\-based royalty exception, and the minimum royalty floor
  
  

; ability to draft and defend technical memos for the Reporting Accountants and Sponsor
  
  

Restructuring and spin\-off execution
  
  

– proven track record in designing reporting perimeters, preparing
  
  

statutory entity and pro forma financials
  
  

, and managing the accounting and tax implications of complex reorganisations
  
  

Cross\-functional leadership
  
  

– comfortable working directly with founders, investors, legal counsel, tax advisers, and auditors in a fast\-moving, high\-stakes environment
  
  

Builder mindset
  
  

– able to create first\-time reporting frameworks, allocation methodologies, and audit support from incomplete starting points; more builder than risk\-focused controller
  
  

Industry experience
  
  

– fintech, asset management, wealthtech, treasury, or other regulated, multi\-entity business models is highly relevant
  
  

To Apply
  
  

Please send your CV and a short note highlighting relevantexperience in
  
  

spin\-offs, restructurings, audit readiness, US or regional IPO preparation
  
  

, or other complex reporting assignments.
  
  

𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗪𝗲 𝗗𝗼
  
  

ScaleUp is an AI\-powered platform that generates alpha on institutional idle cash by dynamically allocating across branded money market funds and low\-risk alternatives — Goldman Sachs, BlackRock, JPMorgan etc — on a custody\-free, performance\-only basis. Clients never lose access to their capital; we only earn a fee on the yield we generate above their benchmark.
  
  

𝗪𝗵𝘆 𝗪𝗲'𝗿𝗲 𝗗𝗶𝗳𝗳𝗲𝗿𝗲𝗻𝘁
  
  

Most wealthtech picks products. ScaleUp generate alpha— because Brinson proved 91% of portfolio return is driven by allocation policy, not selection. We earn only on yield delivered above the client's quoted net target. If we don't outperform, we don't earn more. That's structurally different from every AUM fee and fixed SaaS subscription in the market.
  
  

**📈 𝗣𝗿𝗼𝘃𝗲𝗻 𝗧𝗿𝗮𝗰𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 Since 2022, we have achieved:**
  
  

✅ $3\.2B\+ in transaction volume
  
  

✅ 60% revenue CAGR
  
  

✅ 50\+ blue\-chip clients,including China’s largest card network, SEA’s top banks, and global fintech leaders
  
  

✅ A growing team of 80\+ top\-tier professionals driving innovation, led by ex\-Goldman Sachs Mgt
  
  

𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗠𝗮𝗿𝗸𝗲𝘁 𝗢𝗽𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁𝘂𝗻𝗶𝘁𝘆 Cash is one of the largest under\-monetized assets ($42T) on institutional balance sheets.The winners will not market yield louder — they will embed cash monetization deeper into treasury stacks and partner platforms. That is the shift ScaleUp isbuilding toward: 𝘆𝗶𝗲𝗹𝗱\-𝗮𝘀\-𝗮\-𝗳𝗲𝗮𝘁𝘂𝗿𝗲 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗶𝗻𝘀𝘁𝗶𝘁𝘂𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝗮𝗹 𝗰𝗮𝘀𝗵 —through modular components, a single governed connection, and institutional\-grade control, auditability, and scale.
  
  

💡 𝗪𝗵𝘆 𝗡𝗼𝘄? In a higher\-rate, more volatile environment, cash is no longer passive.Institutions need better ways to monetize balances while preserving liquidityand control, and ScaleUp is helping drive that shift from parked cash to programmed cash.

jobs.title: CRM Developer (Microsoft Dynamics CRM / Dynamics 365)
jobs.description:
Overview of role
  
  

:
  
  

The CRM Developer is responsible for Microsoft Dynamics CRM / Dynamics 365 development, customization, implementation, and maintenance. He/She will develop and support CRM applications, integrations, workflows, plugins, and interfaces through .NET web services and APIs. The role requires close collaboration with business users, functional consultants, and project teams to deliver quality CRM solutions.
  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**  

Develop, customize, and maintain Microsoft Dynamics CRM / Dynamics 365 solutions.
  
  

Participate in requirements gathering and assist in translating business requirements into technical solutions.
  
  

Develop CRM plugins, workflows, custom modules, and integrations using CRM SDK, C\# and .NET technologies.
  
  

Build and maintain integrations with external systems using REST/SOAP web services and APIs.
  
  

Configure and support CRM security roles, teams, business processes, and system configurations.
  
  

Support mailbox configuration, server\-side synchronization, and CRM administration activities.
  
  

Perform unit testing, system testing, bug fixing, and deployment activities.
  
  

Troubleshoot application issues and provide timely resolution.
  
  

Prepare technical documentation and deployment documentation.
  
  

Provide post\-implementation support and maintenance services.
  
  

Work closely with project team members to ensure successful delivery of CRM projects.
  
  

Ensure application performance, code quality, and maintainability
  
  

**Requirements:**  

Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent.
  
  

Minimum 2 to 5 years of experience in Microsoft Dynamics CRM / Dynamics 365 development.
  
  

Experience in CRM customization, configuration, workflows, plugins, and integrations.
