Ti offriamo la possibilità di utilizzare fino a 20 giorni all’anno per una workation.
  
  

Contratto collettivo di lavoro
  
  

Il contratto collettivo di lavoro garantisce protezione, rafforza e crea regole chiare, per condizioni d’impiego e di lavoro eque.
  
  

Offerte di mobilità
  
  

Ti offriamo un abbonamento metà\-prezzo gratuito, un AG scontato o un bonus pendolari. Paghi solo CHF 10\.– all’anno con PubliBike o Velospot.
  
  

PostMobile e PostFinance
  
  

Con PostMobile ti offriamo un interessante abbonamento per il personale al costo di CHF 12\.95 al mese. Anche da PostFinance puoi beneficiare di numerosi vantaggi, ad esempio di un conto privato gratuito.
  
  

Buoni
  
  

Ti regaliamo fino a CHF 500\.– di credito personale che puoi utilizzare per tutti i prodotti del Postshop (carte regalo incluse) e per i prodotti FFS e Reka.
  
  

Il tuo processo di candidatura.
  
  

Il nostro processo di candidatura si svolge in diverse fasi. Così sai sempre a che punto ti trovi.
  
  

1\. Preselezione
  
  

Controlliamo accuratamente la tua documentazione e, se rientri nel profilo che cerchiamo, ti contattiamo entro due \- tre settimane.
  
  

2\. Primo colloquio virtuale
  
  

Saremo felici di fare la tua conoscenza in un primo colloquio virtuale.
  
  

3\. Secondo colloquio
  
  

Nel secondo colloquio abbiamo modo di conoscerti di persona in sede.
  
  

4\. Decisione finale
  
  

Di norma la decisione finale viene presa 6\-8 settimane dopo la presentazione della candidatura. In caso di risposta positiva ti comunichiamo oralmente un'offerta contrattuale corrispondente. Se la accetti, ti invieremo un'e\-mail di conferma delle condizioni contrattuali e redigeremo il contratto di lavoro.

jobs.title: Mécanicien/opérateur Rectifiage & Filtrage
jobs.description:
Position Overview:
**Qui nous sommes**


Novelis est animé par la volonté de façonner ensemble un monde durable.


En tant que leader mondial de produits et services innovants et le plus grand recycleur d'aluminium au monde d'aluminium, nous travaillons en partenariat avec des clients des secteurs de l'automobile, de l’aéronautique, des canettes et des spécialités pour fournir des solutions qui améliorent les avantages de l'aluminium léger.


Nous disposons d'un réseau coordonné d'opérations de laminage et de recyclage techniquement sophistiquées sur 29 sites dans 9 pays d'Amérique du Nord, d'Amérique du Sud, d'Europe et d'Asie, avec 12,750 employés dans le monde. Le siège se situe à Atlanta, aux États\-Unis.


Nous comptons parmi nos clients certaines des marques les plus importantes et les plus connues au monde, notamment Coca\-Cola, BMW, Jaguar Land Rover, Airbus, Boeing, Nespresso, Samsung, et d'autres. En outre, Novelis est à la pointe de l'industrie grâce à ses efforts en matière de durabilité et de recyclage.


Participez à notre mission de créer un monde durable et commencez dès que possible à travailler sur notre site de **Sierre**, en Suisse.

**Mécanicien/opérateur Rectifiage \& Filtrage (f/m/d)**

**Secteur EMRA Services**

Responsibilities \& Qualifications:
**Vos responsabilités:**

* Travailler en respectant toutes les règles de sécurité.
* Poste polyvalent combinant des activités d'exploitation des installations de rectifiage, filtration et distillation ainsi que des activités de maintenance mécanique, avec une répartition équilibrée entre les deux domaines.
* Intégré dans le département « rectifiage \& filtrage », vous participez seul ou en équipe à l’amélioration et au maintien de nos outils de production.

  

 Activités d’exploitation :

* Assurer le bon fonctionnement des installations de rectifiage, filtration et distillation afin de garantir la qualité, la disponibilité et la performance des équipements.
* Préparer les cylindres d'appui et de travail conformément aux standards de production.
* Participer aux activités quotidiennes d'exploitation et contribuer à l'atteinte des objectifs de production, de qualité et de sécurité.
* Contribuer à l'amélioration continue des installations et des méthodes de travail (5S, NOS, Operator Care).

  

 Activités de maintenance mécanique :

* Réaliser les opérations de maintenance préventive et corrective sur les équipements du secteur. Participer à la révision, à la mise en service et à l'amélioration continue des différentes parties de nos machines.
* Coordonner les interventions de maintenance et veiller à la fiabilité ainsi qu'à la disponibilité des équipements.
* Diagnostiquer les pannes et mettre en œuvre les actions nécessaires pour garantir la continuité de production

 **Comment nous** **convaincre:**

* CFC mécanicien (polymécanicien ou équivalent)
* Au moins deux ans d’expérience en milieu industriel
* Vous êtes dynamique, capable de prendre des initiatives, doté d’un bon sens de la communication et aimez travailler en équipe
* Vous faites preuve d’une grande rigueur et d’un fort sens de la qualité, conscient qu’une préparation ou une finition non conforme des cylindres peut avoir un impact direct sur la performance et la fiabilité de la production
* Connaissance de SAP est un avantage
* Vous êtes disponible à assurer un service de piquet
* Bonne compréhension des équipements industriels et des enjeux de performance (qualité, délais, coûts, KPI)
* Capacité à instaurer un climat de confiance, favorisant la cohésion d’équipe, l’engagement et une collaboration efficace au quotidien.
* Maîtrise du français ou de l’allemand, avec une bonne connaissance de l'autre langue (anglais un atout).


Merci de postuler avant le 2 octobre 2026\.
\-**Ihre Verantwortlichkeiten:*** Die Arbeit unter Einhaltung aller Sicherheitsvorschriften.
* Vielseitige Tätigkeit, die den Betrieb von Rektifikations\-, Filter\- und Destillationsanlagen sowie mechanische Wartungsarbeiten umfasst, wobei beide Bereiche gleichmäßig verteilt sind.
* Als Teil der Abteilung „Rektifikation \& Filterung“ tragen Sie allein oder im Team zur Verbesserung und Instandhaltung unserer Produktionsanlagen bei.

Betriebliche Tätigkeiten:* Sicherstellung des reibungslosen Betriebs der Schleif\-, Filter\- und Destillationsanlagen, um die Qualität, Verfügbarkeit und Leistungsfähigkeit der Anlagen zu gewährleisten.
* Vorbereitung der Stütz\- und Arbeitszylinder gemäß den Produktionsstandards.
* Mitwirkung an den täglichen betrieblichen Abläufen und Beitrag zur Erreichung der Produktions\-, Qualitäts\- und Sicherheitsziele.
* Beitrag zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Anlagen und Arbeitsmethoden (5S, NOS, Operator Care).

  

 Mechanische Instandhaltungsaufgaben:* Durchführung vorbeugender und korrektiver Instandhaltungsmaßnahmen an den Anlagen des Bereichs. Mitwirkung bei der Überholung, Inbetriebnahme und kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der verschiedenen Teile unserer Maschinen.
* Koordinierung der Wartungsmaßnahmen und Sicherstellung der Zuverlässigkeit sowie der Verfügbarkeit der Anlagen.
* Fehlerdiagnose und Umsetzung der erforderlichen Maßnahmen zur Gewährleistung der Produktionskontinuität

**Wie Sie uns überzeugen:*** EFZ als Mechaniker (Polymechaniker oder gleichwertige Qualifikation)
* Mindestens zwei Jahre Berufserfahrung im industriellen Umfeld
* Sie sind dynamisch, zeigen Eigeninitiative, verfügen über gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und arbeiten gerne im Team
* Sie zeichnen sich durch große Sorgfalt und ein ausgeprägtes Qualitätsbewusstsein aus und sind sich bewusst, dass eine nicht normgerechte Vorbereitung oder Endbearbeitung der Zylinder direkte Auswirkungen auf die Leistung und Zuverlässigkeit der Produktion haben kann
* SAP\-Kenntnisse sind von Vorteil
* Sie sind bereit, Pikettdienst zu leisten
* Gutes Verständnis für Industrieanlagen und Leistungsanforderungen (Qualität, Termine, Kosten, KPIs)
* Fähigkeit, ein vertrauensvolles Klima zu schaffen, das den Teamzusammenhalt, das Engagement und eine effiziente Zusammenarbeit im Arbeitsalltag fördert.
* Beherrschung der französischen oder deutschen Sprache sowie gute Kenntnisse der jeweils anderen Sprache (Englisch von Vorteil).

  

Bitte bewerben Sie sich bis zum 2\. Oktober 2026\.
Location Profile:

Novelis’ Sierre is located in the Valais Switzerland employing around 550 people. It mainly focuses on production of aluminium sheet for the automotive market covering the entire process from casting to finishing. The plant also hosts a world\-leading Research \& Innovation Center specialized in the development of new automotive sheet alloys surface treatment and joining technologies. In Feburary 2022 together with research institutions and a local energy provider Novelis founded the Net Zero Lab Valais to develop carbon\-neutral solutions for aluminium manufacturing. The lab focuses on identifying and implementing innovative solutions to neutralize the carbon footprint of Novelis’ manufacturing operations and neighboring communities starting in Sierre.
The Sierre plant supports its community through direct sponsorship of many annual events promoting education sports and culture.

jobs.title: Emergency Response Secretariat (EPP) Analyst, Humanitarian Response Division (HRD), Geneva, Switzerland, P-2
jobs.description:
**The Position:**

The Emergency Officer for the UNFPA Policy and Procedures for Emergency Response (EPPs) Secretariat post is located in the Global Emergency Response Unit (GERU) within the Humanitarian Response Division (HRD), based in Geneva. Under the guidance of the Head of the Global Emergency Response Unit, the candidate provides substantive support to the GERU team in the planning and implementation of the EPPs rollout, monitoring, knowledge management, and reporting of EPPs related processes. The candidate will be responsible for the EPP secretariat function, especially, when a corporate emergency response is activated.


Overall, the EPP Secretariat function covers emergency response multi stakeholders coordination, knowledge management, and substantive support to the Country Offices (COs), Regional Offices and all HQ Business Units involved in activated emergencies, as well as supporting the preparedness planning by GERU. The ultimate aim of this role is to support GERU and HRD’s role in ensuring that UNFPA’s emergency responses adhere to the structured policies and procedures framework outlined in the EPPs.


UNFPA is the lead UN agency for delivering a world where every pregnancy is wanted, every childbirth is safe and every young person's potential is fulfilled. UNFPA’s strategic plan (2021\-2025\), focuses on critical pathways and the strategies necessary to accelerate the achievement of three transformative results: (a) ending the unmet need for family planning; (b) ending preventable maternal deaths; and (c) ending gender\-based violence and harmful practices, including female genital mutilation and child, early and forced marriage. These three transformative results, which UNFPA is committed to achieving, also formed the basis of the current UNFPA strategic plan, 2018\-2021, the first of the three strategic plans leading to 2030\.


In a world where fundamental human rights are at risk, we need principled and ethical staff, who embody these international norms and standards, and who will defend them courageously and with full conviction.


UNFPA is seeking candidates that transform, inspire and deliver high impact and sustained results; we need staff who are transparent, exceptional in how they manage the resources entrusted to them and who commit to deliver excellence in Programme results.  

  



**How you can make a difference:**

UNFPA is the lead United Nations agency for delivering a world where every pregnancy is intended, every childbirth is safe, and every young person's potential is fulfilled. The UNFPA Strategic Plan for 2026\-2029 articulates the organization’s response to a complex global environment, providing a roadmap for resilience and renewal. It is designed to accelerate the implementation of the Programme of Action of the International Conference on Population and Development (ICPD) and the achievement of the Sustainable Development Goals by 2030\. This mandate is pursued through a focus on four interconnected outcomes: ending the unmet need for family planning; ending preventable maternal deaths; ending gender\-based violence and harmful practices; and adapting to demographic change through evidence and rights\-based policies.


In a world where fundamental human rights are at risk, we need principled and ethical staff who embody these international norms and standards and will defend them courageously and with full conviction.


UNFPA is seeking candidates who transform, inspire, and deliver high\-impact sustained results, ensuring effective external relations, communications, partnership\-building and resource mobilization in a rapidly changing development and funding landscape. We need staff who are transparent, exceptional in how they manage the resources entrusted to them, and who commit to delivering excellence in programme results.  

  



**Job Purpose:**

The Emergency Officer (EPP Secretary) is responsible for the following functions:


**General Emergency Coordination**

* Support the coordination role between HQ, ROs, and COs for EPP activated emergencies.
* Provide tailored operational support for emergency preparedness and response to UNFPA’s regional and country offices.
* Support the quality control and standardization in applying organizational policies in emergencies.
* Facilitate the activation and deactivation of emergency responses, and follow up action points that ensure EPP deliverables are met within the specified timelines.

**EPP Secretariat\-Specific Responsibilities**

* Support the EPP Crisis Response Team (CRT) meetings during emergency activations and deactivations, document the proceeding of the CRT, and to follow up the implementation of the actionable outcomes.
* Support the development, refinement, and dissemination of EPP tools, templates, and guidelines.
* Support the development and monitoring of preparedness actions, including risk analysis, contingency planning, and advanced preparedness measures.
* Monitor and document the adherence to EPP timelines and protocols, and support the provision of the technical guidance to ROs and COs.
* The Emergency Officer will support the coordination of the Level 3 (L3\) After Action Reviews (AARs) and support the implementation of AARs for Level 2 (L2\) and Level 1 (L1\) emergencies. The incumbent is responsible for consolidating and managing the knowledge that emerges from the AAR outcomes and ensuring follow\-up with relevant Business Units within UNFPA to implement corrective measures and strengthen organizational response capacity.

**Capacity Building and Knowledge Sharing**

* Support the development and delivery of capacity building training sessions on EPP protocols and emergency preparedness measures.
* Collate and synthesize lessons learned from emergency responses, contributing to the refinement of UNFPA’s emergency policies and procedures.

**Data Management and Reporting**

* Collect and analyze data from emergency responses, ensuring that findings inform planning and decision\-making processes.
* Prepare periodic reports on EPP activation and response activities for senior leadership.

**Cross\-functional support services**

* Within the Humanitarian Response Division, liaise with various units to support the integration of cross\-cutting thematic areas into UNFPA emergency response.
Contribute and provide inputs into interagency engagement on UNFPAs positions on emergency preparedness and response as per appropriate and requested.  
* 

**Qualifications and Experience:**

**Education:**

* An advanced university degree in International Relations/Development, Business Administration, Management, Humanitarian Affairs, International Law or other similar fields is required.

**Knowledge and Experience:**

* At least two (2\) years of progressively responsible experience in humanitarian affairs, field operations, emergency preparedness, project management, or advisory services in humanitarian settings, with an in\-country office operations experience.
* Proven experience in coordination and field\-level program implementation.
* Strong understanding of humanitarian response and preparedness frameworks, including the IASC protocols.
* Knowledge management experience is an asset, including use of dashboards and data analysis and management.
* Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to operate under stressful conditions.
* Strong interpersonal and organizational skills.
* Experience within the UN system would be an asset.
* Previous secretariat experience or special assistance function will be an asset.
* Computer literacy \- Word, Excel, Power\-point, etc., and good knowledge of Atlas/PeopleSoft would be an asset.
* Proficient writing and communication skills.

**Languages:**

* Fluency in English is required. Knowledge of Arabic, French or another official UN language is considered as an asset.

**Required Competencies:**

**Values:**

* Exemplifying integrity,
* Demonstrating commitment to UNFPA and the UN system,
* Embracing cultural diversity,
* Embracing change

**Core Competencies:**

* Integrity/Commitment to the mandate;
* Achieving results
* Results orientation/Commitment to excellence;
* Self and conflict management;
* Communicating information and ideas;
* Ability to plan and organize;
* Being accountable;
* Developing and applying professional expertise/ business acumen;
* Thinking analytically and strategically;
* Working in teams/ managing ourselves and our relationships;
* Communicating for impact

**Functional Competencies:**

* Strong analytical skills.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Proficiency in current office software applications and corporate IT systems.
Proficiency in data analysis and reporting  
* 

**Compensation and Benefits:**

This position offers an attractive remuneration package including a competitive net salary plus health insurance and other benefits as applicable.


**UNFPA Work Environment:**

UNFPA provides a work environment that reflects the values of gender equality, diversity, integrity and healthy work\-life balance. We are committed to ensuring gender parity in the organization and therefore encourage women to apply. Individuals from the LGBTQIA\+ community, minority ethnic groups, indigenous populations, persons with disabilities, and other underrepresented groups are highly encouraged to apply. Reasonable accommodation may be provided to applicants with disabilities upon request, to support their participation in the recruitment process. UNFPA promotes equal opportunities in terms of appointment, training, compensation and selection for all regardless of personal characteristics and dimensions of diversity. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion is at the heart of UNFPA's workforce \- click here to learn more.


**Disclaimer:**

Selection and appointment may be subject to background and reference checks, medical clearance, visa issuance and other administrative requirements.


UNFPA does not charge any application, processing, training, interviewing, testing or other fee in connection with the application or recruitment process and does not concern itself with information on applicants' bank accounts.


Applicants for positions in the international Professional and higher categories, who hold permanent resident status in a country other than their country of nationality, may be required to renounce such status upon their appointment.

jobs.title: Application Engineer
jobs.description:
EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and software development services, with two offices in Switzerland (Zurich, Geneva).


We're looking for an **Application Engineer** to join our team in Lausanne, Switzerland in an onsite working mode. In this role, you will develop and maintain critical applications that support scheduling, dispatch, risk management and compliance processes. Your contributions will directly impact operational efficiency and regulatory adherence across complex environments.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead requirements gathering and specification for data management applications
* Collaborate with client managers, Product Managers and development teams to prioritize and deliver product backlog items
* Ensure adherence to applicable regulations and internal security guidelines
* Facilitate clear communication between business units and technical teams
* Oversee application maintenance, performance optimization and migration activities
* Mitigate risks linked to product delivery and evolving business needs
* Drive continuous delivery of features and improvements focused on usability and value
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders and third\-party suppliers to align product goals

**Requirements**

* Proven experience in eliciting and specifying complex business requirements
* Familiarity with regulatory compliance frameworks (GDPR, NIS2, REMIT)
* Hands\-on exposure as a Product Owner or Proxy PO in an agile environment
* Strong understanding of Oracle Forms, Python and C\#
* Excellent analytical skills to translate business needs into technical solutions
* Solid background in backlog refinement and risk assessment
* Effective communication and client\-facing skills to engage multiple stakeholders

**Nice to have**

* Knowledge of system integration techniques and performance tuning
* Previous experience in regulated environments
* Exposure to cloud\-native technologies or DevOps practices

**We offer**

* 5 weeks of vacation
* EPAM Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)
* Enhanced parental leave
* Extended pension plan
* Daily sickness allowance insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Global business travel medical and accident insurance
* Learning and development opportunities including in\-house training and coaching, professional certifications, and courses
* Please note that any offers will be subject to appropriate background checks
* We do not accept CVs from recruiting or staffing agencies
* For this position, we are able to consider applications from the following:

* + Swiss nationals
	+ EU/EFTA nationals
	+ Third\-country nationals based in Switzerland with an appropriate work permit
	+ Displaced people from Ukraine who are currently in Switzerland and hold, or have already applied for, S permits

jobs.title: Solution Architect
jobs.description:
We're looking for a **Solution Architect** to join our team in Zurich, Switzerland in a hybrid working mode. The position involves sustaining and evolving a suite of internally developed applications built on Oracle Forms, Python and C\#, enabling operational stability while driving modernization initiatives within the power, utilities and renewables domain.


This is an excellent opportunity to provide architectural leadership, guide legacy\-to\-modern solution design and shape enterprise\-leve platforms within a highly regulated sector.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead the design and integration of legacy Oracle Forms applications with modern technologies to support critical operations
* Ensure system reliability and availability for business\-critical processes including scheduling and TSO nominations
* Collaborate with internal team members, client managers and third\-party vendors to maintain alignment and clear communication
* Oversee support activities, troubleshooting and enhancements for existing management applications during the maintenance phase
* Define and implement an IT roadmap that enables modernization and scalability of management solutions
* Facilitate technical meetings to present architectures, gather feedback and coordinate implementation efforts
* Translate architectural concepts into operational processes ensuring smooth handover and compliance with business goals

**Requirements**

We’re seeing an increase in fraudulent job offers. To protect yourself, please follow these key guidelines when applying for roles at ING:

Y aunque por fuera parezcamos naranjas, por dentro somos verdes. Nuestra ambición en sostenibilidad es impulsar tu viaje y el nuestro hacia la sostenibilidad. Estamos recorriendo nuestro propio camino, pero también estaremos al lado de nuestra clientela cuando decida emprender el suyo.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Integrations & API
jobs.description:
**Make a measurable and mission\-critical impact.**

  

**Join us** **on the**  

**Product Management** **team** **as a** **Product Manager – Integrations \&** **API’s**, and help shape the future of safer, more efficient, and more reliable operations across the globe.  

**Start your journey with Anova today****!**

 **Role Summary:**



The Product Manager owns a significant product domain within Anova Unify — from multi\-year strategy through to execution, adoption, and business outcomes. You set the vision for your area, build conviction through deep customer and market insight, and drive delivery in close partnership with engineering and design. You operate with a high degree of autonomy, influence roadmap direction across the broader product organization, and are a go\-to thought partner for senior leadership.



This role's center of gravity is outcomes — customer value realized, revenue retained and grown, and platform capability that compounds over time. You're as comfortable in a customer conversation as you are in a data model discussion or a board\-level briefing. You mentor more junior PMs and raise the bar for how the team thinks about product quality, discovery rigor, and measurable impact.

  

**Where you’ll work:**

  


This is a hybrid role based out of our Porto office. In practice, most of your work can be done remotely, with occasional in\-office time in Porto for team collaboration — a flexibility our team consistently tell us they value.

  

**Job Duties and Responsibilities:**


* Lead deep customer discovery. Design and run ongoing discovery programs — interviews, site visits, usage analysis, win/loss reviews. Develop a differentiated point of view on what customers need, what they'll pay for, and what will create durable competitive advantage.
* Own the go\-to\-market. Define pricing and positioning for your area in partnership with Marketing and Sales leadership. Enable the field with competitive intelligence, winning narratives, and objection handling.
* Set domain strategy. Define the multi\-year product vision for your area. Ground it in customer insight, competitive dynamics, and Anova's strategic priorities. Build and maintain the roadmap with clear outcome targets.
* Drive AI\-first product thinking. Identify where ML and AI (forecasting, anomaly detection, decision support, workflow automation) create meaningful customer value in your domain. Build a clear point of view on what to build, what to buy, and what to partner for — and move it from idea to shipped capability.
* Partner with engineering on architecture and trade\-offs. Engage credibly on system design, API contracts, data models, and integration architecture. Make principled trade\-offs between scope, speed, and technical quality — and document your reasoning.
* Reason across the full stack. Understand how Anova's physical devices, connectivity layer, and cloud platform interact — and make product decisions that account for hardware constraints, firmware cycles, and sensor data quality, not just software capabilities.
* Shape the customer success motion. Codify what success looks like for customers in your domain. Influence the playbooks, onboarding milestones, health scoring, and AI\-assisted scale programs that Customer Success runs.
* Mentor and develop PMs. Coach junior and mid\-level PMs on discovery methods, spec quality, prioritization discipline, and stakeholder communication. Model the standard for written PM artifacts across the team.
* Enable adoption. With each release, ensure the team is ready to help customers get value from what you've shipped.
  


**Outcomes you'll own:**

  


* Anova leads customer insight amongst the IoT market. Your work toward understanding customers, their processes, and how IoT transforms their business, will keep Anova the leading player that best understands how IoT leads to our customer's value in servicing their customers.
* Platform growth and customer value realization. Your domain drives measurable customer outcomes — reduced operating costs, faster time\-to\-value, or expanded use cases. You track and improve these metrics continuously.
* Greater than 90% customer device productivity. Through solving real value\-adding problems for customers, providing best in class reliable uptime, drive customers to maintain their device portfolio live and healthy.
* Net Revenue Retention. Customers in your area renew, expand, and advocate. You own the product\-side inputs to NRR — adoption, engagement, and satisfaction — and make disciplined trade\-offs to protect gross margin.
* Roadmap quality and conviction. A rigorous, evidence\-backed roadmap that the organization trusts. You can defend every priority with data, customer insight, and a clear strategic rationale.
* Cross\-functional alignment. Engineering, Customer Success, Sales, and Marketing are aligned on what's being built and why. Ambiguity is resolved upstream, not during delivery.
* Team development. You raise the craft of product management around you — through direct mentorship of PMs, strong written artifacts others learn from, and a culture of honest, evidence\-based decision\-making.

  


**How you'll work at Anova:**


* You write to think. Specs, strategy memos, one\-pagers, and decision frameworks are how we align a global, distributed team. Your written artifacts are models others reference. AI can help; writing well remains your skill to own.
* You use AI as leverage. You're fluent with LLMs for research, synthesis, drafting, and analysis. You have a seasoned, nuanced point of view on where AI should — and shouldn't — show up in B2B industrial products, and you actively shape Anova's perspective on both.
* You reason from data. You define the metric before you ship the feature. You build the instrumentation plan alongside the spec. You know when data is sufficient to decide and when it isn't.

  


**What you’ll need to succeed:**  

**Minimum Requirements \-**


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience with APIs, systems integration, and software deployment.
* 6\+ years of experience as a Product Manager, with direct ownership of product strategy and business outcomes.
* 10\+ years of total professional experience, spanning product management, software engineering, systems integration, or comparable technical roles.
* You've built from scratch more than once — new products, new markets, new internal capabilities — and you have the experience to prove it. The more times you've started from nothing and shipped something that mattered, the better.
* Demonstrated track record of shipping SaaS or enterprise software that drove material business results — measured in adoption, retention, or revenue.
* Experience owning multi\-year product strategy and translating it into a prioritized, evidence\-backed roadmap.
* Deep customer discovery practice — structured interview programs, synthesis frameworks, and the ability to build conviction from ambiguous signals.
* Demonstrated experience using AI and LLM tools in a product management context — for research, synthesis, spec drafting, competitive analysis, data work, or customer insight.
* A clear, developed point of view on how AI should show up in B2B industrial products — both in internal operations and in customer\-facing capability.
* Ability to write compelling, structured strategy documents, specs, and narratives for executive and cross\-functional audiences.
* Strong technical fluency — able to engage credibly on APIs, data models, integration architecture, and system trade\-offs with engineering leaders.
* Data fluency: design metrics frameworks, build instrumentation plans, analyze data in BI tools, and make evidence\-based roadmap calls.
* Experience influencing pricing and go\-to\-market decisions for a product area.

  


**Preferred Qualifications \-**


* Prior product management in IIoT, connected\-hardware, or industrial technology environments.
* Experience shipping ML or AI\-driven features — forecasting, anomaly detection, decision support, or workflow automation — in a SaaS environment.
* Background in venture or private\-equity\-backed high\-growth industrial technology companies.
* Experience mentoring or managing junior PMs or leading a product pod.
* Domain knowledge in industrial operations, field service, supply chain, or logistics.
* Experience with enterprise integration patterns — ERP, dispatch, routing, or billing system connectivity.
  


**Physical Requirements** **\-**


* Willingness and ability to travel up to 30–40% domestically and internationally.
* Travel won’t consistently be 30\-40%, however at times this individual must be able to travel up to that percentage monthly
* Ability to perform typical office tasks, including sitting or standing for extended periods, using a computer, communicating effectively, and occasionally lifting light items

  


**ABOUT ANOVA**



We are very proudly “one” Anova — built by integrating the best in IIoT technology and expertise. Anova monitors more than 1,250,000 assets across nearly 80 countries for over 2000 clients, from family businesses to the largest LPG, Industrial Gases, and chemicals companies in the world. Our scale is global. Our service is local. We partner directly with customers, taking a holistic approach and delivering tailored solutions that drive innovation and improvement and make our world safer, more efficient, and reliable.

  



We believe that rewarding work should reward you. As part of Anova, your work, integrity, and commitment are rewarded through competitive compensation and reward strategies, through sincere appreciation, and through opportunities for growth and advancement. We put people first by providing benefits that support your life and well\-being, from health and finance to recognition and reward, and so much more — we've got you covered.

 **If this sounds like a fit for you, apply to join Anova in connecting the industrial world — for better.**

  

For more information about how Anova is transforming the Industrial IOT industry, visit us at Anova.com.

**About Us**
Planet is a leading technology company transforming payments by putting customer experience first. We offer integrated solutions that include payment processing, VAT refunds, dynamic currency conversion, and management services for merchants in the Retail and Hospitality sectors worldwide.


In recent years, we have experienced significant growth, expanding our services and global presence.


With strong private equity investors, Advent International and Eurazeo, we have the financial capital and expertise to grow our capabilities and reach through acquisitions.


Our mission is to create a world of connected commerce where payments are simple, secure, and seamless, enabling our partners to deliver exceptional experiences to their customers.

 **Role overview:**


Planet is scaling AI\-first engineering across its technology organisation, and the AI Enablement team is helping turn that ambition into day\-to\-day reality.


We are looking for **Senior AI Developer Experience Engineers** to join the team and help drive adoption across Engineering. This is a hands\-on role focused on AI Fluency, developer experience, internal enablement tooling, and measurable improvement across the software delivery lifecycle.


You will work closely with teams across Engineering, partnering directly with developers, QAs, product owners, scrum masters, business analysts, and managers to help them adopt better ways of working with AI. This is not a role from the sidelines. You will spend time with teams, understand where they struggle, coach them in practical contexts, and help embed better habits into real delivery work.


We are looking for people with strong engineering foundations who also bring a strong human touch. You should be someone who communicates clearly, builds trust easily, works well with different personalities, and knows how to bring people with you. Success in this role depends as much on credibility with engineers as it does on your ability to explain, facilitate, coach, and create momentum across the organisation.


You will help enable more than 300 engineers, alongside a broader set of SDLC roles, through structured AI Fluency sessions, hands\-on pairing, internal agents and workflows, reusable guidance, and support for priority initiatives. Over time, the role will also help drive adoption of broader platform and toolchain capabilities that improve engineering effectiveness across Planet.

 **What You'll Do:**

* Deliver AI Fluency sessions across Engineering and SDLC roles, from prompt engineering fundamentals to more advanced agentic coding workflows and practical AI\-first ways of working
* Work closely with teams across Engineering, building strong relationships, understanding where they struggle, and helping them adopt AI and better workflows in a practical, team\-friendly way
* Pair directly with developers and teams to improve adoption in real delivery work, helping them use tools such as GitHub Copilot, Copilot CLI, internal AI agents, workflow automations, and related capabilities effectively and responsibly.
* Help maintain and improve internal enablement tooling, including AI agents, automations, templates, prompts, workflows, and supporting assets used across the organisation.
* Create high\-quality enablement content, including guides, templates, examples, recorded sessions, best practices, and role\-specific learning material that teams can actually use.
* Assess and track AI maturity across teams using Planet’s AI Fluency model, helping identify where support is needed and where stronger patterns can be scaled.
* Support priority initiatives with dedicated AI\-first coaching, helping delivery teams apply better workflows, better prompting, and more effective use of internal tools in live projects.
* Collaborate closely with Architecture and Platform teams so enablement stays aligned with engineering standards, platform capabilities, system landscape, and the way Planet builds software.
* Capture adoption signals, usage insights, and learning feedback, and feed these into the AI Centre of Excellence and broader leadership reporting.
* Over time, help expand enablement beyond AI tooling into broader developer experience and platform adoption across the engineering toolchain.

 **Who you are:**

* Strong software engineering background, with experience building or maintaining production systems and a solid understanding of the full SDLC.
* Hands\-on experience with AI\-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Copilot CLI, Cursor, Cody, Claude Code, or similar.
* Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly, run hands\-on workshops, and adapt your style to different audiences across Engineering.
* Strong interpersonal skills and a genuine human touch. You build trust, work well with different personalities, and enjoy helping teams improve in a practical and collaborative way.
* Credibility with engineers. You are comfortable pairing with developers, discussing implementation trade\-offs, and helping teams improve how they work in practice.
* Experience creating strong technical content such as guides, tutorials, documentation, or internal learning material.
* A genuine interest in developer experience, engineering productivity, and helping teams adopt better ways of working.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Experience in developer experience, developer enablement, developer advocacy, or internal technical coaching.
* Understanding of enterprise engineering environments, including APIs, system design patterns, CI/CD, observability, infrastructure, and engineering governance.
* Strong understanding of prompt design, LLM capabilities, agentic workflows, and practical AI usage patterns in software engineering.
* Experience defining or tracking adoption metrics, maturity models, developer productivity indicators, or ROI\-oriented enablement measures.
* Experience with workflow automation and internal tooling, including platforms such as N8N or similar.
* Familiarity with fintech, payments, or regulated engineering environments.

**Tech Environment**


AI and enablement tools: GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Copilot CLI, internal AI agents, workflow automations


Engineering ecosystem: GitHub, Azure DevOps, Jira, Confluence, Terraform


Languages and stacks: Java, .NET, TypeScript, Python, and others across Planet teams

 **Why Planet**


Planet is an equal opportunity employer where diversity is valued, and all employment is decided based on qualifications, merit, and business need.


Come and grow your career in the most exciting, fast\-paced technology market, with a business that delivers feel\-good connected commerce.


We would love to hear from you. Apply now.


At Planet, we embrace a hybrid work model, with three days a week in the office.

  

Reasonable accommodations may be made in order to allow for an individual to perform the essential functions of this role successfully.


  
### **About Us**

**Company Background**


Planet provides integrated software, payment and technology solutions for its customers in the Hospitality and Retail sectors and worldwide via a network of global Financial Services Partners.


Founded over 35 years ago, we have evolved our services, delivering an innovative digital commerce platform that puts customer experience first.


With headquarters in London and around 3,000 expert employees located across six continents we serve customers in over 120 markets.

jobs.title: Associate Industrial Engineer (PT)
jobs.description:
**Associate Industrial Engineer (PT)**
======================================



Are you a recent engineering graduate who enjoys solving technical challenges and understanding how complex machines are built, maintained and improved? Do you have an analytical mindset and enjoy working with different engineering disciplines? Then this could be the ideal first step in your career at WEB in Porto.

  


#### **Kick\-start your engineering career in high\-tech**


As an Associate Industrial Engineer, you will work on innovative high\-tech projects for leading technology companies. Together with experienced colleagues, you will learn how industrialization, manufacturing processes and technical documentation contribute to the successful delivery and maintenance of complex systems.


This role offers a strong learning environment where you can develop your technical expertise, problem\-solving skills and understanding of industrial engineering within a professional project organization.


**Your role**
-------------


As an Associate Industrial Engineer, you will:


* Analyze existing processes, procedures and technical systems with high complexity under supervision.
* Support the creation and maintenance of technical procedures, work instructions and documentation.
* Collect, structure and validate technical information for project teams and Technical Authors.
* Contribute to identifying process bottlenecks and opportunities for improvement.
* Support industrialization activities related to module build, testing, installation and maintenance.
* Assist in evaluating manufacturability, serviceability and maintenance aspects of products and systems.
* Collaborate with engineers, project teams and other stakeholders to ensure technical information is accurate and complete.
* Learn to apply industrial engineering methodologies, customer requirements and quality standards.

**What you bring**
------------------


**Education**


* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Systems Engineering or a related engineering discipline.

**Experience**


* Starter or recent graduate.
* Relevant internships, graduation projects or extracurricular engineering activities are considered a plus.
* Affinity with manufacturing, industrialization, process improvement or high\-tech engineering environments.

**Personal skills**


* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills. (you like solving complex technical puzzles)
* Curious, eager to learn and motivated to develop yourself.
* Structured and methodical way of working.
* Attention to detail and focus on quality.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work in multidisciplinary and international teams.
* Interest in complex technical systems and processes.

**Language**


* Excellent command of the English language.

**Your colleagues**
-------------------


#### **Philippe**


Manager Projects


#### **Els**


Business Unit Manager Projects


#### **Sofia**


Recruiter Porto


#### **You?**


Associate Industrial Engineer (PT)
**How you will work**
---------------------


You will be part of our Projects organization, working from our Porto office within an international team of engineers, technical authors and project professionals.


While Porto will be your home base, you will collaborate daily with colleagues, customers and project teams across multiple countries. Together, you support the development, industrialization and optimization of highly complex machines and systems for leading technology companies.


You will collaborate closely with Project Leaders, Technical Authors and experienced Industrial Engineers while building your knowledge of manufacturing processes, diagnostics, availability and serviceability.


At WEB, learning and development are central. You will receive coaching, guidance and feedback that will help you grow into an independent Industrial Engineer.

  


**What we offer**
-----------------


Gross monthly salary between €1400,\- and €1750,\-, depending on your experience and qualifications (based on a 14\-salary structure). In addition, you can expect:


* Meal allowance (€10\.20 net per working day via meal card).
* Work\-from\-home possibilities.
* Frequent international trips to clients and other WEB office locations.
* Health Insurance (Multicare 3\).
* 26 holiday days per year.
* Mental health support.
* Personal development budget.
* IT budget.
* Exposure to challenging projects within the high\-tech industry.
* An international and collaborative working environment.
* Clear career growth opportunities within WEB.

**Why WEB?**
------------


At WEB, we believe in developing talent. As an Associate Industrial Engineer, you will work on meaningful projects, learn from experienced professionals and gain exposure to some of the most advanced technologies in the industry.
  

We invest in your growth from day one and provide the support, training and opportunities needed to build a successful engineering career.


**Equal Opportunities \& Transparency**
---------------------------------------


We are committed to fair, transparent and unbiased recruitment processes. We evaluate all candidates based on their skills, experience and potential, regardless of age, gender identity, nationality, disability, religion or background.


We believe diverse teams create better solutions, stronger collaboration and better results. Therefore, we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.


**Ready to start your new chapter?**
------------------------------------


Can you already see yourself in this role? Send us your CV and motivation and show us why you’re the perfect fit for WEB. Who knows, you could soon be joining us in shaping the next generation of high\-tech innovations!

By upholding our values of respect, excellence, collaboration and integrity; Al\-Futtaim Group continues to enrich the lives and aspirations of our customers each and every day

  

**Overview Of The Role:**  

* The Commercial Vehicles Sales Representative for the HINO Trucks Division is responsible for driving sales growth by actively seeking and engaging with prospective customers. This role focuses on achieving sales targets, maximizing profitability, and ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction through effective relationship management and consultative selling practices. Success in this position requires strong product knowledge, exceptional communication skills, and the ability to operate effectively in a fast\-paced environment.

* Achieve and exceed monthly and annual sales targets while maximizing profitability by focusing on net sales and gross margin earnings.
* Utilize discounts effectively as a tool to close deals, ensuring profitability and customer satisfaction.

#### **Customer Engagement**

  

* Contact prospective customers and manage assigned accounts within the designated territory.
* Conduct regular customer and field visits to assess business requirements, ensure satisfaction, and maintain long\-term relationships.
* Qualify customers by understanding their requirements and interests and matching them to appropriate models.

#### **Product Demonstration**

  

* Demonstrate trucks by explaining characteristics, capabilities, and features, offering test drives, and explaining warranties and services.

#### **Administrative Responsibilities**

  

* Write sales orders, secure deposits, and process paperwork in line with established business policies.
* Provide sales management with information by completing reports.
* Ensure that monthly overdue payments are within the agreed target.

#### **Professional Development**

  

* Attend all sales meetings, modular training sessions, and refresher courses to stay informed about new products.
* Communicate with the Sales Manager or Branch Manager regarding any additional training requirements.

  

**Required Skills To Be Successful:**  

* Strong PC skills, including proficiency in Excel and Microsoft Office.
* Excellent customer service and strong communication skills.
* Solid time management and analytical skills.
* Goal\-oriented self\-starter with the ability to thrive in a fast\-paced work environment.

  

**What Qualifies You For The Role:**  

* 3\+ years of experience in a Commercial Vehicle sales role at a dealership.
* Mandatory experience in light, medium, and heavy\-duty truck sales in UAE.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

A major division of the UAE\-based Al\-Futtaim Group of companies, **Al\-Futtaim Automotive** is an industry leader with presence in 10 countries across the Middle East, Asia and Africa.  

Our core business activities at Al\-Futtaim Automotive include distribution, manufacturing, leasing and aftersales, and we are firmly established as the regional representative of some of the world’s most iconic automotive brands: Toyota, Lexus, Honda, Jeep, Chrysler, Dodge, Volvo and RAM.

jobs.description:
**Some careers have more impact than others.**


If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.


HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking is a markets\-led, financing\-focused business that provides investment and financial solutions. Through our international network, we connect emerging and mature markets, covering key growth areas. We partner with our corporate, government and institutional clients to help them achieve consistent, long\-term performance. Our products and services include advisory, financing, prime services, research and analysis, securities services, trading and sales and transaction banking.


This role is within our Global Payments Solutions (GPS) team and will support the onboarding and integration of clients onto HSBC Global Payments and Liquidity solutions, coordinating delivery across internal teams and client stakeholders to ensure a smooth implementation onto HSBC digital channels. They will manage a portfolio of client connectivity projects with clear governance, strong execution discipline, and timely escalation to protect client experience and delivery outcomes.

**In this role you will**

* Manage end\-to\-end delivery of client onboarding and connectivity implementations across HSBC digital channels, including HSBCnet, Treasury API, Host\-to\-Host (H2H) and SwiftNet.
* Own day\-to\-day project governance: maintain project plans, milestones, RAID (risks, actions, issues, dependencies), meeting cadence, and status reporting.
* Drive delivery timelines to support efficient implementation and timely client go\-live, escalating blockers early and coordinating resolution with relevant teams.
* Coordinate stakeholders across GPS Product, Technology, Operations, Implementation teams, and Sales/Relationship Management to progress deliverables and manage dependencies.
* Support client communication throughout the project lifecycle: organise working sessions, capture decisions/actions, and provide clear progress updates.
* Contribute to client workshops to gather requirements and support business automation goals, partnering with SMEs for solution design and technical alignment.
* Support pre\-mandate activity (e.g., RFI/RFP inputs) by providing implementation approach, timelines, assumptions, and delivery dependencies, with senior oversight.
* Maintain accurate implementation documentation and support streamlined document handling using approved tools
* Capture lessons learned and client feedback to support continuous improvement and enhance client experience (including Net Promoter Score (NPS) outcomes).
* Stay informed on relevant industry developments, including emerging connectivity approaches and changes impacting payments delivery (e.g., ISO 20022 awareness).

 **To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:**

* Experience delivering projects in a client\-facing environment; payments, cash management, connectivity, or technology implementation experience is preferred
* Strong organisation and prioritisation skills; able to manage multiple workstreams and deliver under time pressure
* Clear communication skills with the ability to tailor updates to different audiences and work effectively across cultures and time zones.
* Working knowledge (or strong interest) in payments/liquidity and digital connectivity concepts (API/H2H/SWIFT); familiarity with ISO 20022 is an advantage.
* Practical problem\-solving mindset with disciplined escalation and a focus on outcomes and client experience
* Fluent written and spoken English required; Mandarin is an advantage
* A graduation degree is essential for obtaining a UAE visa and work permit. If your university certificate is from outside the UAE, up\-to\-date attestations and equivalency are also mandatory (Recognition of Higher Education Qualifications Issued Outside The UAE)

 **You’ll achieve more at HSBC.**


HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.


We believe diversity brings benefits for our customers, our business and our people. Different ideas and perspectives help us innovate, manage risk and grow the business in a sustainable way. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

  

Issued by The Hong Kong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited.
